tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi snying thig zhes bya ba bzhugs so// e ma ho/ mthu stobs nus pa'i zer ma re res kyang / /bdud dpung ma lus cig car tshar bcad nas/ /bla med lam la bkod mdzad khro bo'i rgyal/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu gus pas mchod/ /rnam dag chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang / /rnam mang gdul bya'i dpal mgon sna tshogs gar/ /rnam gsum rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /rnam dag blo yis kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsung rab dam pa'i chos/ /chos kyi nying khu bla med theg pa'i rgyud/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje phur pa'i lam/ /lam de phyogs tsam gsal la bdag blo spro/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad pa dam bcas nas/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bla med rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams yin zhing / gang zhe na theg pa dman pa rnams lta zhog gi theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du zhugs nas/ blo gros dang snying stobs ji ltar che yang grangs med gsum du dka' spyad dgos shing / sngags kyi theg pa'i lam du zhugs na tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thob par gsungs te/ ye shes thig le las/ blo gros che yang theg gzhan gyi/ /grangs med gsum nas sangs rgyas yin/ /sngags kyi theg pa la mos na/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /rgyud sde'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu zab cing rgya che bar gyur pa ni/ rdo rje phur pa' ིrgyud rnams yin te/ gsang rgyud las/ phur pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ste/ /phur pa lung gi bla ma yin/ /phur pa man ngag nges pa'i don/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar rdo rje phur pa 'di la/ rtsa ba lta bu'i rgyud gsum/ bshad pa'i rgyud lnga/ cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum/ rgyud phyi ma gnyis/ phyi ma'i phyi ma gsang ba sde drug bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga/

rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga/ la bzla ba'i rgyud lnga/ drag po rma thabs kyi rgyud gnyis/ 'phrin las gtso bor ston pa 'bum bskor te/ rang gzhung tshugs pa'i rgyud sum cu rtsa bdun dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu la rgyud bcu/ dam can ma rnams la bzhi/ gtor rgyud dang tshogs rgyud gnyis te rgyud chung bcu drug sdom che chung lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs pa las/ 'dir phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu la brten pa'i sgrub bskor yin/ 'o na phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu gang zhe na/ rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa byi to ta ma 'bum sde'i rgyud dam/ rigs pa mchog gi rgyud las/ rdo rje rigs kyi le'u zur du phyung ba la/ phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bur grags pa yin zhing / de slob dpon gang gis zur du phyung zhing dgos pa ci'i phyir du'o zhe na/ slob dpon ni kun mkhyen gnyis pa a+yon gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid yin zhing / dgos pa ni gong du smos pa'i rgyud de dag gi don thams cad rdo rje rigs kyi le'u 'di la 'dus par dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar rtsa dum 'di nyid la brten nas a+yon gyi mkhan po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang phur thun mong gi sgrub thabs/ rja ེbtsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i tho yig de dag gi gsal byed dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtogs par sla ba/ de yi zur 'debs rin chen do shal dang / sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gnyis/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa la sogs te sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa mang du bzhugs pa las/ 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos dngos ni/

sa los mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed 'di nyid la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mchan bu gnang ba'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi 'od can zhes bya ba de nyid nyams su blangs nas bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul dmigs rim dang bcas pa gsal bar ston pa bdud rtsi snying thig zhes bya ba 'di yin zhing / de la dang po yid ches shing khung btsun par bya ba'i phyir/ lo rgyus kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ sngon gyi dus gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi sku ye shes kyi rang mdangs gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po nyid kyis/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rang snang dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par bzhengs te/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi mnga' thang chen po la dbang bsgyur ba khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang / gzhan yang rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa 'bras bu'i sems dpa' rnams la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa theg chen bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams gsungs shing / de rnams ni rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa ste/ 'o na rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zhes pa gang zhe na/ ston pa dang 'khor gyi rnam par tsam du snang ba ma gtogs dbyings dang ye shes tha mi dad pas/ chos thams cad rang rig rang shar gyi ngang du gsungs pa la/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zhes 'jog pa yin te/ de skad du yang / rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig /chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang / /thabs mkhas gang 'dul so so'i skur ston pa/ /thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de nas mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu mdzes pa'i dpal dang ldan pa de nyid kyis lha rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun pa zab mo lta ba'i phyogs rnams lha yul du gsungs shing dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/

de skad du yang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal thugs kyi dgongs pa yis/ /lha dbang brgya byin gnas su gsang sngags byon/ /tshom bu 'bum dang bcas te mngon sangs rgyas/ /lha yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi sman gyi sku dang ldan pa de nyid kyis klu rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par sgrub pa zab mo'i bskor rnams klu yul du gsungs shing dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ de skad du yang / spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi dgongs pa yis/ /klu rgyal 'jog po'i gnas su gsang sngags byon/ /tshom bu 'bum dang bcas te mngon sangs rgyas/ /klu yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /phyag na rdo rje 'jigs tshul mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag de nyid kyis gnod sbyin rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par drag po mngon spyod kyi las rnams gnod sbyin dang mi yul du gsungs te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ de skad du yang / phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dgongs pa yis/ /rgyal po dza yi gnas su gsang sngags byon/ /gang zag las can ma lus byang chub 'tho+ob/ /mi yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du ston pa shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan khar lung bstan pa/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri la 'byung / /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /mi las skal ldan dam pa zhig /byang chub mchog tu 'grub gyur pas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes bshad pas/ lo bcu phrag gnyis dang nyag ma brgyad ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dus su rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la phyag rdor gyis gsungs pa'i las can 'di nyid byang chub mchog tu bsgrub pa'o/

/de las rgyud sde yul a+yon gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / yul dbus kyi slob dpon bi ma mi tra dang / yul bal po'i slob dpon shī la mañdzu ste/ mkhas pa mi gsum gyis gsan nas bal yul a su ra'i brag phug tu rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad/ de'i dus su grub rtags rab 'bring tha gsum du byung ste/ rab phur pa nam mkha' la lding ba de pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi phyag gis blangs te rgya gar tsan dan gyi nags tshal rgya che zhing dpangs mthug pa de la btab pas/ spu rtse la me gtugs pa ltar dmar lam ste bsregs/ slar skad cig de nyid la lo 'bras me tog dang bcas pa sngar ltar 'khrungs so/ /de'i dgos pa ni nags tshal de'i gseb na mu stegs pa'i grong khyer mang du yod pa de bsreg pa'i ched du'o/ /de skad du yang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa btsug pa'i phyir/ /g.ya' ri nags la sgrub pa mdzad/ /bsnyen phur nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phang / /rdo rje phyag g.yas blangs zhing bsgril/ /bsgril zhing tsan dan nags su 'phangs/ /me 'bar 'khrugs cing mtsho yang skem/ /gseb kyi mu stegs sa gang bsregs/ /yak+ṣa nag po rdul du rlog /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'bring phur pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng nas 'gul zhing 'phar ba gcig byung ba de/ bi ma mi tras blangs nas chu bo gaṅgā chu zheng che la gting ring ba de la btab pas/ skad cig de nyid la gtog gi bskams te gram pa skya shar gyis song nas/ sngar ltar rgyugs so/ /dgos pa ni chu de la gnas pa'i klu nor rgyas zhes bya ba mu stegs pa la 'tsho ba ster ba zhig yod pa de brlag pa'i phyir du'o/ /tha ma phur pa 'dzum zhing dgod pa zhig byung bas shī la mañdzus blangs te maṇ+ḍa la'i mkhar sgong brag zhes bya ba sra zhing brtan pa zhig yod pa de la btab pas/ skad cig de nyid la brag de thal ba'i rdul phran ltar gtor ro/ /de'i dgos pa ni brag de la mu stegs pa la mngon shes ston pa'i the'u rang gi pho brang yod pa de brlag pa'i ched du'o/

/yang slob dpon de gsum gyis rgya mtsho'i gling du bsgrubs pas/ steng gza' dang rgyu skar gyis thog ser phab/ 'og klu dang sa bdag gis rgya mtsho lud du bcug bar snang gi lhas dus ma yin pa'i char dang rlung nag btang bas/ slob dpon rnams thugs khros te/ phur pa gcig nam mkha' la bsgril bas gnam gyi gza' skar thams cad thang la lhung / phur pa gcig mtsho la btab pas mtsho bskams te/ klu phrug rnams tshos te ngu skad dir gyis song / phur pa gcig bar snang la btab pas lha dang gza' thams cad thang la lhung / der rang dbang med par srog gi snying po phul nas bran du khas blangs so/ /de ltar dngos grub brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ngo mtshar can dngos su ston pa mdzad pas/ mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag tu grags so/ /'o na rang gi mthu stobs nus pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ngo mtshar can de lta bu ston pa ni legs mod de/ 'on kyang sems can la gnod pa byas pas ltung bar mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ rgyu snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ thabs mngon spyod las kyis bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ zhe sdang gis bsad cing nga rgyal gyis mnan pa lta bu ma yin te/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe bar byed cing rnal 'byor pa byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa la sogs pa nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can ma rung pa de dag thabs mngon spyod kyi las kyis tshar ma bcad na/ gnas skabs bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe bar byed cing rnal 'byor pa chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod/ mthar kho rang yang las kyis rnam par smin pas rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye nges pa la/ kye ma/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can rgyu 'bras mi dge ba kho na la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying rje snyam du bzhag nas mi phan pas/

nges par mngon spyod las kyis tshar gcad par bya'o/ /snyam la bsgral ba'i las bya/ gang du bsgral na 'di nas pha rol tu bsgral/ pha rol nas myang 'das kyi sar bsgral lo/ /ji ltar bsgral na/ phung po rdo rje bltams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzas pa pos phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams brjod bral skye med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas la/ las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnams stong nyid ye shes kyi me dang mtshon chas bsregs cing sbyangs te/ rnam par shes pa skye med rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūm̐ yig tu byas te/ de nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sras su gnas spar ba'o/ /de ltar slob dpon rnam gsum dgongs pa yang de 'dra bzhin no/ /der ma zad rang re rjes 'jug rnams kyang bden pa'i las bya ba'i tshe dgongs pa 'di shes pa shin tu gal che'o/ /'dir smras pa/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad byung gdams pa'i tog /sdig can btsan thabs 'dren pa'i man ngag 'di/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa'i mthil/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa 'jam dbyangs kun bsod kyis/ /gsung rab dri ma med las bdag gis shes/ /shes pa de nyid slar yang gsal byas nas/ /rjes 'jug las can don du 'dir bris so/ /gang zhig rtogs pas rang nyid yongs bsgral nas/ /thugs rjes gzhan dag bsgral bar 'dod pa rnams/ /gdams ngag 'di nyid thugs kyi dkyil du zhog /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //de ltar slob dpon sprul pa'i sku rnam pa gsum gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan nyid kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ bod yul du zhal gzigs/ de'i tshe lha 'dre gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags te bran du bkol nas/ bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyi grub nas rgyal po'i dgongs pa mthar phyin mdzad/

gzhan yang bod yul mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling 'dir dam pa chos kyi sgron me chen po spar te spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bye brag du bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas las can rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ gsang sngags 'bras bu'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ der ma zad bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ lugs zung gi khrims bcas/ gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs/ bod yul sa rdo ri brag thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ ma 'ongs rjes 'jug gi don du gter kha mang du sbas/ mdor na mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas bod khams kyi sems can thams cad dus der bde ba la bkod pa ma zad/ deng sang rang re rnams kyis bar du'ang rgyal khrims dang bcas te bde ba'i rnam pa dang / chos khrims dang bcas te dam pa'i chos rnal ma nyams su blang rgyu yod pa 'di dag kyang a+yon nyid kyi sku drin kho na ma gtogs pa gzhan ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i bka' drin mtshungs med de nyid la zab rgyas gdams pa rgya mtsho ltar zad mi shes pa las/ thugs dam gyi nying khu gdams pa'i tog rdo rje phur pa'i dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams/ thugs sras kyi mchog tu gyur pa 'khon rigs lo tsā ba klu'i dbang po dang / de'i mched gcung ston rdo rje rin chen gnyis la gdams te/ zab rgyas chos kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ de nas 'khon chen klu dbang nyid kyis lha sa yer pa'i brag phug tu/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes nas grub rtags rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la bzhag pa ma zad sa brgyad non pa'i byang chub sems dpar gyur pa yin te/ de skad du yang / rgyal dbang pad+ma nyid kyis/ bī ka ma la shrī'i gtsug lag khang /

/sprang po nyi ma dngos grub tshe 'phos pa/ /'khon pa klu yi dbang po bya ba khyod/ /lo ni brgyad cu gya gnyis thub par 'gyur/ /sa brgyad non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'o na sa brgyad pa de la yon tan ji lta bu zhig mnga' zhe na/ spyir sa lam gyi dbang du byas na/ 'ji+ig rten las 'das pa'i sems thob pas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri ma dang bral ba gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ mchog tu gsal ba'i shes rab thob pas gsum pa 'od byed pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'od 'phros pas bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ bsam gtan dang 'gro don mdzad pa gnyis 'dzoms pas rang gi rgyud sbyang bar dka' ba 'dzad pas lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur pas drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ mtshan ma las ring du song bas bdun pa ring du song ba/ ting nge 'dzin de la mtshan ma gang gis kyang mi g.yo bas na sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ gdul bya rnams la chos ston pa'i blo gros chen po dang ldan pas dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ chos kyi char gyis gdul bya'i lo tog smin par byed pa yon tan gyi sprin chen po dang ldan pas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de yang sa bdun pa man chad ma dag sa bdun dang / brgyad pa yan chad la dag pa sa gsum zhes 'jog pa yin la/ spyir chos la bzod pa thob nas ngan song du mi ldog sa dang po thob nas 'khor ba la phyir mi ldog sa brgyad pa non nas theg dman du phyir mi ldog ste/ de phyin chad rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog go /ma dag pa ni 'jig rten pa'i dri ma rags pa rnams dag zin kyang shes sgrib kyi bag chags phra mo tsam ma dag pas ma dag pa/ cher dag pas dag pa'o/ /sa de dag la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan ni/ sngar ma mthong ba'i chos nyid lhag mthong gi ye shes mthong ba'i mthong lam sa dang po'o/

/de thob ma thag dbang po lnga gnas gyur te/ skad cig lag pa brkyangs bskums tsam gyi ring la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya bgrod/ sangs rgyas brgya las chos nyan/ 'ji+ig rten gyi khams brgya bskyod/ sems can brgya smin grol la bkod/ lus kyi sprul pa brgya bstan/ de dag re re yang 'khor brgya brgyas bskor ba la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs shing / sa gnyis pa la yon tan de dag stong du bsgyur/ gsum pa la khrir bsgyur ba la sogs pas bdun gyi bar du gong 'phel du bsgyur ro/ /sa brgyad pa la chos sku'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs/ dgu pa la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa smin/ bcu pa sprul pa'i sku'i zhing ma lus pa yongs su sbyong bar gsungs so/ /des na sa brgyad pa de'i yon tan ni/ dpe mtshon dang bral bas dpe med ces gsungs te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ brgyad pa dpe med ces pa ste/ /don la dpe dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sangs rgyas sa yi yon tan dbye ba rnams/ /rang bzo ma yin mdo rgyud lung nas gsungs/ /klu yi dbang pos sa brgyad thob pa'ang / /rang bzo ma yin rgyal dbang pad+mas gsungs/ /pad 'byung thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba/ /shes ldan kun gyis dgongs par mi 'gyur ram/ /de skad du yang nyid kyi gsol 'debs las/ sgrib pa kun bsal khams gsum sa ler mkhyen/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes bde chen mchog gi sku/ /de skad gsungs pa nges don tshad ma yin/ /tshul 'di log lta'i mun nag 'joms phyir dang / /dad ldan rnams la dwang ba bskyed phyir bris/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //gang ltar rtsa ba'i sa bcad gong du smos pa'i las can rgyal po nyid nas 'khon chen klu dbang gi bar du byon pa la/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa zhes gsungs shing / de gang zhe na/ slob dpon gyi brda tsam gyis bstan pa/

slob ma'i rigs pas mkhyen pa la rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa zhes 'jog pa yin/ de nas gcung ston rdo rje rin chen nas bzung / bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nges pa'i don du khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu nyid dang zhal cung zad tsam yang mi gnyis kyang / drang don gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'khon gyi rigs las ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs te/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i lhar bcas kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs mgon mtshungs zla ma mchis pa 'jigs med dpa' bo ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen nyid dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi khri skyong theg chen chos kyi char 'bebs ngag dbang bkra shis rin chen nyid de/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnam pa gnyis kyis dbur mdzad pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen du ma'i rigs kyi khyab bdag dbu skra mthon mthing mdzes pa'i cod pan gyi tshul du mdzad/ gzhan yang mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa 'bras mu tig tu bsgyur ba sogs/ ngo mtshar rmad byung gi mdzad pa du ma'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad zin nas/ mthar sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba dang / lha'i me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgra dngos su sgrogs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ gzugs kyi sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas brjod na/ shrī sa skya pa chen po 'jigs bral theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'jam dpal bde legs rgyal mtsho rin chen tshul khrims dbang phyug zhes mtshan snyan su zhig gi sgra 'dzin gyi bu gar lhung ba'i mod la dad pa'i ba spu dbang med du g.yo zhing / gsol ba btab na byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zegs ma snying la 'jug nges pa'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi bar du/

brgyud pa'i bla ma grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen sha stag tu byon pa rnams ni gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa yin la/ 'o na gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa zhes pa gang zhe na/ gdams ngag byin rlabs kyi zhal rlangs thul le ba/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas slob ma'i snyan du brgyud pa la gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa zhes 'jog pa yin la/ 'o na brgyud pa gsum po 'di la mchog dman gyi rnam pa ji lta bu zhig yod zhe na/ kun rdzob tu mchog dman gyi rnam pa tsam snang yang / don dam par chos kyi sku kun tu bzang po nyid kyi thugs las sprul zhing thugs kyi sras kho nar yin te/ sa los mdzad pa'i lam rim smon lam las/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams/ /ye nas lhun grub chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyi/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi zab chos rdo rje phur pa'i gdams ngag 'di ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos dri ma med pa thugs dam gyi nying khu gdams pa'i tog tu gsungs shing / 'di dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa nas da lta'i bar du rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub thob rgyun mi chad pa gshegs pa'i shul lam yin zhing / rjes 'jug rnams kyang lam 'di la zhugs na myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ 'di dbang gi chu bo ma nub gdams ngag gi sarga ma log brgyud pa mi'i bar du khyi ma shor ba sa steng na rtsod pa thams cad dang bral ba'i lam zab mo'o/ /lam 'di la brten nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ chu bo bzhi 'dus kyi sgo nas gdams pa nyams su len dgos shing / chu bo bzhi ni smin byed dbang gi chu bo skur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa/

dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭīka stong thun dang bcas pa/ gdams pa nyams len gyis chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa/ man ngag gnad kyi chu bo dris lan gegs sel dang bcas pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / de yang dang po smin byed dbang gi chu bo ni/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig tu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma yongs su smin par byed pa zhig la gsungs shing / de yang slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ dkyil chog lam rim rtsa 'grel las/ blo yang rgyud la goms pa dang / /ting 'dzin las su rung ba dang / /phyi nang sde snod thams cad la/ /som nyid med cing the tshom med/ /gsang ba sbas pa'i mchog rnams ni/ /snod dman rnams la mi spel zhing / /zab mo'i dbang chog thob pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rnyed na rab/ de ltar min yang yo+on tan cher mtho na/ /skyon cung zad tsam 'dres kyang bla mar rung bar gsungs te/ don dam bsnyen pa la/ rtsod ldan dbang gi bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'grogs/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig dang bral ba yod ma yin/ /gang gis yon tan lhag par yang ni legs spyod na/ /bu rnams kyi ni bsten par bya ba 'os pa nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'o na skyon dang 'dres na gong du smos pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams dang tshul mtshungs pa ma yin no zhe na/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ gdul bya ma dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun pa 'dul byed kyi mdzad pa ma dag pa'i tshul gyis 'dul ba'ang gsungs te/ phur pa rtsa rgyud ma las/ gdul bya ma dag 'gro rnams la/ /thugs rje thabs kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /rgyan dang bkod pas rab mdzes pa/ /'gro ba'i don du rab sprul nas/ /blo dang mthun pa'i ston pa yis/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /zhes pa ltar/ gdul bya ma dag pas bsam pa ma dag pa/

bsam pa ma dag pas bsam pa ltar mdzad pas mdzad pa ma dag pa'i tshul ltar snang yang don la skyon gyis gos pa med de/ de skad du yang / 'jig rten khams na bzhugs shing spyod spyod kyang / /chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la bstod/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /'on kyang dbang bskur ba thob cing cho ga ma 'khrul ba'i sgo nas snying rjes slob ma 'dzin pa zhig ni nges par dgos so/ /slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang rtsa 'grel las/ rkyen thub mi ldog dam tshig can/ /shes rab rnam gsum bsgom nas sbyangs/ /man ngag lung la rtag dga' zhing / /des shing 'jam la snyan par smra/ /thabs dang shes rab zab mo'i don/ /gnyis med don la mi skrag cing / /slob dpon dag la gus byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa ni rab/ de min yang dad mos dang shes rab che ba brtson 'grus che ba/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig srog ltar 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bla ma la gus pa zhig ni nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo ni/ dkyus su bshad pa rgyud kyi tshig don rnams 'grel pa dang ṭīk+ka stong thun la sogs pa nyan bshad kyi sgo nas gtan la phab ste khong du chud par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo ni/ 'khrul zad bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la rang bzo'i skyon spangs te mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ci rigs pa nyams su len pa'o/ /bzhi pa man ngag gnad kyi chu bo ni/ dogs pa'i gnas thams cad bla ma la dris te/ bla mas gegs ma lus pa bsal ba'o/ /de yang dang po smin byed dbang gi chu bo sngon du song nas/ gdams pa nyams su len dgos te/ dbang ma thob na 'bad pa ji ltar che yang / gsang sngags bsgom pa la 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ dper na bye ma btsir bas mar khu mi 'byung ba ltar/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/

dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bas mar med ltar/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gal te rgyud kya ིlung tsam thob pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ gsang sngags 'chad pa dang nyams su blangs pa sogs byas pas/ tshe 'dir tshe cung zad ring ba dang longs spyod cung zad 'phel ba dang / rkyen phra mo tsam bzlog pa la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub phran bu tsam thob pa srid kyang / shi ma thag sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar gsungs te/ yang thig rgyud las/ gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med pa 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /zhes so/ /des na 'bad pas nges par dbang zhu dgos te/ de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na dbang thob pa'i phan yon gang zhe na/ gang zag dbang po rab dbang bskur ba tsam gyis ma rig pa'i 'ching ba las grol bar gsungs te/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ des na gang zag dbang po rab/ /dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs/ /dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan la bsgom dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab dbang gis grol zhing ma grol ba rnams kyis tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas/ tshe 'di'am bar do'am tha na skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du nges par grol bar gsungs te/ tshul ji lta bus zhe na/ dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob phyin chad dam tshig ma nyams pa byin rlabs tshul bzhin du bsten na/ skye ba de nas skye ba ngan pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa skye ba bzang po dbang gi snod rung dbang thob pa'i skal ba can du byas nas/ skye ba bdun pa'i thog tu ma bsgoms pa 'grub par gsungs shing / de skad du yang / gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan pa/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun du ni/ /ma bsgoms pa la dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa'o/

/gal te sgom sgrub la brtson pa ma byas kyang rtsa ltung gis ma gos na skye ba bcu drug gi mthar 'grub pa'ang gsungs te/ rgyud las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang / gnas skabs su yang / rgyud 'gyur nyon mongs je chung 'gro: snying rje phan sems dag snang che: btsan pas 'jigs brgyad nye mi nus: lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol: grags pas rgyal khams yongs su khyab: mi yi bu rnams mngon par bstod: nus pas rdo rje'i brag kyang 'jig: 'jig rten bgegs la smos ci dgos: gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rgyang du bros: ma dang mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du: 'gro don ma byas rang shugs 'byung : mthun rkyen snang srid lha 'dres sbyor: 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal bya mi dgos: ces rgyal dbang pad+mas gsungs so/ /'dir smras pa/ gang zhig mtshan nyid ldan pas dbang bskur gyi/ /phan yon tshul 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /rtsod bral rgya bod mkhas pa kun gyis bzhed/ /de las zab dang myur ba'i lam med pas/ /su zhig srid pa'i sdug bsngal btson ra las/ /myur du thar nas kun mkhyen 'dod pa rnams/ /dbang la mi mos sems ldan min nam ci/ /bla ma gus bsten dbang la 'bad par rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //de ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i dbang bzhi legs par thob nas myur du dpal chen he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa rnams dgos pa las/ de la dang po grangs dang dus kyi bsnyen pa bya dgos pas/ de yang bsnyen song gi ming tsam la smon pa ni rang gis rang nyid bslu ba yin pas bsam pa de 'dra ring du spangs nas/ thog mar rgyud 'debs dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma dang /

mngon rtogs bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ gtor bsngos chen mo rnams mgrin par blangs te brjod pa la thogs pa med par byas/ de nas rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams dang / a+yon chen po'i gzung ma mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la gdams pa'i rdo rje don gsal rnam dag 'jam dbyangs kun bsod kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i rnam bshad 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed dang / gzhan yang phur pa'i gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i bla ma dam pa mtshan ldan rnams kyis mdzad pa'i legs bshad mtha' dag la lta nus shing / de dag gi dgongs pa ma 'khrul ba rtogs na rab dang / de tsam ma nus na kho bos byas pa'i bdud rtsi snying thig 'di nyid la nan tan du lta zhing / tshig don khong du chud par bya ba ni shin tu gal che'o/ /de nas lag tu blang ba'i rim pa bshad pa ni/ phur pa rgyud ltar bshad pa/ lung ltar bshad pa/ man ngag ltar bshad pa la sogs pa bshad lugs mang du yod kyang / 'dir rgyud kyi chings drug gam khog don drug la man ngag gis brgyan te bshad par bya ste/ de yang khog don drug ni phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba dang / dkyil 'khor gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas te don gyi khog phub pa dang / khams gsum nas srog la dbang bskur zhing srog ye shes sems dpa' srog la dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blang ba dang / gab pa'i sngags drug dang tshe lung khrus lung gi kha bskangs te gdab pa'i las bya ba dang / mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi mjug bsdu ba ste drug go /de drug gi dang po phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ rdzas phun sum tshogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o/ /de rnams dang ldan na las gang 'dod 'grub par gsungs te/

kī la ya me lce phreng ba'i rgyud las/ gnas dang bdag nyid 'khor rdzas dus/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan na/ /las rnams gang 'dod 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i gzhung ldan gyi gnas dang / 'dre srin gdug pa can rgyu ba la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i gnas ma yin pa sngar rnam dkar gyi las brtsams tshad gegs med mthar phyin grub pa bkra shis pa'i gnas dang / bya rgod phung po'i ri/ rdo rje gdan la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyis zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya la sogs pa bla ma gong ma grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas la sogs pa/ byin can gyi gnas dang / brag ri dang ljon shing chu bo yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa 'dzoms pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas te/ de bzhi ni gnas kyi dam par gsungs te/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ gnas kyi dam pa bstan pa la/ /gzhung ldan bkra shis byin chen dang / /nyams dga' ba yi gnas dang bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /bye brag rdo rje phur pa'i gzhung ldan gyi gnas ni/ gnam 'khor lo 'dra zhing sa pad+ma 'dra ba/ rgyab na brag rdo rje gzhon nu 'gying ba 'dra ba/ shar lho na zangs kyi wa mo thur du rgyug pa 'dra ba/ lho nub na bsen mo bka' gnos pa 'dra ba/ nub byang na las kyi ging dmag la chas pa 'dra ba/ byang shar na re ma ti khrag zor 'phen pa 'dra ba/ shar gyi ri gzhol ba/ lho skyob pa/ nub mtho ba/ byang ma dud pa/ lung pa dbyibs legs pa/ sgrub khang dang chu shing 'dzom pa/ gcan gzan dang mi rgod kyi nyam nga med pa/ mi dang mi min rgyu srang nyung ba la sogs pa yid kyi gnas kyi dam par gsungs te/ gsang rgyud las/ steng 'og bar snang brtag pa ni/ /'khor lo gnam la pad+ma sa/ /phyogs mtshams kun tu rdo rje'i brag /gzhung ldan bkra shis dam pa'o/

/dbyibs legs lung pa legs pa dang / /sgrub khang shing chu 'tshams pa dang / /gcan gzan mi rgod nyam nga med/ /mi dang mi min rgyu srang nyung / /'di ni yid 'ong dam pa ste/ /de ni dwang du blang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /yang drag po sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ dur khrod shing gcig rgya gram lam/ /gcan gzan mang po rgyu srang na/ /gnam ni gri 'dra sa gru gsum/ /logs la tsher ma can gyi ri/ /gcan gzan gdug pa sna tshogs rgyu/ /rtsa ni ma rigs sna tshogs 'du/ /yod pa mkhas pas brtags te btsal/ /de ni drag po'i gnas su bshad/ /zhes gsungs pas don go sla bas 'dir ma bkrol lo/ /gnas de dag gi dgos pa ni bar chad med cing ting nge 'dzin 'phel grub rtags nye ba la sogs pa yon tan mang du gsungs so/ /gal te de lta bu'i gnas ma rnyed na/ rang chos byed pa la bar chad med pa/ mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba la sogs pa'i phyogs de nyams dga' ba'i gnas yin pas cung zad yon tan dman yang 'gal ba'i skyon med do/ /gnyis pa bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa ni/ skyon spangs pa dang / yon tan ldan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sdig la mi 'dzem pa/ snying rje med pa/ chos la mi dad pa/ shes rab chung ba/ slob dpon med pa gsang sngags rang nyid kyis len pa rnam rtog che zhing chang la sogs pa'i zas bag med du spyod pa/ sgrub pa la ma zhugs pa'i sngon nas gzhug pa la skyo ba/ zhugs nas sun pa byed pa/ ha cang bkres skom dang ldan pas bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub ste/ me lce phreng ba'i rgyud las/ sdig pa la ni mi 'dzem dang / /snying rje'i lam dang bral ba yis/ /btsal kyang 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /dad pa chung zhing shes pa dman/ /slob dpon med pa dpe brten dang / /khu smig che dang 'tsho rkyen mang / /skyo rkyen sun rkyen bsrul lud kyis/ /las 'di brtsams kyang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa yon tan dang ldan pa ni/

lta ba dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa rtogs pa/ spyod pa rlabs chen thabs kyis zin pa/ 'phrin las thogs pa med pa snying rjes sems can gyi don spyod pa/ dam tshig nyon mongs pa ye shes su rtogs pa/ sgrub pa'i rgyal po thabs shes gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa/ thos pa'i shes rab/ bsam pa'i shes rab/ bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / nang kri ya/ u pa/ yo ga ste/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum nang gi phyi theg pa gsum dang / nang gi nang mahā yo ga a nu yo ga a ti yo ga ste/ thabs shes rab gnyis med kyi rgyud de theg dgu'i don la mkhas pa/ lta spyod ma 'khrul ba sngags kyi spyod pa shes pa ni/ bdag nyid yang dag don gyi rnal 'byor pa yin te/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ yang dag don gyi rnal 'byor ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i gdengs ldan 'gyur/ /spyod pa rlabs chen thabs su spyod/ /'phrin las thogs med snying rje spyod/ /dam tshig nyon mongs dug lnga sgrol/ /sgrub pa gnyis med rgyal po 'grub/ /shes rab rnam gsum yongs su 'dzin/ /phyi nang bka' brgyud don la mkhas/ /sngags kyi spyad pa'i spyod pa shes/ /zhes so/ /de yang mdo rgyud lung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa la thos bsam sgom gsum nan du byas na/ rang la skyon dang 'dres pa bsal ba dang / yon tan ma tshang ba rnams tshang du 'ong ngo / /gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa spangs pa dang / ldan pa btsal ba gnyis las/ dang po spyir dkon mchog la mi dad pa dang bye brag bla ma la mi gus pa/ rkun ma dang brdzun la mkhas pa/ smra mkhas kyang thabs sdug pas don mi 'grub/ snying chung bas bzod med spro thung ba la sogs rnams spang dgos pa gsungs te/ rgyud las/ dad med bla ma la mi gus/ /byi la nor chud bslu brid mkhas/ /smra mkhas thabs sdug zol ma la/

/snying sgor chung yang bsten mi bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal ba ni/ slob ma gtsang sbra dang che ba/ 'jigs med dpa' brtul che ba/ sgrub pa po la dad cing sems ngang rgyud ring ba/ sgrub rdzas chud mi za bar byed cing / yun ring 'grogs kyang ngal sdug bzod nus pa/ mgar ba dang bshan pa la sogs pa ma yin pa rigs btsun rgyud bzang ba ni sgrub pa'i g.yog tu gsungs te/ gsang rgyud las/ slob ma gtsang sbra dpa' brtul che/ /dad ldan ngang rgyud ring ba dang / /dpa' 'dzangs 'grogs kyang skyo dub med/ /rigs btsun rgyud bzang sgrub pa'i g.yog /ces gsungs pa'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyas pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / mnan sreg 'phang gsum la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams ni 'dir ma bris pas gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'dir bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su dgos pa'i yo byad bdud rtsi 'od can nas 'di ltar gsungs te/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang / khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i sku lugs ma'am bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>gtor ma la khrag byug rgyu gsungs kyang deng sang phyag len la mi mdzad/ gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yon du ban+dha lcang lo can gyi nang du rak+ta <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>khrag ma 'byor na chang la sha dmar po btab pa/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa tshad ldan gyi nang du sman phud/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod phreng bshams/ zhes gsungs shing / der mi gsal ba rnams 'dir brjod na/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs bshams pa'i g.yon du/

gur lha bcu gsum gyi bris thang yang bshams/ dpal gtor gyi g.yon du dam rdzas lnga'am/ gsum mam/ gcig gang rigs bshams/ de'i g.yon du bdud rgyal phur srung gnyis la dmar gtor re/ gzhi bdag gtor ma'i gong du bzhag bskang ba bya na bskang gtor rnams phyag len ltar byas la/ stegs cung dma' ba la bzhag de rnams kyi mdun du gong du brjod pa'i nyer spyod rnams bshams/ de rnams kyang thal rdul dang byi ba la sogs pa'i gnod pa mi 'byung pa'i phyir/ gtor kha btsan pa gtsang mar byas pa'i nang du bzhugs/ gtor rdzas sha dmar bdud rtsi ril bu sbrang bu ram/ chang 'o ma phyogs gcig tu sbyar ba'i zil ma dang / mar gsar gyi khu ba 'debs/ sman gyi rdzas rgyas par bshad pa yod de bdud rtsi ril bu chang bzang po la btab na chog par bsam/ de dag kyang rgyu bzang ba/ 'byor ba che ba dbyibs legs pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pa bya dgos te/ dgos pa khyad par can yod do/ /gzhan yang sgrub khang phyag bdar byas la rnam rgyan la sogs pas mdzes par byas te yid du 'ong bar byas/ rang gi stan nang 'tshang can legs par bshams pa'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje shing ngam rdo srab la bris pa bzhag de'i steng ku sha che ba rtse mo sngas phyogs su bstan pa 'jug sngas 'og tu chung ba rtse mdun phyogs la bstan te bzhag mdun du lcog rtse yangs pa'i khar g.yas nas rim bzhin/ nas 'dzin ḍā ma ru rdor dril/ nang mchod rnams bshams/ khyad par bsnyen phur mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsham dgos te/ gsang rgyud las/ lha grangs tshang ba'i phur pa dang / /yungs kar gu gul rak+ta rnams/ /sgrub pa rtsa ba'i yo byad do/ /zhes so/ /de yang 'dir cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ kun rdzob kyi phur pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / don dam gyi phur pa ni bzhi yod de/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dang bzhi'o/

/'o na de dag gi las gang zhe na/ rgyud las/ 'debs pa'i phyir na phur pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas las 'debs pa/ des na 'debs par byed pa'i gang zag yang bzhi ste/ phur pa man ngag gtsug lag gi rgyud las/ phur pa bzhi'i dgongs pa yis/ /gang zag rnam bzhi mthar dbyung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag rnam pa bzhi ni/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don rtogs pa ni nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag sems can gyi don las mi g.yo ba brtan pa ni ri bo lta bu'i gang zag chags pa'i sems dang ldan pa bya ka lan ka lta bu'i gang zag rgyu bzang la gtum pa tsan dan gyi sdong po lta bu'i gang zag dang bzhi/ 'o na gang zag bzhi po des phur pa bzhi po de yul gang la 'debs zhe na/ nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yul chos kyi dbyings la 'debs/ ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis tshad med snying rje'i phur pa khams gsum sems can la 'debs/ bya ka lan ka lta bu'i gang zag gis gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la 'debs/ tsan dan sdong po lta bu'i gang zag gis mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dgra dang gegs la 'debs/ de ltar du btabs pas thebs pa'i rtags bzhi ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa stong nyid du rtogs pa dang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen por spyod kyang snying rje dang snying rje'i yul gnyis ka rang bzhin med par shes pa dang / bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi ba dang bzhi'o/ /ma thebs pa'i skyon bzhi ni/ chos kyi dbyings la ma thebs na chad pa'i skyon dang / khams gsum sems can la ma thebs na rtag pa'i skyon dang / yum gyi mkha' la ma thebs na theg dman gyi lam la gol ba'i skyon dang / dgra dang bgegs la ma thebs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi tshugs pa'i skyon dang bzhi'o/ /'o na phur pa de dag thebs pa'i 'bras bu gang zhe na/

chos kyi sku dang / sprul pa'i sku dang / logs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag sgrub pa dang bzhi 'byung ste/ dang po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi sku thob pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i dbyings/ /bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med pa/ /spros las 'das pa chos kyi sku/ /rtogs pas rnal 'byor mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa yang / rtsa rgyud las/ dpal ldan bde ba chen po'i sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam las 'das/ /sa bcu'i mgon po chen po rnams/ /dag pa'i rgyud la ston par snang / /zhes gsungs so/ /sprul pa'i sku thob pa la yang zhi drag gnyis las/ dang po gdul bya zhi bas 'dul ba la/ yang rtsa rgyud las/ gdul bya ma dag 'gro rnams la/ /thugs rje'i thabs kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /rgyan dang bkod pa rab mdzes pa/ /'gro ba'i don du rab sprul nas/ /blo dang mthun pa'i ston pa yis/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa drag pos 'dul ba la/ yang rtsa rgyud las/ rnam dag chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gdul dka'i 'gro ba ma lus thams cad la/ /ye shes khro bo rol pa'i tshogs su snang / /zhal gyi khro gnyer 'bar ba'i sdang mig gzigs/ /'gro ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs rab tu 'chang / /stag gi sham thabs la sogs rab 'jigs rgyan/ /'phrin las mdzad pa drag pos tshar bcad nas/ /bla med lam la bkod pa'i khro bor sprul/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag bsgrub pa ni/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ gang zhig mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /gsang ba thugs kyi dngos grub dang /

/dgongs pa thams cad nges par 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa yi/ /'gro ba'i don la 'phrin las bzhi/ /'di ltar thogs par mi spyod pas/ /dngos grub bar gcod la sogs pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /shin tu sgrub pa nga yi bstan/ /'di sgrub pa yi rnal 'byor mchog /bsod nams tshogs kun rab tu rdzogs/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis/ /rtag par byin gyis rlob byed pa/ /ci ltar bsam pa bzhin du 'grub/ /gnod byed nye bar zhi ba yis/ /'du ba'i nad kun 'joms pa dang / /tshe yi rig 'dzin rab tu thob/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs 'grub pas/ /gnod byed nye bar zhi ba yi/ /rang byung ye shes rtogs par 'gyur/ /'khor dang longs spyod kun rgyas shing / /bkra shis dpal ni yongs rdzogs byed/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar gnas skabs lam gyi dus na'ang / 'phrin las yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pas na/ myur du 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la 'di las zab pa'i lam med par nges shes dag go /'o na phur pa zhes pa'i ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba rnams gang zhe na/ dang po ngo bo la nges don dang drang don gnyis las/ dang po ni rten g.yo kun la khyab pa'i srid zhi'i bdag nyid rang gzhan brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ chos kyi dbyings gzhan du mi 'gyur ba rang gi rig pa 'od gsal bde ba chen po chos kyi sku nyid yin te/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ phur pa'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes ste/ /de yi yul ni spros med chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni nges don chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ drang don gzugs kyi sku longs spyod rdzogs pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su bzhengs shing / tha ma sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa snang ste/ yang myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ phur pa'i ngo bo rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la/ /tha ma sprul pa yang sprul tshogs dang bcas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa phur pa'i nges tshig ni/

skye med stong pa dang 'gag med gsal ba gnyis su med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang / phur zhes pa thabs dang / pa zhes pa shes rab/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i sku yin te/ de nyid phur pa'i nges tshig go /de yang rgyud las/ phur ni skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ /pa ni 'gag pa med pa'i don/ /gnyis su med pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /phur ni thabs kyi rgyal po'i don/ /pa ni shes rab dag pa'i don/ /gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa dbye ba ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar kun rdzob kyi phur pa la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / don dam gyi phur pa bzhir bshad pa de'o/ /gang ltar don dam pa'i phur pa ni byang chub kyi sems yin zhing / de rtogs na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa yin te/ rgyud las/ don gyi phur pa byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems kyi phur pa ni/ /snang srid phur pa'i rgyu ru grags/ /'byung ba'i rgyu yang sems yin te/ /sems las ma byung chos gzhan med/ /byang chub sems kyi phur pa yis/ /'khor ba ngan song mya ngan zlos/ /sdug bsngal byang chub mya ngan zlos/ /sems can sangs rgyas mya ngan zlos/ /yul ni dbyings su mya ngan zlos/ /nam mkha'i gtun khung dkyil 'khor du/ /rigs drug sems can mya ngan zlos/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /des na don dam byang chub sems kyi phur pa de rtogs par byed pa la/ kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa la brten dgos shing / de la zhi rgyas dbang drag tu yod pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ gzhung las/ lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa/ /drag po gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar drag po'i phur pa dgos pa las/ de'i rgyu ni/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams ni/ /drag po las kyi phur pa'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /rgyu de dag las byas pa'i phur pa'i tshad ni/

khams bco brgyad la gdab pa'i phyir sor bco brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis la gdab pa'i phyir sor bcu gnyis/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad la gdab pa'i phyir sor brgyad/ dbang po drug la gdab pa'i phyir sor drug 'byung ba bzhi la gdab pa'i phyir sor bzhi/ dus gsum la gdab pa'i phyir sor gsum la sogs pa gsungs te/ myang 'das las/ sor ni bco brgyad bcu gnyis dang / /zhes dang / sor bzhi pa dang sor drug dang / /brgyad dang bcu gnyis yang dag bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /rgyu shing la byed tshe/ gsang rgyud las/ rtse mo phyogs ni ma nor bar/ /rtse mo la ni rgya mdud bya/ /myu gu'i ngos su rtse mo bya/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /dbyibs ni/ myang 'das las/ rgya mdud gnyis dang zur brgyad dang / /zur gsum pa ru rab tu gzhog /rtse mo chu srin kha nas 'byung / /rtsa ba'i phyogs su rgya mdud bya/ /rtse mo 'phrin las rigs su gzhog /kha dog so so'i rigs dang bstan/ /zhes gsungs pas go sla'o/ /'on kyang sor bcu gnyis brgyad drug gang rigs la mgo bo rgya mdud sked pa shing gis zur brgyad de'i 'og tu 'og gi rgya mdud/ de'i 'og chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i rtse mo zur gsum du byas na chog par bsam/ de lta bu'i phur pa de la/ byug bdug gdab gsum phur pa'i las skal yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thugs rjes sems can gyi don la chags pa bskyed pa'i phyir rak+ta'i byug pa/ don mdzad pa la gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir gu gul gyis bdug pa/ don mdzad pa la mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir yungs kar gyis gdab pa ste rdzas de gsum yang bshams/ bsdu na de gsum gcig tu bsres la thum byas pa dang / ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i dar sna lnga brtsegs pa'i cod paṇa 'dod yon ma spang pa dag rtags phur dang bcas pa phur pa'i sker btags la/ phur gdan gru gsum gyi steng du bzhugs shing / gong du bshad pa'i lcog tse'i khar gang 'os su bzhag

gzhan yang sgrub pa'i tshe 'dangs nges pa'i 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad dang / rang la nad gzhi yod na de la dgos pa'i sman dang / mdor na rdzas dang yo byad rnams gzhan nas rkus pa dang 'phrog pa la sogs pa ma dag pa'i yo byad ma yin pa chos dang mthun pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa yang bsdu bar bya'o/ /lnga pa dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ zla 'phan zla ba mar ngo la/ /drag po mngon par spyod pa'i dus/ /ra ba bzhi yi yar ngo yi/ /shis par gyur pa'i bzang po la/ /zhi ba rgyas pa sgrub pa'i dus/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bzang po yi/ /tshes grangs bzang po gang yang rung / /slob ma dbang rnams bskur ba'i dus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar go sla bas shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis ni don gyi khog phub kyi nang tshan phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga yis sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba'i tshul 'bring 'dus tsam bstan zin to/ /de nas 'di'i khog don drug tu ma gsungs kyang 'khrul med dam pa'i phyag len ltar bshad na/ thog mar nges par sgrub par zhugs nyin snga bar langs la sgrub khang gi phyi nang bar gsum du yod na mtshams tho mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len nam shog dpe nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhi sgo re re'i g.yas g.yon gang 'os su <!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>shog bu la bris nas sbyar kyang rung 'bri ba'o/ (oṃ a hūm̐/) /sgo gcig las med na gcig bris pas chog go /bsdu na gcig phyi sgor sbyar bas rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang de las brgal nas mthar ma phyin par phyir mi 'gro'o/ /mtshams bzhugs dus mar ngo la bzhugs nas 'thon dus yar ngo la 'thon pa'i phyag srol 'dug kyang rgyud dang mthun pa gal che bar bsam mo/ /gang ltar snga dro bsang rgyas bsdus gang shes re mdzad/ de nas cha gsum gyi gtor ma tshar re mdzad pas/ rang gi mi shes pa dang / mi khom pa la sogs byung tshe gzhan la bcol kyang chog go

/de nas nyi ma phyed yol ba dang / sgrub g.yog pas spos phor gu gul dang nas 'dzin khyer/ rang nyid zhwa gzan gyon zhing rdo dril thog nas phyi sgor phyin la/ tho la gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar ram nas kyis brab dril bu drag tu brdung zhing yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas kī la ya drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad/ de nas gu gul yungs dkar rnams bzhag la ngag tu 'di skad brjod do/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' ba brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bdag gis btsugs pa'i tho 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ phyi'i dgra bgegs nang du ma btang / nang gi dngos grub phyir ma g.yel ba bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig ces brjod la dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor la ngag tu/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ gang mang brjod/ de ltar brtan bzhugs tshar gsum byas rjes tshig bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor la/ mtshungs med bla maྎ skye med chos skuྎ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang giྎ

gang sngonྎ brtson pa'i go bgosྎ mi 'gyur lhun poྎ nad rigs bzhi brgyaྎ bgegs rigs stong phragྎ nyin mo bde legs sogs sho lo ka gcig 'di'i mjug tu 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag las rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod tshe dril bu gsil zhing me tog gi char phab/ de nas tho de'i steng du rang gi rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod de phyir mig mi lta ba nang du log la sgo gcad do/ /de nas tho gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs de bzhin byas la rang nyid sgrub khang du zhugs la gdan la 'dug ste/ dbugs thang chad pa ma sos kyi bar du cung zad cig ngal gsos/ de nas rgyud las/ phun sum tshogs pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /byams dang snying rje sngon btang nas/ /srid pa phur bu bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ kyai ma/ bdag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sdug bsngal gting dpag dka' zhing skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong rab tu 'khrug pa'i srid pa'i mtsho chen 'di la rtag tu 'khor ba ni nyam re thag 'khor ba ni skyon dang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das pa yin te/ mdo sde dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba ni khab kyi rtse mo dang 'dra/ der gnas pa la bde ba ga la yod/ de yang sems can dmyal ba pa rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod brlag med pa zhig yod de/ da lta 'jig rten 'di na rang gi lus la nyin re bzhin mdung thung sum brgya re btab ste lus bar mtshams med pa 'big zhing bcad de khrag gi rgyun chil chil du 'bab par byed pa ni shin tu sdug bsngal che ba yin mod te/

'on kyang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu chung ba zhig gi sdug bsngal stong du gzhal ba'i cha tsam yang ma yin te/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i spring yig las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu'ang / /'ol yang mi bgyid char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na de bas kyang che ba'i sdug bsngal ji lta bu zhig yod zhe na/ dmyal ba la rigs mang du yod kyang 'dir skabs su bab pa tsha ba pa'i sdug bsngal cung zad cig bshad na/ tsha ba pa ni lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me 'bar ba'i steng du sems can de gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams kyis bzung ste/ lcags sregs kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas 'og sgo nas spyi bo'i bar du thal byung phug pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad me yis gang bas glo snying la sogs pa'i nang khrol rnams kyang lcags sregs kyi steng du mchil ma btab pa ltar phag sgra dang sul sgra 'byin cing khol/ ba spu'i bu ga nas du ba dang kha mig la sogs pa'i dbang po'i sgo rnams me dmar chil chil du 'bar ba'o/ /de bas kyang rab tu tsha ba pa dang mnar med la sogs pa sdug bsngal ches che bas skad cig kyang bzod nus med pa'o/ /'o na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal thog tu bab na/ srog dang bral nas myur du 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ de yang 'chi ba ma yin te/ de ltar sdug bsngal mi bzad pa lo grangs bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du myong yang / ji srid rang gi las ngan de ma zad bar de srid de nyid srog dang bral ba ma yin/ yang bshes spring las/ de ltar sdug bsngal mi bzad shin tu lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge zad par ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rang thog tu mi 'bab pa'i gdeng ni med/

bab pa'i rgyu ni khong khro la sogs pa'i mi dge ba ni nyin zhag re'i bar du'ang grangs med pa spyad nas yod do/ /des na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rnams rna bas thos pas snying 'dar na thog tu bab na bsran thabs ga la yod/ 'o na de dag la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las rang nyid gcig pu thar bas chog gam snyam na/ de ni ma yin te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung mgur las/ khams gsum gyi sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde ba 'dod pa the le le/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum gyi sems can pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med de/ rang nyid 'khor ba 'di la 'khyams 'khyams nas/ lus srog sbyin pa'i ma la grangs med de/ dper na sa chen po 'dis rgya shug gis tshig gu tsam gyis ril bur bgrangs kyang ma yi grangs sa yis mi lang ba gsungs te/ yang bshes spring las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bu bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na pha mar ma gyur pa'i sems can med/ pha ma yang lan gcig ma yin pa yang yang du byas pa yin te/ sems can gcig gi rgyud kyis bdag gi ma byas pa'i nu zho 'thungs pa'ang phyogs gcig tu bsags na rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu bas kyang lhag par gsung ste/ de skad du yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ gang gis bdag gi ma byas nas/ /nu zho 'thungs ba gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /pha ma nam byed rim bzhin gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs phan dpag tu med pa btags pa'i drin chen sha stag yin te/ da lan bdag la lus rten 'byin pa'i ma 'di'i drin yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bdag dang po mngal du zhugs pa nas phyir ma btsas kyi bar du'ang bdag la gnod pa'i kha zas dang spyod lam spang / phan pa'i kha zas dang spyod lam bsten nas bdag ma shi ba byas/

btsas nas kyang lus kyis kha lag mi 'phrod/ ngag gis brda don mi gsal/ sems kyis blang dor mi shes pa bdag 'bu 'dra bar gnas pa'i tshe/ drin chen gyi ma 'dis lus drod kyis bskyangs/ mngar ba'i nu zho sbyin/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ bdag gis mi gtsang ba'i tshogs rnams ma la btab kyang sun pa med cing byi dor byas/ mthun pa'i kha zas rnams snyod cing byin/ me chu g.yang gsum la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyabs/ a pha zer mi shes pa la a pha gyis/ a ma zer mi shes pa la a ma gyis dang zhes pa la sogs pa dngos po'i blang dor thams cad bstan/ bdag nang du lus na phyi ru sdug bsngal/ phyi ru lus na nang du sdug bsngal/ mdor na ma rang gi snying gi tshal pa phyir lhung ba ltar/ skad cig kyang 'bral mi phod pa dang / bdag mi yi gral ma tshud dogs byed/ tshud kyang ngo ma mnyam gyi dogs/ mnyam yang tshe mi gnas bsam pa'i dogs pa ma rang gis ngal brgyas bsgrubs shing chags pa'i zas nor/ yar dkon mchog la mchod ma nus/ mar slong ba la sbyin ma nus/ ma rang gi za gon ma nus pa'i longs spyod thams cad bdag la dus gcig tu sbyin pa la phangs pa dang chags sems med pa ma rang gi don grub pa yin snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i drin chen gyi ma/ bdag chos dang mjal ba yang ma 'di'i sku drin kho na yin/ der ma zad sangs rgyas thob na'ang rtsa ba ma'i drin yin no/ /de dang 'dra ba sems can gzhan rnams kyang ma ru ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ gyur tshe dus nye ring ma gtogs pa drin de 'dras bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ des na drin chen rnams sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag nas/ bdag gcig pu bde ba 'dod pa don re chung / sems can pha ma yin pa mi shes shing / pha ma drin chen yin par mi shes na/ 'jig rten na bdag las blun pa su zhig yod/ shes nas drin chen rnams yal bar dor na bdag las ngo tsha med pa dang khrel bor ba 'jig rten gyi khams na med pas/

nges par phan lan du phan gdags pa gcig dang drin lan du drin 'jal ba zhig nges par bya dgos pas/ 'di rnams da lta lus sems bde ba dang bral sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho nar longs spyod pa nyam re thag 'di rnams lus ngag yid gsum bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam du byams pa nan tan du bsgom/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu longs spyod pa dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje nan tan du bsgom/ pha ma sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba la longs spyod/ bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba la ni rgyab phyogs te blang dor phyin ci log tu spyod pa ste/ kyai ma/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje snyam du yun ring du bsgom/ da 'di rnams la gang gis phan na 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la bkod na phan par 'dug ste/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la ni med/ bdag las lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs la'ang med/ de las lhag pa 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sogs la'ang med/ 'o na su la yod na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod do/ /des chos thun re gsungs pa dang / 'od zer spro bsdu skad cig ma re res kyang sems can bye ba khrag khrig bsgral nus so/ /des na da lan bdag gis ci nas kyang pha ma sems can gyi don du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bla na med pa'i go 'phang rin po che gdan thog 'di'am tshe rabs 'di'am bar do'am tha na'ang skye ba phyi ma tshun chad du nges par thob par bya snyam du bsgom/

de thob par byed pa la dam pa'i chos rnal ma nyams su len dgos shing / de ma gtogs pa thabs gzhan gcig kyang med/ chos sgrub pa'i skal pa ni dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus 'di ma gtogs pa gzhan la med/ dal 'byor gyi lus 'di ni rnyed par dka' ba yon tan ldan pa 'jig par sla ba yin te/ de yang rnyed par dka' ba ni/ grangs kyi sgo nas snyed par dka' ba yang / mdo las/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam mo/ /yi dwags ni kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam mo/ /dud 'gro ni chang gi sbang ma tsam mo/ /mtho ris ni sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa bar do'i sems can ni grangs dang tshad bzung du med de/ dper na dbyar gyi tshe sems can gcig shi ba'i ro zhag bdun du bzhag na/ de'i nang thams cad 'bu yis gang bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi la sogs pa brgya stong gi bar du bzhag pa'am/ mdor na ji snyed gcig bzhag pa de snyed de'i nang 'bus gang bar 'gyur bas/ skye sa'i rten 'brel ma 'grigs pa ma gtogs skye rgyu'i sems can la zad pa med do/ /des na de 'dra'i nang nas mi lus thob pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar dkon pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dpe yi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba dang / ngo bo yis sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba rnams gzhan nas shes par byas la bsgom/ brgya la thob na de'i yon tan ni bsam gyi mi khyab ste/ rang gis rang ma bslus na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang myur du 'byin par nus so/ /de skad du yang / 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ bdag lta rigs kyi mir skyes la/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes pas/ /byang chub spyod pa ma btang na/ /bdag gis byang chub cis mi thob/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams na gang dkon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu dkon/

de la yon tan brgyad de/ sems can gyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang / de yang gsol ba ma btab na mi 'byung ba dang / btab na 'byung ba dang / dus su 'byung ba dang / ji ltar 'tshams par 'byung ba dang / zad mi shes par 'byung ba dang / rtog pa med par 'byung ba dang / phyis lan la re ba med pa'o/ /de ltar yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub 'byin par mi nus so/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob na snang ba thams cad nor bu grub pa'ang yin te/ tha na ljags mchil btab pa'ang yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur pa'i lo rgyus yod do/ /des na de lta bu'i bla na med pa byang chub de mi'i lus rten la thob par nus pas yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan cher lhag par gsungs te/ de skad du yang / slob spring las/ gang zhig thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar byed cing / /byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang sgrub byed pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan cher lhag pa'i/ /mi nyid thob nas su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /des na rin thang bral ba'i mi lus rin po che thob nas 'bras bu dge ba'i chos ma bsgrubs par shi ba rnams ni dal 'byor stong log tu song ba yin te/ dper na bkren cing 'phongs pa'i byis pa mang po'i pha rgan zhig yid bzhin nor bu 'dod de dka' ba dang ngal dub khyad du bsad cing lam ring por zhugs nas/ bdag gir med pa'i yid bzhin nor bu mang du spungs pa'i gling der phyin/ slar nor bu'i rdul tsam yang ma gos pa sgren mo lag pa stong par rang gi khyim du log na/ dka' ba khyad bsad lam ring zhugs nas nor bu'i gling du phyin pa don med cing / rang dang rang gi byis pa'i tshogs rnams kyang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las bskyabs ma nus shing dbul 'phong gi gnas su bzhag cing gnas pa ni/ shin tu blun pa bas kyang ches blun zhing shin tu nyam thag pa bas kyang ches nyam thag pa bzhin du sngon bsags 'bad pa chen po'i dge ba'i las kyis dkar po dge ba'i chos la bdag gir med pa'i dal 'byor gyi gling 'dir phyin nas mi lus thob/

thob nas chos ma bsgrubs par shi ba na rang dang pha ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bskyabs ma nus shing / srid pa'i btson ra'i nang du gzhan bzhag cing rang yang gnas pa ni de bas kyang blun pas de las blun pa 'jig rten gyi khams na med do/ /des na dal 'byor gyi lus thob pa'i snying po dam pa'i chos sgrub dgos shing / de yang da lta nyid nas brtson pa ma byas na lus 'di ni mi rtag cing myur du 'jig pa'i chos can yin te/ 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa'i mdo las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog dang ni/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pas spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing / khyad par 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe srog ni glog dang ri gzar gyi 'bab chu dang gar mkhan gyi rnam 'gyur ltar myur du 'jig pa'i chos can yin zhing / nam 'chi nges pa'ang med de zla ba phyi ma'i tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang ba dang / 'jig rten phyi ma'i gshin rje'i grong khyer gnyis sngon du su mthong cha nges pa med pas zhag bcu 'dug pa'i tshis la mi 'bad par phyi ma'i chos la 'bad dgos te/ tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang yong gtol med pas/ /sang gi tshi la mi 'bad pa/ /phyi ma'i tshi la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /des na bdag da lta nyid nas chos la 'bad par rigs/ chos kyi nang nas kyang zab pa las ches shin tu zab pa dang po gsungs pa nas tha ma da lta'i bar du rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub thob rgyun mi chad par byon pa'i/ rdo rje phur pa'i gdams ngag 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs pa'i shul lam yin zhing / bdag 'di dang mjal ba ni shin tu skal pa bzang ba 'di 'grub na sangs rgyas thams cad gcig char du 'grub pa yin/

ji skad du/ skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i chos 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /des na bdag gis pha ma sems can mi bzad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir zhing skyabs dang mgon med pa 'di rnams kyis don du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde gshegs kun 'dus dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang rin po che tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya'o/ /de bas na sngon dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa zhal gyi bzhes pa'i rig 'dzin rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs shing myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig snyam la sems yun ring du gtad/ de nas rnam rtog gzhan du ma yengs pa skad gsang la sgra dag pa dang bcas te brgyud 'debs dpal ldan brten g.yo ma yongs rdzogs 'don/ de nas lha'i nga rgyal bzung ste/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas blangs zhing gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la 'thor zhing ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs brjod/ sems kyi dmigs pa ni rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog pa dang sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad de mig tsam yang lta ba'i dbang med par byas/ slar khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar bsdus/ slar yang rdo rje gsor zhing oṃ swa bhā sogs brjod/ dmigs pa ni/ gnas dang mchod rdzas la sogs pa snang ba'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong pa nam mkha' lta bur gyur par bsam/ stong pa de dag gis ngang nas yi ge a grangs med pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang /

rang gi bshams pa'i mdun gyi mchod pa dngos su 'byor ba'i snod rnams kyang ar gsal ba rnams 'od du zhu ba las bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ yi ge hūm̐ re re 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa bkod pa legs pa yid du 'ong ba nus pa tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ gzigs pa tsam gyis zag med kyi bde ba thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par byed pa mdor na dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par bsam la/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas oṃ badz+ra aharala'i hūm̐ phaṭa/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas oṃ badz+ra biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod/ de nas ḍā dril dang bcas pa'i dharmā ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod pas mchod yul spyan drangs shing mchod rdzas rnams dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du zad mi shes par byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang la dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa stsol bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dngos dang / de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu nas gang tsam gyi ma reg par bla ma'i bla ma nas/ kun tu bzang po'i bar seṅges btegs pa'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tho brtsegs su bzhugs par bsgoms/ de'i mtha' bskor du brgyud rim gyi khongs su ma 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs par mos/ rtsa brgyud bla ma de dag rnams ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor zhugs pas na sangs rgyas dkon mchog

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas yin pas chos dkon mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag yin pas dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum mo/ /de nas 'dir bla med rdo rje phur pa'i thun mong pa'i dkon mchog gsum ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi 'og rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' pad+ma nyi zla dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la gsang ba gsum bdag bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum/ de'i mthar bskor du rang rang gi gdan la khro bcu yab yum/ phra phyag nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog rigs lnga ste rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang / de'i phyi phyogs bzhir dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mtshams bzhir dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis rnams rgyan dang sku mdog phyag mtshan zhal phyogs tshul la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin bsgom/ de'i mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyi/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs la sogs pa yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / g.yas su sprul sku shākya thub pa la sogs pa bskal bzang gis sangs rgyas rnams dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams gsal bar bsgom/ de bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang bzhugs par mos/ rgyab tu rin po che'i drwa mig gi nang du sangs rgyas de dag gi gsung gi ngo bor theg pa chen po spyi dang bye brag gi mdo rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams/ rnam pa chos po ti'i tshul du bzhengs pa gdong dar khra phun ne bzhugs par bsgom/ g.yon du nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / nyan thos mchog brgyad la sogs pa nyan thos 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams bzhugs par mos/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa chos srung spyi dang bye brag dkar bdud lcam dral/

gzhan yang gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bskor nas/ skyabs yul de dag bdag dang pha ma sems can la thugs brtse zhing byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs nas/ sprin gyi phung po btib pa ltar khra dpung nge mngon sum bzhin bzhugs par bsgom/ de nas rang rten la kha phyogs te gnas pa'i mdun du/ dgra 'dre byur gsum/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mthar skor kun tu khams gsum 'khor ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams/ rang rang gi lus kyi zug rngu sems kyi sdug bsngal dang bcas te/ nyam thag pa'i tshul gyi lag thal mo sbyar zhing mig mchi ma'i rgyun rtsa re ba skyabs gnas rnams la blta zhing / bdag cag gis khyed rnams kyi bka' las 'das shing bka' ltar ma byas pas/ thog ma med pa nas tha ma da yi bar du mi bzod pa'i zug rngu drag po myang zhing / 'khor ba 'di la rtag tu 'khyams shing da rung kyang 'di tsam nas srid pa'i mtha' chod/ 'di tsam nas thar pa'i lam sna zin snyam pa'i gdengs tshad ni med/ mdor na 'khor ba 'di ni thar dus med pa'i btson rwa/ slebs dus med pa'i mgron po/ sos dus med pa'i nad pa dang 'dra bas shin tu nyam re thag da khyed rnams kyi bdag cag srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las myur du skyabs du gsol bsam zhing / ngag tu skyabs 'gro'i sgra 'u ru ru 'byin bzhin khrom 'tshogs pa ltar gnas par bsam/ de yang srid pa'i 'jigs pa ni/ dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal gong du brjod pa ltar bzod brlag med pa dang / yi dwags rnams la lo stong du btsal kyang chu thig pa re yang mi rnyed na kha zas rags pa gzhan lta ci ste rnyed/ bkres skom gyi dbang gis rang gi lba ba smin pa'i snag za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / dud 'gro rnams la glen lkug gi sdug bsngal te/ de yang glen pa ni rang sha rang gi za zhing zos pa'i zug rngu mi bzod kyang / de rang gis rang zos pa'i len pa ni mi shes pas shin tu glen pa dang /

ngag lkug pas sgra gcig ma gtogs pa brda don 'phrod pa brjod mi nus pa dang / gzhan yang gcig gis gcig za ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de bzhin du mi la skye rga na 'chi/ lha min la 'thab rtsod/ lha la bag med pa/ bar do la 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal ste/ mdor na rigs drug gam srid pa bdun gyi sdug bsngal gyi grangs brjod du med pa/ ngo bo bzod brlag med pa/ mtha' thug pa med pa dang / tshe 'di'ang rgyal po'i chad pa/ 'bangs kyi bsam ngan/ dgra rkun jag gsum gyi 'tshe ba/ me chu g.yang gsum gyi 'jigs pa/ longs spyod med na zas skom mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal/ yod na bdag gir mi thub pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / nang rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa na ba'i 'jigs pas lus 'khum pa/ gsang ba chos dang mi mthun pa'i dug lnga'i rnam rtog rang dbang med pa skye ba dang / 'chi kha yang gnad gcod drag pos gdung ste bla ma yi dam dran long med pa dang / 'chi rkyen ngan pa'i dbang gi smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor ngan pa dang / gzhan yang lus ngag yid gsum gdon bgegs kyis gzir ba la sogs pa gzhi srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / lam gyi dus na'ang skye bo tha mal pa lam ma rnyed pa dang / mu stegs can lam log pa dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal can lam gtor ba dang / nyan thos 'gog pa lam bor ba dang / nyan thos rang rgyal lam dman pa dang / phar phyin zhugs pa'i byang sems lam gol ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang / 'bras bu'i dus na las ngan gyi 'bras bu ngan song gsum la sogs pa rigs drug gi gnas su skye ba dang / rang don yid byas kyi 'bras bu nyan rang gi sar lhung ba dang / snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang yin pa la yin pa ma shes pa tha mal du 'dzin pa ni tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su shes kyang de'i rang bzhin med par mi shes pa mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni gya nom lha zhen gyi 'jigs pa/

'jigs pa de dag la skyabs pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba yin ste rgyu 'jigs pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /snying rje'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rigs drug gi sems can 'di dag pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ drin chen pha ma 'di dag nyon mongs pas sems dkrugs shing mi shes pa'i 'dam du bying nas/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje 'di dag myur du skyabs su gsol snyam pa dang / dad pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs gnas de rnams la mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan mnga' ba ste/ de yang mkhyen pa med na long bas long ba khrid pa dang 'dra/ mkhyen pa yod kyang brtse ba med na phyug po'i sgo drung du sprang po mu ges shi bcug pa dang 'dra/ brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na ma zha ma'i bu chus khur shor ba dang 'dra/ 'o na skyabs gnas rnams la mkhyen brtse nus gsum ji ltar mnga' zhe na/ mkhyen pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba po bdag dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can de dag re re'i rang rang gis nyams su myong ba'i sdug bsngal de dag rgyu gang gis byas/ rkyen gang gis bslang / dus nam thog tu smin/ da lta tshor ba ji lta bu sdug da gang tsam nas thar/ ci bsam ci smra ba thams cad cig char du thugs kyis dgongs pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel thugs su chud de/ tsher ma rno ba/ sran ma zlum pa/ stag gzig gi ri mo dang / rma bya'i sgro mdong bkra ba la sogs rgyu rkyen rten 'brel thams cad dgongs pa'o/ /mdor na dus gsum sgrib med cig char tu gzigs pa'i mkhyen rab dang / chags thogs med pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'o/ /brtse ba ni sems can thams cad la ma dang bu lta bu'i tshul gyis thugs brtse ba'o/ /nus pa ni chos thun re gsungs pa dang / 'od zer spro bsdu skad cig re res sems can bye ba khrag khrig sgrol nus pa dang /

skra nyag ma gcig gis rtse mor rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu thams cad thig pa tsam yang ma lus pa btsan gyi len nus pa dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams yung 'bru zhig gis nang du 'jug nus pa dang / de yang yung 'bru cher ma song 'jig rten gyi khams de chung du ma song ba'o/ /de dag la sogs pa mthu stobs dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas na rgyu dad pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ sangs rgyas la lam ston pa'i ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam grogs kyi tshul du'o/ /dus gang nas gang gi bar du'o zhe na/ dus de ring nas ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du'o/ /skyabs su 'gro ba po ni/ bdag dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can rnams so/ /skyabs yul bla ma rnams ni/ mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ sangs rgyas ni/ gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can dam pa'i chos ni/ gtso bor rdo rje gzhon nu'i rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag go /'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni/ gtso bo khro bcu phra thabs sgo ma sras mchog dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang byang sems nyan thos chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa rnams so/ /de dag ni skyabs 'gro rgyas pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /bsdu na skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de dag ni sngon 'gro bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis las skyabs 'gro'i sgo nas tshogs bsags pa'o/ /'o na bsod nams kyi tshogs ji tsam rdzogs zhe na/ mdo las/ skyabs gsol bsod nams 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' bar snang 'di yang snod du chung / /zhes gsungs pa'o/

/de ltar gong du bshad pa'i don rnams bsgom la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar lan nyer gcig las mi nyung ba rtse gcig tu bya/ de nas thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs yan lag bdun pa brjod/ de dag gis dmigs pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rnams ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal dang ldan pa ste/ de 'dra sngar 'das pa dang / da lta bzhugs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa 'byon rgyu rnams la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ 1 /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum ni mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing mchog ste/ de rnams la bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyi skyabs su mchi'o/ 2 /khyed rnams la bdag gis dngos su 'byor pa dang / yid kyis sprul pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod pa dag pa 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ 3ka dngos grub chu bo'i rgyun rang chas su 'bab pa gcod pa'i gegs bdag gi nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ 4 phyogs bcu dus gsum dkar po dge ba'i chos byas dang byed rgyu rnams ni snang yang rang bzhin med pa 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos ma chags par spyod pa ste de rnams la bdag rjes su yi rang ngo / 5 /shin tu dag pa ni chad pa med pa rtag pa med pa 'ong ba med pa 'gro ba med pa ste dri ma thams cad dang bral ba ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub ste/ de bdag gis myur du thob par sems bskyed do/ 6 /bde bar gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la yul mnyes par bya ba dang / zab pa rang gi don bsgrub pa dang / rgya che ba gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa ste dgos pa gsum gyi phyir bdag gi lus 'di 'bul lo/ 3kha bdag gis tshe rabs thog mtha' bar gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i las rnams gcig tu bsdus te/ thams cad byang chub chen po thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ 7 /zhes bshad pas gzhung tshig rkang gnyis re dang aṃ gi re bstun te shes par byas la bsgom par bya'o/
