/de'i rjes su skyabs yul rnams bdag dang pha ma sems can la dgyes bzhin du mtha' nas dbus kyi bar 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas/ bdag dang pha ma sems can la thim pas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad cig char du bral nas thams cad sangs rgyas par bsam mo/ /de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang sogs sho lo ka gcig po de brjod/ dmigs pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba dang / bde ba'i rgyu dge ba'i las dang rtag tu ldan na ci ma rung snyam snying thag pa nas bsgom pa ni byams pa tshad med/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa kha tsam min pa snying thag pa nas bsgom pa ni snying rje tshad med pa/ pha ma sems can de dag sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na/ bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na bdag gi yid tshim pas dga' spro thob bo snyam du bsgom pa dga' ba tshad med pa/ sems can thams cad rang phyogs la ma chags la gzhan phyogs la sdang ba med pa mdor na chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs na ci ma rung snyam du bsgom pa btang snyoms tshad med pa ste tshad med bzhi'o/ /de ltar na tshad med bzhi'i don bsgom pa ni smon pa sems bskyed/ don dang bcas pa'i gzhung tshig brjod pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed do/ /'o na tshad med pa gang zhe na/ mgon po byams pas/ sems can khams ni tshad med de/ /phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can la ni tshad med cing / de la khyab pa'i snying rje dang byams pa sogs bsgom pas na tshad med pa'o/ /de ltar yul tshad med pa la byams pa sogs tshad med pa bsgoms pas des bsod nams kyang tshad med pa'o/ /de skad du yang mdo las/ bye ba khrag khrig bltams pa'i zhing rnams na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ci yod pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la nyin re rtag mchod pas/

/byams pa'i sems la grangs dang char mi phod/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de yan chad bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid bsgom dgos te/ de skad du yang / rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshig nas stong nyid bsgom pa dang / btsan thabs su bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag gi phyogs tsam rtogs kyang 'dir yi ge mang bas ma bris so/ /btsan thabs su bsgom pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ye ta sogs/ sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can te/ snod bcud kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bur gyur par bsam pa'o/ /de nas bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bcad pa ni/ stong pa de ka'i ngang las chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin/ rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sogs nas/ sku can du gyur zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab/ de nas sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod pas yum gyis dam tshig bskul/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ badz+ra bhan+dha zhes brjod pas yab yum phan tshun bde ba chen por ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ badz+ra añdza li dzaḥzhes brjod pas yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ste dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam la/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems sogs nas s+phoṭa s+phoṭa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod la rdor dril bzhag de dag gi skabs kyis dmigs pa ni yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas 'byung ba'i hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa'i khro bcu rnams rngam zhing 'jigs la drag gtum mi bzad pa zhal nas hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra drag tu sgrog pa/

rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i mdun du gnas pa la bka' bsgo ba ni/ phaṭa zhes brjod pas spros shing thugs dam bskul/ gang bskul na rang gdug cing gzhan la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par songs shig lha min lha yang rung ste gal te nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud rnams mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos shig ces bka' bsgos pas khro bo de rnams zhabs sa la brdab cing zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa dang bcas te/ sngar yod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ gal te mi 'gro ba'i gdug pa can thams cad 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi bsad cing bsgral ba'i las mdzad/ las ngan sdig sgrib ye shes kyi mes bsregs sha khrag lhag ma med par tshogs su rol nas rnam par shes pa hūm̐ yig tu byas te skye med rdo rje gzhon nu'i sras su gnas spar/ de nas rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam pa ni bgegs bskrad pa'o/ /da phyin chad bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hū?m̐ las sogs na a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ phyag rgya'i rigs rnams ni sgrubs thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / mthong brgyud phyag len ltar shes par bya'o/ /dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer tsha la rtsub pa spros/ de rnams rim pa bzhin rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug tho rnams su gyur pas nga yi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin du srungs zhes pa'i don dang / phyag rgya g.yas nas g.yon du bskor la oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang g.yon nas g.yas su bskor la/ oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod/

sngags don ni badz+ra rdo rje a yu dha mtshon cha rak+ṣa srungs zhes pa dang / hūm̐ phaṭa ni 'di'i skabs su dgra bgegs khos shig ces pa la 'jug gsungs/ dmigs pa ni sngags dang po'i dus thugs ka'i hūm̐ las mtshon cha rnam pa lnga byung ste dgra bgegs ring du bskrad/ gnyis pa'i dus stong gsum la sogs pa rang ji ltar mos pa'i tshad kyi phyi nas nang du rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo rgya gram dbyug tho rnams kyi 'og tu chur nyal gyi sa gzhi/ logs su 'greng bur lang ba'i drwa ba/ steng du gur rdo rje'i tog dang bcas pa de'i nang gi bar snang la bla re'i tshul du lding ba/ drwa ba'i phyi rol tu slar yang phyed tsam bskor ba'i rwa ba de rnams dbyibs ni zlum po'o/ /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing zhes pa nas tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ phyag rgya ni gzhung bzhin bskor tshul ni sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni mtshon cha rnam lnga'i srung 'khor de dag bdag sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du rkyen gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig mi nus pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pas na/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i bgegs mthu bo che rnams dang / mdor na srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi/ log par blta ba'i dgra bgegs rnal 'byor pa byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa rnams mig tsam yang blta bar mi bzad pa rgyang ring du song bar bsam/ sngags don ni rdo rje gzi brjid brtan pa'i 'khor los srungs zhes pa'i don yin gsung / de yang dang po'i dus gzi brjid ldan pa/ gnyis pa'i dus gzi brjid 'bar bar bsgom pa'o/ /de nas rwa ba de rnams las sogs nas ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa'i bar brjod/ phyag rgya gzhung bzhin bskor tshul sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni chu tshan thang la bo ba'i rlangs pa nam mkhar langs pa'i tshul ltar/ rwa ba de rnams la me'i 'od zer bskal pa'i me ltar tsha la rtsub pa dmar nag drag tu 'bar bas sa dang mkha' kun khyab pas bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams/

skad cig tsam la spu nyag ma mer gtug pa ltar sregs pa'i nus ldan du bsam/ sngags don ni oṃ ni sngags kyi 'go 'dren pa/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rdo rje me 'bar ba/ ha na bsnun/ da ha sregs/ pa tsa tshos/ ma tha thul/ bhañdza choms/ ra ṇa nyon mongs pa hūm̐ phaṭa dgra bgegs khos shig ces pa yin gsungs/ de yang dang po'i dus bsregs/ gnyis pa'i dus 'bar zhing gnas par bsam mo/ /de rnams mtshams bcad cing srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /de nas tshogs zhing spyan drangs shing yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas zhes pa nas/ nam mkhar zhes pa'i bar brjod/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po rtse mo gug pa lcags kyu'i dbyibs can byung ba sna bug g.yas nas thon te/ nam mkha'i khams khyab pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes dang / las las grub pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te badz+ra sa ma dzaḥzhes brjod/ de yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpung pa gnyis ni rdo rje bcing / /rdo rje se gol brdab pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu mdzad na/ /gzhan rnams thams cad smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthus thams cad bsdu bar the tshom med do/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo gu ru zhes sogs brjod/ dmigs pa ni bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ sngags don ni na mo gu ru bh+ya/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo badz+ra sogs nas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /de nas tshogs zhing ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mdun du skyabs su 'gro ba sogs yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/

dkon mchog gsum zhes pa nas yid kyi bzung zhes pa'i bar thal mo sbyar te lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin skyabs gnas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag khyed la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag cag rnams kyis thog ma dang tha ma bar gsum du lung ma bstan pa dang / rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed nyams pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa sogs bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba ste/ bcas rang gis bsdus pa'i nyes ltung rang gis bgyis pa dang / gzhan bgyid du btsal ba dang / gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba sogs/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad de ring bdag gis mthol lo bshags so/ /de yang tshul ji lta bus bshags na stobs bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshags dgos te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bshags yul dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan mngon sum du bzhugs pa rnams ni rten gyi stobs dang / sngar rang gis byas pa'i sdig pa rnams la khog du dug btung ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog la bab kyang shes bzhin du sdig pa'i las ci yang mi byed pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang / yul khyad par can 'di rnams kyi mdun du bdag gis thabs khyad par can 'di lta bus bshags pa byas pas bdag gis rgyud dag par the tshom med do snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshags pa'o/ /so so skye bo dang / nyan thos dang / rang rgyal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te zag bcas zag med kyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa thams cad la bdag gis phrag dog spangs te rjes su yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas byang chub ste don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang yid kyis bzung te bsgom snyam du dam bca' ba'o/

/de ni yan lag bdun pa la mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / 'dir skabs su bab pa ni gong du phyag 'tshal ba dang /1 dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba re re dbye bas 4/ bshags pa dang 5/ yi rangs pa dang /6 sems bskyed dang 7yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar yan lag bdun pa'i phan yon lung ltar bshad na/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal brjod tsam gyi/ /'khor ba las ni thar zhes gsung / /zhes so/ /skyabs 'gro'i phan yon ni/ gong du brjod pa ltar/ skyabs gsol bsod nams 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' bar snang 'di yang snod du chung / /zhes so/ /bshags pa'i phan yon ni/ bshes springs las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la/ /phyis nas bag dang ldan pa gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bu rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gcung dga' bo bud med la chags pa dang / sor phreng can gyis mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa dang / mthong can ldan gyis pha bsad pa dang / bde byed kyis rang gi ma bsad pa sogs sdig pa de rnams kyang bshags pas dag par gsungs so/ /rjes su yi rang ba'i phan yon ni/ mdo sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal yang tshad bzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de ltar min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni bsam las 'das pa yin te/ 'di cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed na 'khor ba'i btson rar tshud pa'i 'gro ba yin yang / sems bskyed phyin chad ming dang don gnyis ka skad cig de la 'phos nas ming bde bar gshegs pa'i sras zhes brjod cing don 'jig rten lha mi dang bcas pas phyag bya ba'i yul du 'gyur bar gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/

/bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba ltar/ skyon gyi rang bzhin mi gtsang ba'i lus 'di blangs yang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed na rgyal ba'i sku/ rin chen rin thang med pa bsgyur te/ yang spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med pa bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'o na sems bskyed gang zhe na/ gzhan gyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa de yin te/ de skad du yang mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces so/ de la dbye na smon 'jug gnyis las/ smon pa sems bskyed ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yin 'bras bu mchog thob par 'dod pa yin pas de la yid smon pa'o/ /'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ 'bras bu de nges par thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa nas gsungs pa'i lam rnams la/ tshul bzhin du slob pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed do/ /de yang ci skad du/ gzhan phyir 'bras bu 'dod pa smon pa'i sems/ /'bras phyir lam la slob pa 'jug pa'i sems/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar yan lag bdun pa'i tshig rnams dmigs pa dang bcas te brjod tshar rjes mdun gyi tshogs zhing de dag thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ba la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang gi snying khar thim par bsam la mdun gyi sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de nas yang rang gi snying kha sogs nas brlabs par gyur zhes pa'i bar gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ni rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pas rang gi mdun gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa la a la la ho zhes brjod cing spro ba bskyed/

de nas hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas lha tshogs de dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' ིkhams gang bar gsal btab dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya hoḥzhes brjod pas yum rnams kyis bskul/ sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par byon nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la thim pas byin brlabs nus mthu phun sum tshogs zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo nas kyang thim pas lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang / dbang bzhi ma lus pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad rtsa ba nas dag mchog thun mong gi dngos grub skad gcig de nyid la thob par bsam mo/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyang rang la thim par bsgom pa de gzhung 'di nyid nas ma gsungs kyang rnam bshad chen mo'i dgongs pa ltar na bsgom par mngon no/ /de nas rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sman rag gtor gsum byin gyis rlabs pa dang / bsnyen phur byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ pho thod mo thod ma ning thod/ /ba ling rak+ta bdud rtsi sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pas rab 'byor na/ ma ning gi thod par bdud rtsi/ pho thod du gtor ma/ mo thod du rak+ta rnams bshams/ de tsam ma 'byor na gong du rdzas phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs su bshad pa des chog pas/ de rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ thog mar rdo rje'i rtse'i nang mchod nas blangs te rdzas rnams la 'thor zhing oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod/ dmigs pa ni rang gis thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros rdzas kyi mi gtsang ba bsang / de dag la gnas pa'i bgegs rnams bskrad/ slar rang gi thugs kar thim par sgom/ de yang myang 'das las/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gi 'bru gsum gyis/ /bsregs gtor sbyongs pa'i rim pa yis/

/'phel zhing bcud dang ldan pa ni/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis brlab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las yi ge raṃ dmar po gcig spros te mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa'i tshul gyis sna bug nas thon raṃ las byung ba'i mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas 'bag pa dang mi gtsang ba'i tshogs thams cad bsregs/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las yaṃ sngon po sngar ltar spros/ yaṃ las rlung chen g.yos pas sngar bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams kyang gtor/ yang khaṃ dkar po sngar ltar spros khaṃ las chu bo bab pas sngar gtor ba'i shul thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs pas nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam/ yang sa bon las bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ gnyis spros pas bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gnyis su gyur par bsam/ yang aṃ gnyis sngar ltar spros snod gnyis kyi nang du 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab par gyur par bsam la/ gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de nas sman gtor gnyis swa bha was te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba'i rnam pa can/ de'i steng du raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs pa'i steng / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus su hūm̐/ shar du oṃ/ lhor traṃ/ nub du hrīḥ byang du aḥrnams gsal bar bsgom/ de nas yig 'bru lnga po de 'od du zhu ba las/ ba lang khyi rta glang chen mi/ /zhes pa'i sha lnga dang / dri chen rak+ta byang sems dang / /klad pa dri chu bdud rtsi lnga/ /zhes bshad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / me long mnyam nyid sor rtogs dang / /bya grub chos dbyings ye shes lnga/ /zhes bshad pa'i ye shes lnga ste/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur te thod pa'i nang gang bar bsam/ de nas 'og gi rlung de g.yos pas de'i steng gi me 'bar ba thod pa'i zhabs la reg pas nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā a haḥlas dbus su rdo rje/

shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri ste/ phyag mtshan lngar gyur pa la oṃ badz+ra dhṛ ka sogs kyi sngags rnams brjod pas rkyen gyis phyag mtshan lnga po de rnams 'od du zhu nas dbus su badz+ra he ru ka yab yum/ shar du bud+dha/ lhor rat+na/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du karma he ru ka yab yum ste bcur gyur/ de nas sa ma ya swāṃ zhes brjod pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor bas bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ yid kyis sprul pa'i longs spyod la sogs pa lha yi bdud rtsi/ chang la sogs pa mi'i bdud rtsi/ li shi suk+mel la sogs pa sman bdud rtsi/ bur shing la sogs pa shing bdud rtsi ste/ 'jig rten pa'i bdud rtsi dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi ste/ bdud rtsi de rnams thib thib du bkug nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum la thim/ de rnams 'og gi bdud rtsi sman dang gtor ma la thim thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pas kha dog dwangs pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba la sogs ro brgya dang ldan pa nus pa zag med kyi bde ba myong ba tsam gyis bskyed nus pa ste phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po ltar gyur par sems kyis bsam la/ gzhung gi tshig rnams ngag tu brjod lus kyi dung phor 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya phyag len ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes pa thams cad bdud rtsi lnga zhes pa'i don can gyi sngags brgya rtsa'am nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs phyag len ltar mang nyung 'tshams par bya'o/ /zhes sman phud byin gyis brlabs pa dang yang gtor ma la sems kyis dmigs pa gong ltar bsgom/ lus kyis gzhong pa 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya phyag len ltar byas/

ngag tu te dz+wa ba ling sogs kyis sngags mang nyung gong ltar brjod/ sngags don ni gtor ma gzi brjid stobs dang ldan pa gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi dam tshig grub pa zhes pa'i don yin gsungs/ de ni sman gtor lhan cig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /'on kyang brjod pa'i tshig thun mong yin kyang / sems kyi dmigs pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa rnams sman gtor gnyis rang rang la re re bsgom par bsam mo/ /de nas rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsang sbyang ni gong du song zhing rak+ta'i snod sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod dmigs pa ni/ rak+ta'i snod aḥlas thod pa yangs pa'i nang ye ger 'od du zhu ba las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas rak+ta de'i steng du ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig dmar khyil le byung bar bsam/ ra zhes brjod pas skad cig de la nyi ma'i steng du ye ger dmar po byu ru'i sdong po phyis pa lta bu gcig bsgom/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa zhes brjod pas ra de las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med spros pas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi snying khrag dang gzung khrag thams cad sa ཾha ra ṇa hūm̐ zhes pas tshul bsdus te ra dmar po la thim par bsam/ de nas pad+ma 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya phyag len ltar byas la/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sogs sngags ji ltar 'tshams par brjod/ sngags don ni/ khrag chen po 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa yin la/ dmigs pa ni ra yig nyi ma dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas 'og gi rak+ta dang gnyis su med par gyur pas rak+ta'i rgyal mtsho rba klong dmar nag 'khrugs cing nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas bsnyen phur byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar gong du bshad pa'i bsnyen phur de skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las yi ge hūm̐ sngon po bai ḍūr sngon po g.ya' dag pa lta bur bsam la/

yang hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa zhes brjod pas hūm̐ de las 'od zer sngon po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad gang bar spros/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la zhes brjod pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyis rnam par spyan drangs te/ hūm̐ yig de la thim pa'i rkyen gyis de nyid phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par gyur par bsam la/ phyag rgya phyag len ltar byas la oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs kyi sngags ji ltar 'tshams pa brjod pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ khro bo bcus brgyan pa'i tshul ni 'og tu bstod pa'i skabs nas shes par bya'o/ /de yan gyi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams song nas/ ༈ de nas dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bsgom pa ni/ de yang dang po grangs ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum las/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang zhes gsungs pas/ de yang sems bcos pa ni rang gi sems 'di yod par 'dod na rtag pa'i mtha' la lhung / med par 'dod na chad pa'i mtha' la lhung ba ste/ sems bcos pa'o/ /ma bcos pa ni sems 'di yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ stong pa nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /de yang dang por sems yod pa ma yin te/ yod na rang re tha mal pas ma rig kyang / kun mkhyen sangs rgyas rnams kyis gzigs dgos pa las ma gzigs te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po sems ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigs mi gzigs/ gzigs par yang mi 'gyur te/ sems ni sngon po ma yin/

ser po ma yin/ dmar po ma yin/ leb rgan du ma yin/ shel gyi kha dog tu ma yin/ thung du ma yin/ ring por ma yin/ zlum po ma yin/ gru bzhi ma yin/ snang ba ma yin/ mun par ma yin/ skyes par ma yin/ bud med du ma yin/ ma ning ma yin/ gsang ba'i bdag po sems ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin du ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams kyi rang bzhin du ma yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin du yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /sems med pa yang ma yin te/ sems med na 'gro 'dug dang smra brjod la sogs pa su yis nus/ yar sangs rgyas thob pa dang / mar ngan song du 'gro ba rnams kyang su yi byas/ des na de dag la sogs pa 'khor 'das thams cad kyi sa bon dang byed po sems yin te/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad rab ster ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /'o na yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin pa'i sems de gang zhe na/ sems 'di ni 'di zhes brjod du med pas/ 'di'o zhes bstan du med de/ rje te lo pas/ ngag gi lam 'das tshig gis spyod yul min/ /te lo nga la ci yang bstan du med/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / phrin gzhung dregs pa zil gnon las/ smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems 'di ni gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral bas tshig gis lam las 'das zhing ngag gi smra ba dang brjod par mi nus pa stong pa nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ma bcos pa rang byung chen po'o/ /'di chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin yang de bzhin nyid las mi 'gyur bas/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba des 'khor 'das kyis chos thams cad la khyab pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bcas pa yang stong pa nyid do/

/sems can gyi sems ma rig pa'i log rtog dang bcas pa'ang stong pa nyid do/ /'o na sangs rgyas dang sems can dbyer med pa yin nam zhe na/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don ma rtogs pa rnams kyis 'khor 'das gnyis su yod pa ltar snang yang / don dam par gnyis su med de/ de skad du yang / 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa zhes/ /de nyid ma mthong ba rnams bzhed/ /de nyid mthong rnams 'khor ba dang / /mya ngan 'das pa gnyis mi bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /des na sems can rmongs pa'i dbang gis med pa la yod pa bzhin du gnyis snang gi bag chags la zhen pas 'khor ba'i gzugs su snang nas/ skye rga la sogs pa 'khrul pa kho na la longs spyod/ ma rmongs par gyur pa'i tshe 'khrul gzhi sems dang 'khrul pa skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa rnams gnyis su med pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du phyi rol sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa dngos por snang ba'i chos thams cad kyang rang gi sems ma gtogs par logs su med de/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ don du snang ba blo nyid yin/ /snang ba de nyid phyi na med/ /bag chags brtan dang mi brtan las/ /bden dang brdzun pa'i rnam gzhag byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ dper na rmi lam skabs kyi snang ba de rang gis sems ma gtogs gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin du phyi rol du snang ba'i ri brag la sogs pa'i dngos por snang ba 'di dag kyang rang gi sems las gzhan ma yin no/ /'on kyang bag chags cung srab pas rmi lam mi bden par bzung la/ bag chags shin tu brtan pas phyi rol gyi dngos por snang ba 'di dag bden bden por snang ngo / /de bzhin du bag chags bzang ngan gyis snang ba yang bzang ngan sna tshogs su 'char te/ dper na chu snod gang la lhas bdud rtsi/

mis chu/ yi dwags kyis rnag khrag dmyal ba pas khro chu rnams su mthong bar gsung zhing / des na chu bden par grub na bdud rtsi mi bden/ bdud rtsi bden par grub na chu mi bden pas gzung 'dzin bden med du shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin mi'i yul gyi sa rdo ri brag dang / dmyal ba'i yul gyi lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi la sogs pa rnams don dam par rang gi sems yin zhing / 'on kyang bag chags bzang ngan gyis tha dad du snang ba yin te/ dper na snam bu dkar po zhig ram la tshos na snam bu sngon po dang / btsod du tshos pa'i snam bu dmar por snang yang / don dam par dkar po nyid ma gtogs pa dkar po nyid gzhan du song nas/ sngon po dang dmar po gzhan nas yong ba ma yin no/ /de gang zhe na snam bu dkar po ram gyi khu bas sngon por bsgyur nas/ snam bu sngon po zhes zer yang / don la mdog sngon por snang ba ma rtogs/ snam bu gong gi dkar po nyid do/ /de bzhin sems 'di ma rig pas 'ching ba log rtog dang bcas pa la sems can dang / ma rig pa sangs nas ye shes rgyas pa la sangs rgyas zhes zer yang / don dam par ma rig pas 'ching dus sangs rgyas thugs de gzhan du song ba yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas dus su'ang sems can gyi sems de gzhan du song ba yang ma yin no/ /des na snam bu gcig la tshon gyi bye brag mdog sna tshogs su snang ba srid pa ltar/ sems gcig la ye shes dang log rtog gi bye brag gis khams gsum rigs drug nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas byang sems sogs sna tshogs su snang ba srid pa'o/ /'o na sems can dang log rtog gam/ sangs rgyas dang ye shes gnyis tha dad yin nam ce na/ sems can dang log rtog gam/ sangs rgyas dang ye shes gnyis gcig pa yang ma yin tha dad kyang ma yin no/ /'o na ji lta bu zhe na/ gla rtsi dang gla rtsi'i dri bzhin no/ /de bzhin du nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar/ gcig tu sdod pa mi rigs te/

nyi ma nam mkha' la gnas bzhin 'od zer gyi sa gzhi khyab pa'o/ /tha dad du sdod pa yang mi rigs te/ nyi ma med na nyi ma'i 'od zer ga la srid/ nyi ma yod la 'od zer med pa yang ga la srid/ de bas na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin zhing / chos sems tha dad du lta ba ma rig pa/ chos sems gnyis med du rtogs pa sangs rgyas yin te/ kun 'dus rig pa'i rgyud las/ sems nyid gang yin chos nyid de/ /chos nyid gang yin sems nyid de/ /chos sems gnyis med ldan gyur pa/ /byang chub chen po de bshad do/ /'o na ma rig dang ye shes gnyis tha dad yin nam zhe na/ de ni snang mun ltar yin pas rigs pas dpyad par bya ste/ dper na snang ba shar ba'i tshe mun pa gzhan du song ba yang ma yin/ mun pa 'thib dus snang ba gzhan du 'gro ba yang med do/ /des na snang ba cher rgyas pas mun pa snang bar bsgyur/ mun pa cher 'thib pas snang ba mun par song ba ltar/ ma rig pa'i mun pa cher 'thib dus ye shes kyi snang ba bral/ ye shes cher rgyas tshe snang ba ma spangs pa ye shes kyi gnas su dag pa'o/ /des na ma rig pa ngan pa gzhan du dor du med/ ye shes bzang po gzhan nas bsgrub tu med de/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya gcig kyang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa'i gnyen po yang dag par spros bral stong pa nyid bsgom dgos te/ de skad du yang / nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /stong nyid ci'i phyir bsgom mi byed/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de bas chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas la/ sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas spang bya gnyen po ro gcig tu rtogs shing /

'bras bu mtshan 'dzin bral ba chos kyi sku la yon tan gyi me tog rab tu rgyas par 'gyur te/ yang mgon po byams pas/ spang gnyen de bzhin nyid rtogs dang / /'bras bu mtshan 'dzin gzhi bral bas/ /de tshe nam mkha'i sku can la/ /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /des na 'di'i skabs su stong nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing / de ma bsgoms pa'i skyon ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis rtsis ma zin pa sku mdog rang rgyud par bsgoms na 'dod khams kyi lhar skye/ phyag mtshan rang rgyud par bsgoms na bdud dam srin por skye/ mgo brnyan rang rgyud par bsgoms na dur khrod kyi wa mo'am nags kyi spre'u skye/ sbyor ba rang rgyud par bsgoms na mngal gyi srin bur skye/ sgrol ba rang rgyud par bsgoms na sems can dmyal bar skye bar gsungs so/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid bsgoms pas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog bcom nas gdab las la sogs pa gang byas tshad ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zhes gsungs pas/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi stong nyid spros bral chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la/ rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje yul med du bsgom pa'o/ /de ma bsgoms pa'i skyon ni kun rdzob bden pa dang don dam bden pa gnyis zung du mi 'jug cing / sangs rgyas mnyes rigs su yar chad cing / 'khor ba bde char du mar lus pas mtshams mi sbyor ro/ /de bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ snying rje chen po'i ros gang bas 'khor 'das mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /des na rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje sems can thams cad la khyab par bsgom pas na/

kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de/ yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ zhes gsungs pas/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi sangs rgyas dang sems can mtshams sbyor ba byed pa'i thabs la/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa rang gi rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa de/ yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu bsgom pa'o/ /de rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rgyu yin pas na rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes so/ /de ma bstan pa'i skyon ni/ bskyed rim mchog dang mi ldan zhing rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can gyi don byed mi nus pa'o/ /bstan pa'i phan yon ni/ bskyed rim mchog yan lag dang bcas te rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi gnas lugs legs par shes par byas nas/ lag tu blang ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ dmigs pa ni/ gong du de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su bshad pa de rnams dran par byas la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ sngags don ni/ oṃ ni mgo 'dren pa ste dam bca' ba/ ma hā shu n+yā ta ni stong nyid chen po ste/ nyi tshe ba ma yin pa'i stong pa de dang / dz+nyā na ye shes te rang gi sems/ de gnyis dbyer med du bsgom pas nga'o/ /badz+ra ste rdo rje/ de'i ngang du gnas pas/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin/ de la nga rgyal 'jog pas at+ma ko3 a haṃ bdag nyid nga'o zhes pa ste/ de nas oṃ dharmā dha dhu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ces pa'i sngags don ni/ chos rnams kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje bdag nyid can gyi rang bzhin nga'o/ /zhes pa yin la/ bsgom don ni/ ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa'i don lhag par dran par bya zhing ting nge 'dzin gsum pa shugs la dran par bya ba ni/

ting nge 'dzin gsum gsang ba sngags kyi sgo nas bsgom par bstan pa yin zhing / tshig gi sgo nas gsal btab ste bsgom pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las rdo rje khro bos sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan te/ de yang ting nge 'dzin dang po rdo rje zhes pas bstan te/ rdo rje la yang pha lam rdzas kyi rdo rje sogs mang du yod kyang / 'di chos nyid don gyi rdo rje'o/ /de bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni mtshan ma'i rnam rtog gcod/ gnyis pa kun snang gi ting 'dzin ni/ khro bos zhe sdang gcod zhes pas bstan te/ gang khro na chos nyid don gyi rdo rje de'o/ /gang la khros na mtshan ma'i rnam rtog la'o/ /tshul ji lta bu zhe na chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi ngang ngam shugs kyis khros pa'o/ /dgos pa ni zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga rtsad nas gcod pa'o/ /gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang sems hūm̐ gi rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba zhes pas bstan te/ gang mtshon na hūm̐ des ye shes lnga mtshon pa'o/ /tshul ji lta bu zhe na hūm̐ de'i khog na a yod pas chos dbyings ye shes mtshon/ zhabs kyu u te me long lta bu'i ye shes mtshon/ khog pa'i ha ni mnyam nyid ye shes/ klad skor ma ste sor rtogs ye shes/ zla tshes da ste bya grub ye shes mtshon pa'o/ /chen ni rang byung yin pas chen po'o/ /sngon po ni kha dog ste gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'o/ /cher 'bar ba ni ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'bar ba dang yi ge du ma spro ba'o/ /nam mkha' la/ bu ga nam mkha'/ 'dus ma byas nam mkha'/ chos nyid nam mkha' rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir chos nyid nam mkha' 'o/ /dkyil du ni mtha' dbus med pa/ thig le ni rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyu'i yi ge rnams thig par byed pa/ nam mkha' de'i dkyil du rang sems hūm̐ sngon po gsal la 'tsher ba'i rnam par shar ba blos bsgom pa'o/

/srog gi sgo ru zhes pa 'dir 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i bskyed gzhir shar ba/ snying gi dkyil du bsgom zhes pa/ hūm̐ de 'og gi gdan steng du bab ste/ gtso bo yab yum bsgoms pa'i snying gi dkyil du ye shes sems dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste sum brtsegs su bsgom pa'o/ /des na dang po shun+ya ta zhes pa nas/ bsgom par bya zhes pa'i bar gyis ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bsgom pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi don du lha bsgom snyam du dran par byed pa yin no/ /ji ltar bsgom na sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad sogs tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ni nam mkha'i hūm̐ de las raṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin spros pas ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad tsha lam ste bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung chen gyis bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus shul dag par byas/ slar yang hūm̐ de las e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ kaṃ e rnams s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas yi ge rnams rim par spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ e las zhes pa nas/ rdo rjes spras zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ 'di'i skabs kyi dmigs pa mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa mthun mi mthun 'ga' 'dug ste/ 'dir gsang sngags spyi'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang / rnying ma'i gzhung phal cher dang bstun te brjod na/ e las ma dag pa'i nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa yum bud+dha kro ta'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i dbyibs gru gsum kha dog mthing skya rgya khyon 'byam klas par bsgom/ de'i dkyil du yaṃ las ma dag pa'i rlung rnam par dag pa yum karma kro ta'i ma'i rang bzhin rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs rgya gram kha dog ljang khu sra zhing brtan pa bsgom/ de'i steng du paṃ las chu khams rnam dag rat+na kro ta ma'i rang bzhin chu'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs zlum po kha dog dkar po bsgom/

de'i steng du raṃ las me'i khams rnam par dag pa pad+ma kro ta'i rang bzhin me'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru gsum mdog dmar po rab tu skyod pa tshad 'og gi chu dkyil de'i phyed tsam khyab pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa khams rnam dag badz+ra kro ta ma'i rang bzhin sa yi dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru bzhi mdog ser po bsgom pa ste 'byung lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab te bsgom pa'o/ /de ni gzhi sbyang bya phyi snod kyi 'jig rten du zhen pa'i chos 'di/ lam sbyong byed 'byung ba yum lnga'i dkyil 'khor chags tshul bsgom pas/ 'bras bu thob tshul lus rtog bcas 'di chos dbyings yum lnga'i mkhar dag pa'o/ /de yang gang du sbyang ba'i skabs su srung 'khor sbyangs na slar ldang ste de'i nang du bsgom/ ma sbyangs na sngar yod de'i nang du bsgom par gsungs/ gsang sngags sgo gsum gsungs pa ni/ sngags brjod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang / tshig gsal btab pa gsum mo/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng raṃ zhu ba las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong rab tu 'khrugs pa rgya mtsho chen po ltar bsgoms/ de'i dbus su keṃ las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab dpang mtho zhing rgya yangs pa'i steng / e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras pa gsal lam ste bsgom/ de nas gdan bskyed pa dang 'gugs pa gnyis las/ dang po pāṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas chos 'byung gi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan dang / ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i lte bar ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ a tsaṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byung bar bsam/ gnyis pa 'gugs pa ni/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin las dzaḥdamar po las lcags kyu dmar po dpag tu med pa spros te/ dbang phyug u ma gnyis bkug ma hā de wa dzaḥzhes brjod/ sngags don ni lha chen po dgug ces pa ste/ gang du dgug na gdan gyi g.yas phyogs su kha sbubs kyi tshul du'o/

/u ma de wi dzaḥzhes brjod/ sngags don lha mo u ma dgug ces pa ste/ gang du dgug na gdan gyi g.yon du gan rkyal du'o/ /de rnams ni rten bskyed pa yin la/ brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ dang po sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba zhes pa nas/ bi ghan+na ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥzhes pa'i bar brjod/ dmigs pa ni/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ kha dog sngon po 'tsher ba de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bab/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa zhes brjod pas hūm̐ de las 'od zer nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod cing mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad skad cig de la sbyangs pa sogs don gnyis byas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'od zer rnams tshur bsdus te gzhi'i hūm̐ la thim/ de nas sngags kyi sgo nas bskyed pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs brjod/ sngags don ni/ oṃ sku lnga ye shes lnga/ badz+ra dus gsum 'dus ma byas/ kī li kī la lha dang phur pa'o/ /sarba dgra bgegs thams cad/ bi ghan nan mnan pa/ baṃ hūm̐ dbang du bsdu ba/ phaṭa sgrol pa'o/ /'di lha dang sbyar na/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags hūm̐/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la/ bskul ba las kyi sngags sarba bi ghan nan/ bzlas pa las kyi sngags baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'o/ /chos nyid dang sbyar na/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la ngos gzung med pa/ sgra grags stong du bsgoms nas bzla bar gsung / byang sems dgongs pa dang sbyar na/ oṃ ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku/ badz+ra dbyings gting mtha' med pa/ kī li kī la ya phur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can sgrol ba/ sarba yum gyi mkha'/ bighan nan yab kyi mkha' baṃ mkha' dbyings sbyor ba/ hūm̐ bud+dha'i thugs ye shes/ phaṭa khro bo khro mo spro ba'i don yin par gsungs pa yang slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa dang sbyar na/

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga ldan/ badz+ra dus gsum 'dus ma byas/ kī li lha dang phur bu gsor ba/ kī la ya 'debs pa/ sarba dgra bgegs thams cad/ bighan nan mnan pa/ baṃ hūm̐ dbang du bsdu ba/ phaṭa sgrol ba'i don yin par gsungs/ slob dpon bī ma la mi tras/ hūm̐ thugs ye shes lnga ldan/ badz+ra rdo rje dbyer med/ kī li phur pa/ kī la ya skye med 'gag med/ sarba nyon mongs pa ye shes su sgyur cig bigh+na nan ye shes kyis nyon mongs gzir cig baṃ dbang du bya ba/ hūm̐ nyon mongs choms shig phaṭa nyon mongs sregs shig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ slob dpon bal po shrī la mañdzus/ oṃ ye shes lnga/ badz+ra kī li rdo rje phur bu/ kī la ya 'debs pa/ sarba thams cad/ bighan nan phur bu'i ri rab kyis mnan pa/ baṃ dbang du bsdus pa/ hūm̐ sku bskyed pa/ phaṭa spro ba'o zhes gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i sngags gcig pu 'di la/ lha thams cad kyi gsang sngags 'dus tshul ni/ khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badz+ra shes rab yum yin no/ /kī ni ye shes khro bo la/ /li ni dbyings kyi khro mo bcu/ /kī ni thabs kyi mche ba can/ /la ni shes rab gshog pa can/ /ya ni sras mchog phur pa ste/ /hūm̐ ni phyag brnyan sgo ma bzhi/ /sarba thams cad 'dus pa ste/ /bighan dgra dang bgegs yin no/ /nan ni dgra dang bgegs mnan no/ /baṃ ni dbang du bsdus pa ste/ /hūm̐ ni rlag par byed pa'o/ /phaṭa ni bsgral ba'i phrin las rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i yon tan dpag med dang ldan pa'i snying po'i sngags brjod pas rgyu'i hūm̐ de 'od du zhu ba las/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa lhang ste bsgom/ de nas tshig gis gsal btab ste bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ gdan steng bdag nyid zhes pa nas ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs zhes pa'i bar brjod/

de dag skabs kyi dmigs pa che ba brjod pa dang bcas pa rnams las/ dang po ni dbus kyi gdan steng du bdag nyid thugs rje chen po sems can gyi don la khros pa khro bo kun gyi rgyal po/ phung po dang nyon mongs pa dang lha'i bu dang 'chi bdag gi bdud sde bzhi bcom la/ dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang ba/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs dang ldan/ /zhes yon tan drug dang ldan pa dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med rdo rje gzhon nu bgres rgud med pa'i sku/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas/ sku mdog mthing nag chos longs sprul gsum mtshon pa'i zhal gsum dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug mtshon pa'i phyag drug pa/ de yang g.yas zhal zla ba ltar dkar po g.yon nyi ma ltar dmar ba/ dbus nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar mthing ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang pos badz+ra he ru ka de bzhin du bud+dha/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ karma/ yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa/ sa nu/ guh+ya he ru ka ste he ru ka dgu dang / gzhan yang ye shes dgu mtshon pa'i rdo rje rtse dgu pas sa dgu man gyi rtog sgrib sbyong ba/ bar pas lam rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong zhing sku lnga ye shes lnga la sbyor rtags rdo rje rtse lnga dang / g.yon dang pos 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bskem zhing ma rig pa'i bud shing bsregs pa'i rtags su ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang / bar pas dug gsum rtsad nas bcad de sku gsum la sbyor ba'i rtags su kha ṭ+waṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa/ mdor na rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga/ me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis kyi phyag gis bsnams shing / phyag tha ma gnyis thabs shes gnyis med kyi sgo nas khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud cing thams cad zil gyis mnan nas log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol bar byed pa'i rtags su ri rab phur bu sgril ba/ nam mkha' khyon gang ba'i sku che la rags pa/

mngal sgong drod gsher brdzus pa ste/ skye gnas bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i zla tshes lta bu'i mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ g.yas kyi spyan gsum dag pa chos dbyings la gzigs pa/ g.yon gyi spyan gsum ma dag sems can la gzigs pa/ dbus kyi spyan gsum 'khor 'das mnyam nyid la gzigs pa/ mdor na nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan dgu zlum zhing dmar ba/ log lta'i 'gro ba dbyings su 'dren pa'i rtags su ral pa khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ gdul bya gti mug can 'dul ba dang / stobs bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags glang can gyi lpags pa/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba dang / tshul khrims rnam par dag rtags zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ zhe sdang can sogs 'dul dka' ba rnams 'dul ba la mchog tu dpa' ba'i rtags su stag gi lpags pa'i 'og pags can du byas pa/ klu rgyal rigs bram ze'i rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs bzhi dbang du sdud pa dang / phrin las bzhi mthar phyin pa'i rtags dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ljang khu/ nag po pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ de yang sbrul dkar khras dbu brgyan/ dmar khras se ral ga ljang khras sked bcing / nag khras phyag gi mkhrig ma dang / dpung pa dang / zhabs rnams rnam par spras pa/ chos sku skyon dang bral ba'i rtags thod skam/ rigs lnga mtshon pa'i rtags grangs lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i rtags thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i rtags rak+ta/ don dam bcud kyi brgyan pa'i rtags su zhag dang / mtshan ma dang spros pa med pa'i rtags thal chen gyi tshom bu ste/ de yang mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon rak+ta'i thig le/ nu ma gnyis bar zhag gi zo ris zla ba phyed pa 'dra ba/ skra mtshams su thal chen gyi tshom bur bris pa/ gser la sogs pa sna tshogs rin chen gyi dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs rnams mdzes par spras pa/

sbyin pa/ snyan par smra ba/ don spyod pa/ don mthun pa ste bsdu dngos bzhi'i rang bzhin zhabs bzhi las/ de yang g.yas gnyis bskums zhing / g.yon gnyis brkyangs nas/ rtag pa'i mtha' mnan pa'i phyir/ dbang phyug chen po kha sbubs kyi mgo po dang / chad pa'i mtha' mnan pa'i phyir lha mo u ma'i nu ma'i steng nas rab tu brdzis nas/ nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog ma lus pa bsregs pa'i rtags su ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang sgrub thabs nas ma gsungs kyang / rdo rje don gsal sogs nas gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ sprul pa du ma 'gyed pa'i rtags su sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ drag po'i rkan sgra rdebs pa'i ljags glog dmar ltar 'khyug pa/ khams gsum gyi sgra nye ring med par gsan pa'i rdo rje'i snyan dang rdog pa'i shang gsum nas dus kyi 'thor rlung dang bcas pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sgrogs pa/ khams gsum dus gcig tu za bar nus pa'i zhal nam mkha' ltar gdang ba/ gzhan yang srid gsum rlung gi rdeb byed thabs shes rang bzhin rdo rje'i khyung gshog nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa gdeng ba'o/ /'di rnams sgrub thabs su ma gsungs pa ni shugs byung du rtogs pa la dgongs pa yin la/ 'di yan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad khog don drug las/ dang po phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga yis sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba dang / gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gsum dang dkyil 'khor gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pas don gyi khog phub/ zhes gsungs pa'i/ dkyil 'khor gsum las bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yan bshad zin nas/ gsum pa khams gsum nas srog la dbang bskur te srog ye shes sems dpa' srog la dbang bskur zhes pa las/ rang gi phung po khams dang sogs nas go mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung tshig rnams brjod/

dmigs pa ni rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba des/ gzugs kyi phung po de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i tshor ba'i/ 'du shes kyi/ 'du byed kyi phung po ste/ phung po lnga dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams/ rna ba'i/ sna'i/ lce'i/ lus kyi/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams/ gzugs kyi khams dang / sgra'i/ dri'i/ ro'i/ reg gi chos kyi khams dang khams bco brgyad/ mig gi skye mched/ de bzhin du rna ba/ sna'i/ lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi skye mched/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ de bzhin du/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos kyi skye mched ste skye mched bcu gnyis dang / gzhan yang skra nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang / rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra ba zhal gsum phyag drug pas lus go mtshams med par gtams par gyur par bsam/ de nas snying rjes bsgral ba'i sogs nas rdo rjer bsgom zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ni/ snying rje zhes pa ni chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ste/ bsgral ba'i zhes pa rang tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams bsgral te ma dag pa sbyangs la/ dag pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur skyed cing bsgom pa'o/ /dam tshig ni zhes pa lha'i sku bsgom pa de las mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig go /de yang rang lha bskyed cing bsgom pa des tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog dag par byas pa de yang / zhe sdang gis bsad cing gti mug gis mnan pa lta bu ma yin te/ sgrub pa po'i phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa rnams rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi bdag nyid kyis gtams par byas shing / rnam par shes pa yang rdo rje bsgom pa ni thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar gsang sngags kyi bsgom pa ni/ bh+rūṃ bhi ma na zhes pa nas/ bigh+na nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung tshig sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/

rang dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang sor bzhi pa/ de yang bhi ma na ste dri ma med pa/ dbyibs zlum po sgo gcig pa mdun du bstan pa/ sgo srung rta mgrin yum bde ba rgyas byed ma/ rmongs byed ma/ tshe 'phel ma/ za byed ma ste gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom/ gzhal yang khang de'i nang du ma sur+ya zhes pa ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dz+nyā na satwa ces/ hūm̐ ni sa bon/ dz+nyā na ye shes/ satwa sems dpa' yin pas/ hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba tshon gang ba shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kriṣ+ṇa shū ka pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐ḥces pa'i/ hūm̐ ni sa bon/ kriṣ+ṇa nag po/ shū ka rtse mo/ pañtsa lnga/ badz+ra rdo rje yin pas/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyis mtshan pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+na nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa skra shad kyi bris pa lta bus bskor ba gsal ba ste/ de ni 'chi med srog gi lung ngam thugs ye shes su bsgom pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag gis bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab tshad rdzogs par bskyed pa bstan zin nas/ de nas yum bskyed pa ni/ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥces brjod/ sngags don ni/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ dīp+ta 'bar ba/ tsakra 'khor lo/ ha na bsnun te 'khor lo 'bar bas bsnun bsnun/ zhes pa'i don yin la/ de ni sngags kyi sgo nas bskyed pa yin gsung / tshig gi sgo nas gsal btab pa ni/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhes pa nas yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs zhes pa'i bar brjod/ dmigs pa che ba dang brjod pa dang bcas pa ni/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum chen mo khams gsum 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas 'debs ma/ dbyings las ma g.yos sku mdog sngo sangs/

chos kun ro gcig pa'i zhal gcig dang / bden gnyis thabs shes mtshon pa'i phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pas thod pa zla ba ltar dkar ba khrag chen gyi gang ba yab la snyom pa/ ye shes kyi spyod pa rdzogs zhing thugs rje glog ltar myur ba'i stag gzig gi lpags ba'i sham thabs can/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i phyir rus pa'i rgyan lngas mthing kha'i sku la rab tu brgyan pa thod skam nas thal chen gyi tshom bu'i bar che brjod yab dang 'dra'o/ /thabs shes kyi rang bzhin zhabs gnyis las g.yas thabs snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rtags thur du brkyang ba/ g.yon shes rab dbyings su rtogs pa'i brdar bskum zhing yab la 'khyud pa/ sku bde ba chen po'i yab la mnyam par sbyor nas sku stod yab kyi g.yon phyogs nas 'khyud de bzhugs par bsgom/ de yang rang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dīp+ta tsakra'i sngags phreng spros nas shangs bug g.yon nas thon/ sku'i g.yon phyogs su 'od du zhu ba las gong du brjod pa ltar gsal 'debs pa yin la/ de ltar yum de yang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom par gsungs so/ /tshul stong gsal de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin de dran par byas la/ gdos bcas lta bu ma yin pa me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan nam nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar gsal stong zung 'jug tu bsgom par gsungs so/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can la phog pas thams cad lhar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas 'od zer phar 'phros don de dag byas nas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ bcas pas 'od zer tshur bsdus nas rang la thim ste/

snod bcud thams cad dam tshig pa'i lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsgom/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa can/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung 'thib pa ltar dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par bsam pa ni/ dmigs pa yid kyi+i sgo nas spyan drangs pa yin la/ tshig gi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ de yang srid pa 'khor ba gong du kun rdzob rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs su gyur pa rnams/ don dam pa ye shes khro bo'i lha tshogs su grub par mdzod/ zhes tshig gi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa yin la/ de yang chos nyid rang sgra'i sgo nas ye shes sems dpa' bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa rnams la'o/ /de nas gsang sngags kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sarba ta thā ga tā sa pa ri wa ra sa ma dzaḥzhes pa sngags don/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya zhes pa la ni gong du bshad zin la/ sarba thams cad/ ta thā ga tā de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa pa ri wa ra 'khor dang bcas pa/ sa ma dzaḥni dam tshig gis gshegs zhes pa ste/ de ltar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i skabs 'di/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum rkyang pa'i ye shes pa yin la/ de nas mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' rang la bstim pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥces brjod/ dmigs pa ni rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin mo mdog dkar pu shud kyi mgo can lcags kyu dang phur pa thogs pa dpag med spros nas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams su dgug par bsam/ sngags don ni/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi rdo rje gnod sbyin mas ye shes lha dgug ces pa'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje 'jigs byed ma mdog ser bya rog mgo can zhags pa dang /

phur pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la gzhug par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra bhe ra bi hūm̐ hūm̐ ces brjod pas/ sngags don dmigs rim gyi khong na yod pas ma bris so/ /yang rdo rje bdud rtsi ma mdog dmar srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrogs dang phur bu thogs pa dpag med kyis bstim zhing dam ye 'dres par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra a mri ta hūm̐ bam̐/ zhes brjod/ yang rdo rje gsod byed ma mdog ljang khra'i mgo can dril bu dang phur pa thogs pa dpag med kyis ye shes pa rnams mnyes par mdzad pas dam tshig pa yang ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ni hūm̐ hoḥces brjod/ de dag ni ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug pa'o/ /de nas nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlab pa ni/ rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku zhes pa nas/ tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gting mtha' med pa'i sku/ bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du rnam par 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa'i sku yi gter du bdag bskyed la/ byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba btab/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nam mkha' gang ba spros pas/ sku'i lha tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po la thim pas lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ ces pa te/ sngags don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes pa'i nga rgyal bzung / de bzhin gsung dang thugs gnyis la sku zhes pa'i tshab du gsung dang /

thugs bcug pa ma gtogs dmigs pa gong dang 'dra/ nga rgyal bzung ba yang sku gsung thugs khyad par ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /de nas sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa ni/ gsang sngags thabs kyi spyod pas sems can gyi don byams dang snying rjes gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas bya ba'i phyir bdag la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ma lus pa rdzogs par mdzod/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba ma lus pa mi gnas myang 'das kyi sa la 'god pa yin pas/ de bas na bdag la khams gsum dus gcig sgrol nus pa'i dbang dang zad mi shes pa'i byin rlabs dus 'di nyid du stsol cig zhes gsol ba snying nas btab pas/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga byon nas thabs dang shes rab kyi chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbur brgyan par bsam zhing rang rang gi sngags dang bstun te gsal gdab pa ni dbus su badz+ra he ru ka de bzhin du dpral ba'i phyogs su bud+dha/ sna ltag g.yas su rat+na/ ltag pa'i phyogs su pad+ma/ rna ltag g.yon du karma he ru ka yab yum ste zhal gtso bo la phyogs pa/ gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /de yang 'dir thub dbang gnyis pa sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar thug pa/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung / /rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin/ /gal te de ni 'khrul gyur na/ /dngos grub med pa rgyud las gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don go sla'o/ /de rnams kyis bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan zin nas/ ༈ /phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/

'di 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras dang tshul mthun par bshad dgos par gsungs pa las/ 'dir tshigs su bcad de cung zad bshad na/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras/ pha ma'i rgyud bzang rigs rus chos 'brang ldan/ /sras mchog 'dir yang chos longs sprul gsum gyi/ /ngo bo dbu gsum phyag drug yang na ni/ /dbu gcig phyag bzhi sku smad phur bu yi/ /dbal can sku gsum klong nas bskyed bya ste/ /de yang phur pa gsang rgyud las/ 'dir ni dbu gsum phyag drug dang / /zhal gcig phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ /de las med pa ngas ma bshad/ /ces dang / lte ba man chad sku smad ni/ /sngo bsang mi bzad 'joms pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar 'khor los sgyur rgyal rigs skyes kyang / /'khor dang longs spyod med na dman pa ltar/ /'dir yang sku gsum klong nas rab bskyed kyang / /lha tshogs rdzas ma tshang na sras mchog min/ /des na phur pa'i rtsibs gzhogs dbus ldir bar/ /bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang bskyed de'i nang du/ /gtso bo yab yum bsgom zhing rtsibs gzhogs brgyad/ /phyogs mtshams khro bo yab yum za gsod bcas/ /bskyed cing de bzhin rgya mdud gong ma'i nang / /hūm̐ kar yab yub mgo brnyan bcas par bskyed/ /rgya mdud 'og ma'i nang du stobs po che/ /yab yum sprul pa dang bcas tshul bzhin bsgom/ /rgya mdud 'og ma'i logs bzhir sgo ma bzhi/ /dbal gyi logs su phur srung bcu gnyis bskyed/ /rgya mdud gong ma'i logs bzhi steng rnams su/ /rigs lnga gtso bo'i dbu rgyan tshul du bskyed/ /de yang gsang rgyud las/ sku gcig ngang las dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs/ /logs brgyad rang bzhin khro bo brgyad/ /zur brgyad 'byung ba'i khro mo brgyad/ /steng 'og lha'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sgyur rgyal 'khor dang ldan yang gzi chung na/ /rgyal por mi tshud de bzhin sras mchog kyang /

/lha tshogs tshang yang sku gsung thugs ye shes/ /gcig tu ma brlabs mchog tu mi 'gyur bas/ /dbal gyi zur gsum hūm̐ gsum logs gsum du/ /phaṭa gsum rtse mor a dkar gcig bcas pas/ /ye shes gcig gi ngo bor bsgom dgos te/ /rgyud las/ logs la phaṭa gsum bzhag pa yin/ /zur gsum hūm̐ gsum bzhag pa yin/ /zhes so/ /yang / gzi brjid ldan yang rgyal por dbang ma bskur/ /rgyal por mi tshud de bzhin sras mchog kyang / /rigs lnga'i dbang ma bskur na sras mchog min/ /de yang rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil/ /nyi dkyil steng du hūm̐ las kun bzang bskyed/ /g.yon pa zla dkyil a las kun bzang mo/ /bskyed la g.yas sor lnga la nyi dkyil steng / /rigs lnga'i sa bon lnga las rigs lnga bskyed/ /g.yon sor lnga la a las zla dkyil steng / /yum lnga'i sa bon lnga las yum lnga bsgom/ /de ltar yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems/ /sras mchog la thim dbang bskur bsam bya ste/ /gsang rgyud las/ lag g.yas mthil du nyi dkyil las/ /kun bzang 'od dang bcas pa bskyed/ /g.yon gyi a las zla dkyil du/ /kun tu bzang mo a las bskyed/ /gung mo rnam par snang mdzad de/ /mthe bong la ni mi bskyod pa/ /mdzub mo rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /srin lag don yod grub pa ste/ /mthe'u chung snang ba mtha' yas so/ /g.yon pa lnga la yum lnga'o/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug dus/ /sor mo cung zad bsnol bar bya/ /phur pa 'dril bar bya ba yin/ /zhes so/ /des ni bdag nyid chen po'i dbang bskur yin/ /de nas rigs kun khro bo'i dbang bskur ni/ /bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las sprul pa'i/ /khro bo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa sgra 'byin pa/ /dpag med byung ste sras mchog la thim pas/ /khams gsum dus gcig sgrol ba'i nus pa dang / /mthu rtsal ldan gyur khro bo'i dbang bskur yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid rdzogs dbang ni/

/rang gi lag gnyis chu srin rnam grol gyi/ /phyag rgyas sras mchog phur bu bzung byas te/ /rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum byang sems las/ /phyag mtshan phra mo grangs med spros thim pas/ /bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu dang sras mchog /gcig tu bsgoms la sku gsung thugs bdag nyid/ /rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur yin zhes mkhas pas gsungs/ /chu srin rnam grol phyag rgya gsang rgyud las/ /de dus sor mo rgyab tu bsnol/ /gung mo gnyis po rab tu bsgrengs/ /de yi bar du phur bu gzhug /de nas sor mo pad 'drar bya/ /kha ma phye ba'i tshul du ni/ /lag mthil bar du phur pa 'dril/ /ces so/ /yang / dbang bskur thob kyang bsod nams tshad med dang / /mi ldan pa zhig rgyal por mi tshul ltar/ /sras mchog 'di yang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ /dgos pas sras mchog de yi spyi bor oṃ/ /mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar hūm̐ bsam ste/ /de las 'od 'phros sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ /spro bsdu'i tshul gyis byin gyis rlabs dgos so/ /dmag la 'byon tshe go cha gyon dgos ltar/ /sras mchog 'di la pe ta li yi sngags/ /brjod cing dkar nag yung gis brab pa'i lus/ /khro bo chung gis go mtshams med bltams pas/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la mngags par bsam/ /de yang rgyud las/ khro bo'i rgyal po bskul ba'i phyir/ /yungs nag byin rlabs khro chung bskyed/ /ces gsungs so/ /pe ta la'i sngags ni/ pe ta li man+dha li rag sha zhes pa dang / yang ma ku la ha la zhes gu gul gyi sngags so/ /yang go cha gyon tsam gyis mi chog pas/ /mtshon cha rnon po thogs dgos ltar/ 'dir yang sngags bzlas gu gul bdug dpa' dang mi zad ngar ldan bsam/ /de yang rgyud las/ phur pa ngar rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ /lce sog nag po'i dud pas bdug /ces dang / byin gyis brlab cing dbang yang bskur/ /gu gul bdug cing yungs dkar gdabs/ /byin brlab dbang bskur shin tu gces/

/zhes pa ltar yin la/ yang mtshon cha rnon po dgra la theb dgos ltar/ /rak+tas byug pa'i phur pa dmar nag dud/ /reg pas 'joms pa gcig tu bsam bya ste/ /yang rgyud las/ gdug pa brlag par bya ba'i phyir/ /ra khyi phag pa'i khrag gis byug /ces so/ /yang / rgyal po phas kyi g.yul las rgyal gyur te/ /dgra yi g.yul sa thams cad theb dgos ltar/ /dam tshig brten pas dgra dang bgegs kyi snying / /dkar nag mtshams su gdab par bya ba yin/ /de yang rgyud las/ gnad chen thams cad 'dus pa yi/ /dkar nag mtshams su gdab par bya/ /zhes bshad do/ /de ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / /rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas chos mtshungs pa'i/ /sras mchog de'i grangs la du zhe na/ /rgyas pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang 'bring po la/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig gam ni yang na lnga/ /tha ma badz+ra bsdus pa gcig yin gsungs/ /de la ming gi rnam grangs bsnyen phur dang / /rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor dang ni sras mchog zer/ /bsnyen phur bsnyen pa'i nus pa gsog phyir dang / /rdzas dkyil zhes pa lha dang byin rlabs rnams/ /'dus pa'i phyir na rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /sras mchog ces pa dpal chen thugs kyi sras/ /dkyil 'khor lus rdzogs phrin las thams cad byed/ /sras gyur khro bcu bas kyang ches lhag pa/ /de bas sras mchog zhes su rgyal bas bshad/ /ji skad du yang / rtsa ba'i thugs la bskyed pa'i phyir/ /sgrol byed sras su bshad pa yin/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba la/ /mngags pas mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /phrin las kun rdzogs rgyal po'i sde/ /sras mchog chen po zhes byar brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /de lta'i sras mchog gzhal yas khang shes dang / /lha ru shes dang phyag mtshan shes pa gsum/ /dang po rtse mo zur gsum nam mkha' dang / /logs gsum zla gam rlung dkyil de steng gi zlum po chu dkyil rgya mdud 'og ma yi/ /'od zer me dkyil 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang /

/rgya mdud gnyis bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang / rgya mdud gong ma rgya phib tshul 'dug pas/ /sras mchog gzhal yas khang du shes par bya/ /gnyis pa sras mchog lha ru shes pa ni/ /dbus kyi khong seng dpal chen yab yum sogs/ /lha tshogs bskyed pa gong du bshad pa yi/ /don rnams dran la lha ru shes par gyis/ /gsum pa sras mchog phyag mtshan shes pa ni/ /lha tshogs kun gyi phyag gis bsnams pa yi/ /phur bu thams cad sras mchog 'di yin gsungs/ /de yang dper na 'dzam gling bye ba brgyar/ /sprul pa bye ba phrag brgyas don mdzad ltar/ /'di yang ye shes sprul pa yin pas so/ /'di nyid bdag gis sras mchog bskyed pas na/ /sras mchog phur bu zhes pa'i mtshan yang gsol/ /bdag gi tshe dang ye shes 'dis sbyin pas/ /sras mchog gi ni phur pa zhes bshad do/ /de ltar sras mchog phur bu'i bshad pa 'di/ /mkhas grub 'ga' yis gsung dang khyad par du/ /kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /dri med gsung rab rnam bshad chen mo nas/ /ji ltar bshad pa'i gnad rnams ma 'khrul bar/ /bsdus nas yi ge nyung phyir tshogs su bcad/ /zhes bshad pa'o/ /de lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces sogs tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las yi ge e chad de/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces brjod pas e lngar spros pa gsungs kyang / 'dir phur chung gi dbang du byas pas e gcig spros mdun gyi phur gdan la thim pas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ sarba sha trun bigha nan dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor nang du dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam zhing / phur pa gu gul gyis bdug cing / a mṛ ta bzlas pas bsangs/ kī la ya'i sngags brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab/ sarba bigha nan rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣas bgegs bsrungs shing mthu dang ldan par bsam mo/

/de nas lha bskyed pa ni/ skye med rnam dag sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa tshig don dang bcas pa ni/ don dam pa skye ba med pa chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang skye ba'i cho 'phrul log lta tshar gcod rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku ston pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/ sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya yi rnam pas/ 'khor ba srid pa 'di dag myang 'das rdo rje phur bu sgrub pa'i phyir du/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs shig zhes dmigs pa dang bcas pas bskul bas/ chos sku skye ba med pa'i mkha' klong nas/ longs sku he ru ka yab yum sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal lam ste bzhengs pa bsgom/ de nas longs sku las sprul sku bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ dbus kyi mthing nag sogs gzhung rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i dus longs sku de dran/ de'i zhing dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i dbyings de nas rdo rje'i rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya khyed/ zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i slad du khro bo'i rgyal po'i rnam pas dbyings nas bzhengs shig bzhengs nas kyang srid gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir du/ rnal 'byor pas bshams shing bskyed pa'i phur gdan mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs shig badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥzhes bskul bas longs sku de'i sku smad phur pa dbal kha can du gyur te sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can du bzhengs te/ skad cig de la 'od dang 'od zer 'khrugs pa dang bcas pa ste/ rang gi bsnyen phur de la thim par bsgom/

de nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bsnyen phur sras mchog de nyid sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag g.yas dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me dpung dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis kyis phur bu 'dril ba/ lte ba man chad chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drag po'i dbal kha zur gsum rno ngar dang ldan pa/ mdog ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma dang 'dra ba la/ mgar gyi so mal nas bton ma thag pa ltar me stag dmar chil chil du 'phro ba/ zhal mche ba gtsegs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa la/ zhal dbus kyi spyan g.yon pa cung zad rang gi phur pa la gzigs pa/ ral pa zur gsum gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul gyis bcings pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras shing rdo rje'i khyung rab tu gdengs nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na mngon sum ltar bzhugs pa bsgom/ de nas de'i spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrīḥ/ rtse mor phaṭa gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ de nas badz+ra sa ma dzaḥzhes pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sras mchog rigs lnga yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes pas yum rnams kyis bskul/ sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes pas yab rnams kyis gnang ste yab yum snyoms par sbyor ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pa dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥces brjod pas yab yum thams cad sbyor ba'i bde ba chen pos 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas sras mchog la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar dbang lha rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs nas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka zhes sogs kyi sngags don dran pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang rgyas gdabs pa sogs ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/

/de nas lha des bdag mthu dang ldan pa bsgrub pa ni/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge ma gcig spros/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas/ lag g.yas pa'i mthil du ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar chil le ba gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ yang thugs ka nas a gcig spros/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la zhes brjod pas/ g.yon pa'i mthil du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skya chil le ba gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ hūm̐ a zhes brjod pas nyi steng hūm̐ dang zla steng du a bsgom/ oṃ hūm̐ swāḥ.āḥhā/ zhes brjod pas lag g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la sa bon de lnga las byung ba'i rigs lnga me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bsgom/ saṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ zhes brjod pas g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la sa bon de lnga las yum lnga me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bsgom/ de nas sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes yum rnams kyis bskul/ lag pa mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐ zhes brjod/ yab yum bcu snyoms par zhugs/ badz+ra ban+dha badz+ra añdza li dzaḥzhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya byas te yab yum phan tshun bde ba chen por ro gcig tu gyur nas sbyor mtshams nas khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa grangs med byung ste/ lag mthil g.yas kyi hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa dang / g.yon pa'i a las pad+ma a yis mtshan par bsam la/ khro chung rnams hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sgra sgrogs pa dang bcas te/ thabs shes kyi ngo bo lag mthil gyi rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa dang / pad+ma a dang bcas pa la thim par bsam la thal mo phral/ slar yang rdo rje thal mo byas la yab yum bcu'i sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i khro chung rnams hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sgra sgrogs pa dang bcas pas sras mchog phur bu la thim pas phur pa'i sku lus go mtshams med par khro bo chung gis bltams par bsam pa ni mthu ldan du bsgrub pa'o/

/de nas chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas phur pa bzungs la/ dip+ta tsakra sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ dang po dip+ta tsakra zhes pa ni 'khor lo 'bar ba zhes brjod pa yin pas 'di badz+ra kī la ya yin pa la 'khor lo 'bar ba zer ba ci yin snyam na/ rnam pa mi bskyod pa yin yang ngo bo rnam snang sogs rigs lnga thams cad 'dus pa la dgongs pa yin gsungs so/ /de na dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo sku mdog mthing nag baiḍūr sngon po g.ya' dag pa'i lhun po ltar la/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can gcer bu ral pa 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ de yang sku stod khro bo chen po la g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba'i zhal gsum dang / 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan gyis spras pa'i phyag kyang drug pa ste/ dbu rgyan la khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs pa/ lte ba man chad sku yi cha ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra ba la ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rnam pa lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa mi bzad pa'i rno ngar dang ldan pa/ de ni las mngon dpyod drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ 'di btab na tshangs pa dang rgya byin la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyang thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur na/ rnal 'byor pa la gnod cing bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs mnar med du 'gro nges pa rnams la btab na skad cig de la tshar gcod cing rjes su 'dzin pa smos ci dgos/ zhes pa'i dmigs pa yid la dran zhing gzhung tshig rnams brjod pa ni phur pa nus mthu bskyed pa'i tshig brjod pa'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs sngags rnams brjod/ phyag rgya rnams ni phyag len ltar shes par bya'o/ /badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pa rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur zhes pa dang / de bzhin du budha a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pa sangs rgyas mngon par dbang bskur sogs go sla bas shes par bya'o/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ zhes pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skus mngon par dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub stsol zhes pa'i don yin pas/ de bzhin du gsung dang thugs zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs don 'dra bas go sla'o/ /dmigs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang dang mthu rtsal dang sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa byin rlabs thams cad kyi dbang bskur bas khro bo khro mo sogs lha tshogs thams cad kyi 'phrin las bdag la 'dus par bsgom mo/ /de nas phur pa phur gdan gyi steng du zhal rang la phyogs nas bzhag go /de yan gyi phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan zin nas/ ༈ /de nas mchod yul spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa spros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum/ yang sprul phra phyag nyi shu/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga ste lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dam can ma mo sde gsum/ gzhan yang ging chen bco brgyad/ ging phran 'bum sde/ dpag bsam shing gi lha mo dang re ma ti dang / gzhan yang gur zhal dkar bdud lcam dral la sogs pa/ rang gi srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas shing oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥces brjod la rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu bsil/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig dang / yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang bcas pa dang / gang de'i sprul pa khro bcu yab yum/

sprul pa'i yang sprul za bsod nyi shu/ nying sprul bka' bsdod srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ glog ltar myur ba'i tshul gyi thugs rje'i stobs kyis bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas/ sems can gyi don du bdag la badz+ra kī la ya yi dngos grub mchog de myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod pas lha tshogs de rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar khra thib be byon pa la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas bris thang sogs mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams la sib kyis thim par bsgom/ de nas zhabs bsil dang gdan 'phul ba ni/ yang dag don du sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ mchod yul khyad par can khyed rnams rang bzhin gyi gdod ma nas yang dag par nges pa'i don du dri ma mtha' dag dag mod kyang / bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma dag pa'i don gyi slad du/ khyed rnams kyis phyag dang zhabs rnams snying rje'i shugs kyis bsil nas kyang / gzhom bral rdo rje'i gdan la dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes bsam la oṃ shrī he ru ka sogs sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don ni/ he ru ka 'khor bcas phyag dang zhabs bsil so sor bzhes te rdo rje'i gdan la so sor bzhugs zhes pa'o/ /dmigs pa yang de bzhin du bsgom pa'o/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ bde bar gshegs so zhes pa lha tshogs spyi dang bye brag gtso bo la khro rgyal gtso zhes bos nas/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyis/ ma dag srid pa'i rgya mtsho snod bcud kyi dngos po mtha' yas kun/ dag pa kun bzang gi mchod sprin mchog tu bsgyur te rol par mdzad/ ces bsam la na maḥsogs sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don ni/

phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sna tshogs gdong rnams la thams cad du nam mkha' la rjes su song zhing 'phro ba nam mkha'i chu zungs zhig 'di longs/ zhes pa'o/ /dmigs pa ni ma dag srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa 'di rnams dag pa gzhal yas khang dang lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du bsgyur te 'bul ba'o/ /de nas mchod yul khyad par can de rnams la rab tu dgyes pa'i phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ sgeg phreng sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi snying kha nas rdo rje sgeg mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu dku g.yas g.yon du sgeg pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas brgyan pa/ grangs dpag tu med pas mchod pa la dga' zhing spro ba'i blos mchod pa byas shing / de bzhin du rdo rje phreng ba mas me tog dang nor bu la sogs pa'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan par byas te mchod/ rdo rje glu mas gsang ba'i snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs shing mchod/ rdo rje gar mas rab tu mdzes pa'i gar sna tshogs sgyur cing mchod/ de bzhi ni nang gi lha mo'o/ /phyi'i lha mo bzhi ni/ rdo rje bdug pa mas bdug spos dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis tshim par byas pas tshul gyis mchod/ me tog mas ut+pa la sogs pa me tog sna tshogs kyis mchod/ mar me mas rab tu gsal ba'i mar me dang / dri chab mas dri sna tshogs pas gang ba'i dri chu'i dung chos/ gzhan yang pi waṃ gling bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag dang / yang puṣ+pe mas me tog gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa dang / bdug spos mas bdug pa'i spor phor/ mar me mas mar me'i sdong bu/ dri chab mas dri chus gang ba'i dud chos/ ro mas shing thog la sogs pa zhal zas sna tshogs pas gang ba'i snod/ gzhan yang rdza rnga rnga zlum la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag dang reg mas na bza'/
