dbyings mas chos 'byung la sogs pa/ mdor na mdzes shing yid 'ong nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mchod rdzas dpag med thogs pa'i lha mo de rnams kyang 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang mdzes pa'i sku lus mchog tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa/ gcig dang gnyis dang brgya dang stong la sogs pa ma yin pa/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs dang mtha' med pa ste/ mdor na nam mkha'i khams thams cad bskang nas/ skyabs gnas mchod pa'i yul bsod nams kyi zhing mchog gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ bdag nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba dang / mdun du spyan drangs pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can srung mar bcas pa rnams la/ rnam dag blo yis mos blos bdag rab tu gus pas 'bul lags na/ thugs bdag la brtse ba chen pos bzhes shig bzhes nas kyang kī la ya yi dngos grub sku gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid stsol cig ces bsam zhing bsgom la/ la s+ye hūm̐ sogs sngags rnams phyag rgya dang bcas te brjod/ sngags don ni/ rdo rje sgeg mo sogs yin pas go sla'o/ /de ltar gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas te mchod pas mchod yul rnams thugs rab tu mnyes pas/ rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa byang zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bsam mo/ /de nas rtsa ba'i mchod pa gsum gyi nang tshan bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ thog mar rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi ngos la hrīḥlas rta mgrin dang / srin lag la a las yum bdud rtsi ma bskyed cing bsgom/ mtheb srin sbyar bas yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ lha mo thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa spros/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi de nas bdud rtsi thod pa gang bar blangs te/ mdzes pa'i gar dang rnam 'gyur dang bcas pas mchod yul rnams la thun mong du 'bul ba dang so sor phul ba dang dngos grub blangs pa'i phyir/

slar yang 'bul ba rnams las dang po thun mong du 'bul ba ni/ rang byung sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ dang po rang byung ni snod bhan+dha/ rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes rig pa byang chub kyi sems rnams rang byung yin par gsungs so/ /gdod nas dag pa zhes pa ni sman bdud rtsi gdod nas dag pa nad sel ba/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi gdod nas dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor/ don bdud rtsi gdod nas dag pa 'khor ba dang myang 'das gnyis su med pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / rtsa brgyad ces pa ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad dam/ yang na nyan rang gnyis theg dman yin pas gcig tu brtsis te theg pa rim brgyad la chos bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad ces bya la/ sdong po/ yal ga shun pa/ lo ma/ me tog 'dab ma/ 'bras bu/ snying po brgyad la sman bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad ces bya zhing / dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems/ sha chen/ rak+ta/ chang / chu/ rin po che brgyad la rdzas bdud rtsi brgyad gsungs shing / stong las sbyar ba'i sman zhes pa ni/ rtsa ba brgyad po de las gyes pa'i sman yal ga stong la 'jog par bshad la/ rigs lnga zhes pa ni/ byang sems rdo rje rigs/ dri chen de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ sha chen rin chen rigs/ rak+ta pad+ma'i rigs/ dri chu las kyi rigs rnams yin par bshad cing / dam tshig lnga zhes pa ni bdud rtsi lnga po bsten pa'i phan yon bstan pa ste/ de yang byang sems kyis tshe ring ba dang / dri chen gyis stobs che zhing / sha chen gyis mthu che ba dang / rak+tas kha dog 'dzin zhing / dri chus skad snyan pa'i yon tan bskyed par gsungs la/ ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas zhes pa ni/ byang sems la stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rdzogs shing / dri chen la me long lta bu'i ye shes rdzogs la/ sha chen la mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rdzogs shing / rak+ta la so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rdzogs la/ dri chu la bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rdzogs par bshad pa'i don yin la/

de ltar ye shes lnga po des sems can rnams sgrol gsungs shing / rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol phyir/ /gsungs pa ni rnams snang sku'i rgyud kyis gti mug sgrol/ rdor sems thugs kyi rgyud kyis zhe sdang sgrol/ rin 'byung yon tan rgyud kyis nga rgyal sgrol/ snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi rgyud kyis 'dod chags sgrol/ don grub 'phrin las rgyud kyis phrag dog sgrol/ ces so/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di zhes pa ni/ chos bdud rtsis nyon mongs pa dug lnga sel zhing / sman bdud rtsis rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i dug lnga sel ba yin la/ rdzas bdud rtsi rnam par rtog pa'i dug lnga sel zhing / don bdud rtsis bdag gi rtag chad mu bzhi'i dug lnga sel bar gsungs shing / de ltar yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par ldan pa'i bdud rtsi de nyid 'bul ba'i yul ni/ ji snyed nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po thams cad la/ thugs dam chos kyi dbyings nas thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par bzhugs pa/ sku gsung thugs bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid du rol zhing bzhugs pa de rnams la/ bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum dad cing / gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ mchod yul dam pa khyed rnams kyis brtse bas bzhes te/ kun tu dges pa chen por mdzod la/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ gsung kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul gyi dngos grub ma lus pa bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing mtheb srin gyis/ bdud rtsi gtor la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā sogs/ sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don ni/ na maḥzhes bya ba/ ta thā ga tā de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ shrī dpal/ ka pā la thod pa/

ma hā chen po/ pañtsa lnga/ a mri ta bdud rtsi yin zhing / kha gsum 'byung ba ni/ dang po brjod dus snang srid mchod rdzas su bsam pa dang / gnyis pa brjod dus mchod rdzas de yang bdud rtsir bsam pa dang / khā hi zhes brjod pa'i tshe+e/ mchod rdzas de lha rnams kyis gsol bar bsam par bya ba yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa so sor 'bul ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / kun bzang rigs lnga dpal chen khrag 'thung yab yum sogs rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa rnams dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas mtsho rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms la sogs pa/ bla ma'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa ma lus pa dang / dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum ste/ mchod yul bla na med pa de rnams la/ rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod/ bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ dges shing bzhes nas thugs rjes bdag sogs khams gsum sems can la cher dgongs te/ bdag la khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol ba'i dbang dang / mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du stsol/ zhes bsam zhing / bdud rtsi gtor la sngags brjod/ sngags don dmigs pa gong dang 'dra/ yang 'jig rten 'jigs par byed pa bdud dang / gshin rje la sogs pa dregs pa can mtha' dag cher 'jigs par byed pa chen po ye shes khro bcu yab yum dang / de dag gis sprul pa'i phra thabs yab za byed 'bar ba'i mche ba can/ yum gsod byed myur ba'i gshog pa can te yab yum nyi shu dang / tshad med rnams bzhi'i las mdzad ye shes sgo ma bzhi dang / dug lnga'i bdud 'dul sras mchog phur pa'i tshogs rnams la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi sogs tshig don/ dmigs pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /dpal gyi 'khor tshogs dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs/ phyi dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma rgyu ba'i gnas rnams su bzhugs pa dang /

nang rtsa dang thig le la gnas pa sogs/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / rnam par 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba'i btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po la sogs pa ging chen bco brgyad/ ging phran 'bum sde dang / dpag bsam gyi shing la gnas bcas pa'i/ lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug dang / dregs pa mo brgyud kyi gtso mo dpal ldan re ma ti rnams la/ rnam dag sogs gong bzhin 'dra'o/ /shwa na mu kha mched bzhi dang / bdag nyid chen mo mched bzhi dang / bse'i lha mo mched bzhi dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma'i tshogs dang / legs nyes btang 'dzin dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang / mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams la/ rnam dag sogs gong ltar brjod/ slar yang dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ drin can rtsa ba'i sogs/ tshig brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor/ tshig don dmigs pa go sla'o/ /dngos grub blang ba dngos ni/ dang por rang gi lce thog tu bdud rtsi bzhag cing myang / byang chub mchog tu sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod cing / tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus par stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ bdud rtsi dpral bar bzhag pas/ oṃ yig tu gyur/ de la bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku yi byin rlabs thams cad bstim/ de rang la thim pas sku'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ de bzhin du wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥzhes brjod pas/ mgrin par bdud rtsi reg pas āḥyig tu gyur/ de la gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'dus par bsam/ de rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsung gi dngos grub thob par bsgom/ yang tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi snying khar bzhag pas hūṃ yig tu gyur/

de la thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'dus/ de rang gi snying khar thim pas/ thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo/ /de yan gyis bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba bstan zin to/ /de nas bla med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ 'di so thar gyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang bas/ nyan thos sogs skye bo blo chung ba rnams la/ gsang dgos pas gsang mchod ces bya ba yin la/ 'di ni dman pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba zab mo sngags kyi spyod pa yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rigs kyi bu dman pa'i 'du shes dang / smad pa'i 'du shes de lta bu ma bskyed cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste sngags kyi spyod pa ni spyod pa'i mchog go /'di lta ste/ sngags kyi spyod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zab mo rdo rje theg pa 'dir ni 'dod chags chen po dang / zhe sdang chen po'i sgo nas/ chags sdang rang sar dag pa byed pa ni/ sbyor sgrol yin la/ des sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed pas zab mo sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa zhes bya'o/ /de 'bul ba ni/ 'khril pa'i sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ thabs shes rab phan tshun 'khril ba'i tshul gyis mchod pa chen po bde ba mnyam du sbyor ba'i phyir/ thabs yab dang / shes rab yum gnyis su med pa'i yum gyi pad+mo la ni/ yab kyi rdo rje zhugs te/ sbyor ba mdzad pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kun gyi bdag nyid rnal 'byor yab yum/ bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes pas/ de bzhin du/ rgyal ba thams cad kyang mnyes par byos shig ces pa'i don dran la gzhung tshig sngags dang bcas pa brjod pa ni/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa ni/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas sogs/ gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de yang mnyam pa la gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi mnyam pa dang / spyad pa las kyi mnyam pa'o/

/rang bzhin gyi mnyam pa ni/ dam rdzas lnga dang ye shes lnga la bzang ngan med pa/ snang stong gnyis med kyi ngang bzhin du mnyam pa ni/ rang bzhin mnyam pa yin la/ bcad pa las kyi mnyam pa ni rgyud las/ sems can rtog pa bzlog phyir dman/ /gtso bor dam du blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gtsang rme'i rtog pa zlog nas/ mnyam pa nyid du longs spyod pa ni/ bcad pa las kyi mnyam pa yin te/ mnyam pa de yang chos nyid rang bzhin gyis grub pa/ chos can rang gi ngo bos grub pa/ mthus grub pa/ byin rlabs kyis grub pa ste/ grub pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i rdzas chen po bdud rtsi lnga po 'di dag la sogs pa rnams/ bdag dam tshig pa dang lha ye shes pa mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'khor gsum dag pas 'bul gyi/ de yang 'khor gsum yongs dag ni/ dbul bya/ 'bul byed/ dbul rgyu'i dngos po gsum du 'dzin pa las grol te/ bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba ste ro'i bye brag rnams dang / 'jam zhing yang ba'i reg bya gos dang / gzhan yang gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa la sogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ longs spyod lnga ldan mchod pa'i lha mor sprul pa rnams kyang / chu la chu thim pa'i tshul du dam ye gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag la ni/ mchod pa'i lha mor byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'dod yon gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid gnyis su med par thim pas/ thams cad rang sems stong pa'i ngang du bsgom pa'o/ /de nas a la la zhes ngo mtshar ba'i sgra ste/ 'dod yon mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor/ mchod yul rnams la thim/ de yang rang rig phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du thim pa 'di ngo mtshar che'o/ /zhes don rnams bsgom la gzhung tshig sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ de dag ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /de nas bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo khro mo/ phra thabs sgo ma sras mchog dam can bcu gnyis kyi tshogs dpag tu med par spros nas/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad/ bdag mdun gyi mdun du 'brub khung gru gsum mthing nag thar med las kyi brtson khang du/ rang dbang med par bkug nas bsgral ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing / dzaḥdam tshig chen po sogs/ gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ de yang sngon ru tra bsgral ba'i dus su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras su/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ ru tra bsgral ba zhal gyi bzhes pas/ ru tra brlag pa'i dus su sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis bsgral ba ltar/ da ltar rnal 'byor pa byang chub sgrub pa la 'tshe bar byed pa sogs/ dam nyams sdig can mnar med du 'gro nges pa rnams/ sngon gyi dam tshig chen po rjes su dran nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la babs zhes gtso bo yab yum dang / de bzhin du sprul pa'i khro bo chen po yab yum gyi dus la babs/ pho nya chen po za gsod nyi shu'i dus la babs/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la babs/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs/ khyi'i gdong can dus la babs/ zhes pa ste/ mdor na bdag nyid ma mched bzhi/ sa bdag ma mched bzhi/ shwa na ma mched bzhi rnams kyi dus la babs/ zhes pa'o/ /gang dus la babs na/ bla med byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' bzhin du lta ba rtogs pa'i gdung 'dzin pa'i rig 'dzin bdag bcag dpon slob rnams la ni/ gnod cing bar du gcod pa dang / gzhan yang bstan pa bshig cing / dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa/ skye 'gro sems can la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bdud dang dam sri la sogs pa bar du gcod pa gang yin pa rnams/ khro bo chen pos byin rlabs mthu rtsal gyis/ skad cig yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ mngon spyod drag po'i tshul gyis bsgral ba dang / rnam shes ye nas dag pa de/ gnas spar bar byas te/ ma dag pa'i lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du phye mar mdzad nas kyang /

las nyon gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ ri rab kyis mnan cing mtshon chas gzir ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams lus ngag yid gsum gyis nyams su myong bar mdzod cig ces pa'i don can gyi tshig rnams brjod nas/ de nas gsang sngags kyi sgo ni/ snying po gsum gyi tshul bstan te/ de yang 'bros su mi ster ba'i phyir zil gyis mnan pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ staṃ bha ni mo hāṃ/ ghā ta ya bha ga wan/ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi tri badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ zhes pas laṃ las ri rab/ des dgra bgegs kyi spyi bo nas mnan te lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag nas sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar bsgoms zhing / 'khor ba nas drangs pa'i phyir/ 'dren par byed pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rdo rje gzhon nu'i pho nya rnams kyis snying kha nas bzung / yan lag bcings/ rnam shes bsdus te/ yud tsam cig gis bkug par bsgoms la/ slar mi 'chor bar bya ba'i phyir/ dbang du bsdu ba'i snying po ni/ sarba bigha ཱna badz+ra kī li kī ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas dus kyi rlung shugs drag po shing lo skam po la btab pa bzhin du/ bsgral ba'i zhing gang yin pa de rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par bsam par bya ste/ des na kha taṃ rnam gsum 'byung pa'i dgos pa ni/ kha taṃ dang pos snang srid kyi dngos po khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du bsam/ kha taṃ gnyis pas khro mo rnams kyi bha ga gru gsum/ chos kyi dbyings kyi gtun khung du bsgral bya gang yin pa de bsam/ kha taṃ gsum pas khro bo rnams kyi rig pa ye shes kyi rdo rje tho bas yum gyi mkha' dkyil du brdung bar bsam/ de ltar brdungs bas sha khrag gis khams gsum gang bar yod pa la/ hūm̐ gsum gyis dug gsum bsdus/ phaṭa gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gsum gyi khro bo'i sprul pas stong gsum gang bar bsam/

badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha zhes pas/ khro bo gnod sbyin zhes bos nas/ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la spyir bstab pa ste/ de ltar phul bas sha khrag rnams/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis gsol bas dgyes nas ha ha zhes gsungs pas/ stong gsum khro bo'i gad rgyangs kyi sgra dang bcas par bsam ste/ rgyud las/ rdo rje khro bo 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje za byed srin po dang / /rdo rje gnod sbyin zhal gdangs bar/ /mtshan ma'i dngos po bstim par bsgom/ /zhes pa dang / rol bas dgyes pas gad rgyangs sgrogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin zhing / de nas hūm̐ gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gsum po 'od du bstim ste zhu bar bsam/ de'i ngang las phaṭa gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gsum gsal bar gsal btab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang mtha' dpyad pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar rang dbang med par bkug pa'i/ bsgral yul de rnams mgo bo laṃ las ri rab kyi mnan/ lus ngag yid gsum khro bo pho nya 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ phye ma'am rdul phran bzhin du brlag cing re zhig sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar byas/ de rnam par shes pa hūm̐ yig tu byas nas/ de nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sras su bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang dbyer med du byas pa'o/ /de nas don dam shes rab stong pa nyid/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ thabs gsal ba rig pa ye shes kyi khro bo'i rdo rje'i brdungs pa ste/ rnal par 'bar ba'i hom khung du bsgral bya'i lus rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas ye shes kyi me stag mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu'i me dbal byung nas/ las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ sha khrag rus tshogs ma lus khro bo khro mo rnams kyis zhal du gsol pas/ rab tu dges pa'i gad rgyangs ha ha zhes sgrogs cing hūm̐ hūṃ gnyis kyis 'od du zhu nas chos nyid du thim/

phaṭa gnyis kyis slar yang dkyil 'khor gsum lam ste gsal 'debs pa'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi nyams len sgrub thabs bsdus pa kho na'i dgongs pa yin/ rgyas pa'i dgongs pa rnams ni 'dir ma bris pas gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /'on kyang mngon spyod gdab pa'i las thams cad nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshang ba rnams la/ shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rtsis zin cing / thabs snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas ting nge 'dzin la sogs pas bsgral bar gsungs pa las/ yul ma yin pa gzhan bsgral bar ma gsungs so/ /de skad du yang badz+ra ki la ya bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ 'di'i las kyi mtshan nyid kyang / kun la bya ba gzhung las med/ /ces dang / yang nyams pa bdun ni de nyid las/ /nyams par gyur pa bdun yod de/ /srog las nyams dang dam las nyams/ /bka' las nyams dang don las nyams/ /las kyi nyams dang mtshan mas nyams/ /'dod pas nyams dang bdun yin las/ /'di dag bsgral ba'i dmigs yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i srog las nyams pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ pha ma dang / rdo rje slob dpon dang / rdo rje mched grogs dang / sems can gyi srog bag med gcod pa'o/ /dam las nyams pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig las 'gal ba'o/ /bka' las nyams pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' bslus shing / bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' khyad du gsod pa'o/ /don las nyams pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don log par spyod pa'o/ /las kyi nyams pa ni/ las mi dge ba bcu bag med du spyod pa'o/ /mtshan mas nyams pa ni/ gsang sngags nang gi rdzas phyir bstan zhing / /nang gi spyod pa phyir byed pa'o/ /'dod pas nyams pa ni/ slob dpon dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags shing / sngags 'chang rnams kyi longs spyod 'phrog pa'o/ /de dag nyams pa bdun dang / yang zhing bcu gang zhe na/ rtsa rgyud myang 'das las/ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar dang gcig /'dod chags chu ltar 'khol dang gnyis/

/gti mug mun ltar 'thib dang gsum/ /phrag dog shing ltar dpung dang bzhi/ /nga rgyal seng ltar khengs dang lnga/ /ser sna rtsi ltar sbyar dang drug /gtum khro khro chu 'dra ste bdun/ /srog gcod srin po 'dra ste brgyad/ /'phrogs rlom srin po 'dra ste dgu/ /chos log byed mkhan pa dang bcu/ /'di bcu bsgral ba'i zhing bcur bshad/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don go sla bas 'dir ma bkral lo/ /'on kyang gang zag gcig la de bcu tshang ba la zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs zhes gsungs shing / de shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rtsis zin cing / thabs snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ las mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral nus pa'i gang zag gis nges par bsgral ba ni phan yon gzhan las che ba'o/ /gang zhe na gdul dka' ba brtul bas so/ /gal te thabs yod nas ma bsgral na rang yang nyams par 'gyur te/ de skad du yang rgyud las/ nyams pa dus su mi sgrol ba/ /de yang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ nyams bdun zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs kyis/ /gnas skabs bstan pa bshig cing dkon mchog smad/ /sgrub la bar gcod skye 'gro'i bde ba bcom/ /mdor na nyes kun 'du ba'i rtsa ba byed/ /mthar thug dkar nag las 'bras mi bslu bas/ /kho rang nges par rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye/ /skyes nas bskal pa bye ba phrag mang por/ /mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po myang ba de/ /rnal 'byor mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rigs 'dzin gyis/ /yud tsam cig la tshar gcod rjes bzungs na/ /bstan pa 'tshugs shing dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ /sgrub pa mthar phyin 'jig rten bde skyid spel/ /gdul dka'i log 'dren bla med lam la bkod/ /de 'dra'i thabs mchog rmad byung ngo mtshar can/ /bla med gsang chen spyi dang khyad par du/ /rdo rje phur pa'i khyad chos ma lags sam/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gang ltar bsgral ba'i mchod pa bstan zin nas/

de nas mchod pa gtso bo gsum gyi nang tshan/ bsgral mchod dang 'brel ba'i rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ sngar bsgral ba'i sha khrag klad pa rus pa rnams dang / gong du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rak+ta'i mchod pa bya ba la/ rnam pa gsum du yod pa'i dang po ni/ he ru ka yi sogs/ gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de yang he ru ka yi gnas bcu la/ phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi'i bcu ni/ sngon dpal chen pos ru tra bsgral ba'i dus su/ ri rab kyi shar du mig gi rnam shes gnyis bor ba la/ gtum pa dang gtum byed kyi tshal gnyis su gyur/ lhor rna ba'i rnam shes gnyis las/ 'dren pa dang 'dren byed kyi tshal/ nub sna'i rnam shes gnyis las/ mnam sems dang / snom byed kyi tshal gnyis/ byang du lce'i rnam shes gnyis las/ dran pa dang dran byed kyi tshal dang / 'jug bya dang 'jug byed gnyis te/ bcu ru byin gyis brlabs par bshad la/ nang gi gnas bcu ni/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i yul lnga yin par bshad cing / gsang ba'i gnas bcu ni/ yum gyi mkha' la skye gnas kyi rtsa brgyad dang / khā kha mu kha 'dus pa'i rtse mo dang / su kar gser gyi spags pa dang bcu la ngos 'dzin par gsungs la/ yang na/ nang gi gnas bcu ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad dang / lte ba la yab yum gnyis kyi gnas dang bcu yin par yang bshad do/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad la yang / bzhir yod pa las/ lus la bkod pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi gnas tshul la bya ba yin la/ sgrub gnas kyi dur khrod brgyad ni/ sngon ru tra bsgral ba'i dus su/ gzugs phung yul brgyad tu bor ba la/ phyi'i dur khrod ces gsungs shing / de yang yul ma ga dha na dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ yul sidha la na dur khrod sku la rdzogs/ /yul kha cher dur khrod he chen brdal/ /yul gsang la dur khrod gsang chen rol pa/ /yul bal por dur khrod lhun grub brtsegs/

/yul o rgyan dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs/ /yul za hor dur khrod legs ldan sgrogs pa/ yul li'i dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs te brgyad gsungs shing / de brgyad kyi mchod rten dang ma mo dang dngos grub rnams ni 'dir ma bris pas rnam bshad chen mo sogs gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /nang rang la yod pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ rkang lag bzhi/ mgo dang lnga/ mtshan ma dang / nang khrol dang / tsit+ta dang brgyad do/ /gsang ba rang gi sems la yod par rtogs pa'i dur khrod ni/ ye shes kyi snying po thig le byang chub kyi sems te/ he ru ka'i ngo bo tshogs brgyad ye nas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal bar rtogs pa'o/ /zhes yi ge rnying ma dag las 'byung ba ltar bshad pa yin gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas rnams nas/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ gnas dur khrod kyi dbus kyi bzhugs gnas mchog gzhal yas khang gi gnas 'di ru/ bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad/ zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar te/ mi'i ro dang bcas pa dang / dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ te/ khrag gi mchod yon rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil ba 'di nyid/ khro bo 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis/ ma lus par bzhes phyir gshegs nas bzhes la/ so sor 'byon pa'i tshe yang bsnam du gsol/ zhes gzhung tshig brjod cing don bsgom la sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnas bco brgyad kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams dang bsres/ shrī he ru ka khrag 'thung / ma hā sa ma ya dam tshig chen po/ rak+tas mu tra khrag gi rgya mtsho/ kha kha khā hi khā hī sogs nang mchod kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar yin la/ de ni rak+ta'i mchod pa dang po yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ nga ni za byed sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de yang dam ye gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin gyi lha tshogs/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/

khams gsum gyi bsgral bya ma lus par bsgral ba dang / 'dul dka' ba mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ gdul bya de dag gi sha rus la sogs pa bza' bar bya/ de dag bzhes su gsol zhes pa ste/ de ni rak+ta'i mchod pa gnyis pa yin la/ gsum pa ni/ nga ni khrag 'thung sogs brjod/ de yang dam ye gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi lha tshogs/ nga ni nyams pa'i khrag 'thung chen po ste/ dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtsho ltar bskyil ba/ 'khor ba'i drwa ba nyon mongs pa gcod pa'i phyir/ 'khor gyi phra men tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ma lus bzhes phyir gshegs nas bzhes la longs spyod cing bsnam par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsams la sngags brjod/ sngags don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba la/ ma hā ru ti ra zhag chen po/ ma hā maṃ sa sha chen po/ ma hā ma ta ka rus pa chen po/ ma hā as+d+yi pags pa chen po/ khā hi zhes pa ni de dag gsol cing bsnam zhes pa'o/ /de thams cad la gtor ma'i steng du rak+ta bsgreng te/ de ni bsgral ba'i mchod pa ste/ 'di tshogs kyi skabs su byed kyang rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ he ru ka yi zhes pa nas rak+ta tshar gsum gyi mchod pa ste/ de dag ni dang po rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa dang / nga ni za byed ces pa man chad khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa zhes gsungs so/ /de yan gyi rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ yang mchod pa'i gtso bo gsum gyi nang tshan gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum 'khor bcas kyi ljags las byung ba'i/ 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / bla med mchog gis sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ bla na med pa mchog gi mchod pa gtor ma dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyi 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba can gyi/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rab tu brgyan te 'bul lags na/

thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ zhes bsam zhing bsgoms la sngags rnams brjod/ sngags don gong dang 'dra ba las/ i daṃ 'di/ puṣ+paṃ me tog dhū paṃ bdug spos/ dī paṃ mar me/ ghan+dhaṃ dri chab/ ba ling+ta gtor ma/ pra tī ts+tsha so sor bzhes/ gṛh+ṇa zung / khā hi gsol/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo zhes 'bod pa ste/ kha dang po snang srid mchod rdzas su bsam pa dang / gnyis pa brjod dus/ mchod rdzas dam rdzas gtor ma'i rang bzhin du bsam pa dang / khā hi gnyis kyis gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa de dag rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis gsol bar bsam la/ sngags 'di tshar gsum mam/ bdun gyis 'bul bar gsungs so/ /de dag ni gtor ma'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ sgeg cing sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don che ba brjod pa dang bcas pa ni/ sku bgres rgud med par/ gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i tshul can/ rgyan dang cha lugs du mas rab tu brgyan pas/ shin tu sgeg cing / rang gi stobs kyis ri rab kyang / rgyang mar 'phen nus pa'i lha dbang phyug chen po pho mo ni/ bdud thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin cing / de nyid shin tu mthu che bas gzhan gyis 'dul bar dka' ba yin yang / dpal chen nyid kyis gdan du gting nas/ dbugs kyang rgyu bar mi nus par mdzad pas na/ shin tu dpa' ba dang / mthing nag sku gcer bu yan lag rags shing / zhal dmar mdangs shing / mche ba zla tshes ltar brtsigs pa dang / spyan rtsa dmar nag 'bar ba'i spyan dgu nyi zla 'gyil ba 'dra ba ste/ shin tu mi sdug pa'i tshul ston cing / de ltar sku'i gar gsum dang / skye ba med pa'i sku dang ldan pa'i/ g.yas zhal zla ba ltar dkar ba ni chos nyid rang sgra grags stong skye ba med pa'i ngang du/ cher rgod pa dang dbang drag gi 'phrin las rnam gnyis/

gcig char du rdzogs pa'i g.yon zhal/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar dmar ba ni/ srid gsum dbang du sdud cing / cher gshe ba dang / khams gsum yud kyis za nus dbus zhal mthing nag mtshan mo'i nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa 'dra ba ni/ 'jigs su rung ba hūm̐ phaṭa kyi skad rgyangs ri rab 'bum/ dus gcig bsnyil bar nus pa ltar/ sgrogs pa dang gsum ni/ gsung gi gar gsum dang / khams gsum rgyud drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la/ thugs rjes su brtse ba'i snying rje tshad med pa dang / srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i gdug pa can ma lus pa thams cad gcig char du tshar bcad nas/ sha khrag lhag ma med par zhal du 'dren pa la rab tu rngams pa dang / don dam pa mtshan ma'i rnam rtog thams cad las rab tu dben pa'i thugs zhi ba chos kyi dbyings las g.yo ba med pa la sogs pa thugs kyi gar gsum ste/ mdor na gar dgu'i rol mdzad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs la bstod pa bgyi'o bsam pa dang / gang de'i sku la gnyis med lhun grub tu sbyor ba'i lha mo ni baiḍūr+ya sngon po lta bu'i sku mdog gsal la 'tsher zhing / ral pa'i len bu gcig tu 'khyil ba la/ puṣ+pa ra ga ste me tog dmar po'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba la sogs pa yon tan bsam yas mtshan e ka dza ti gu h+ye gsang ba'i yum chen nyid la bstod pa'o/ /zhi ba kun tu bzang po gnas gyur ba 'bar pa'i khro chen hūm̐ mdzad/ zhi ba kun tu bzang mo gnas gyur ba rdo rje lha mo sgra 'byin ma/ g.yas su yab kyi sprul pa phag gi mgo can/ g.yon du yum gyi sprul pa smig bu'i mgo can/ zhi ba sa'i snying po gnas gyur ba khro bo rnam rgyal/ zhi ba lha mo sgreg mo/ yab yum gyi sprul pa stag dang bya rgod kyi mgo bo can/ yang kun bzang gnas gyur dbyug sngon can/ mar me ma gnas gyur sder mo/ sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog gi mgo bo can/ 'jam dpal gnas gyur gshin rje/

dri mchog ma gnas gyur rdo rje dur khrod/ sprul pa sha ba dang 'ug pa'i mgo bo can/ byams pa gnas gyur mi g.yo ba/ bdug spos ma gnas gyur gtun khung ma/ sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo bo can/ spyan ras gzigs gnas gyur rta mgrin/ glu ma gnas gyur gtum mo/ sprul pa byi la pu shud kyi mgo bo can/ nam snying gnas gyur gzhan gyi mi thub pa/ phreng ba ma gnas gyur mda' snyems ma/ sprul pa spyang ki dang khra yi mgo bo can/ phyag rdor gnas gyur 'khyil pa/ gar ma gnas gyur sgra mdzad ma/ sprul pa seṅge dang pha wang gi mgo bo can/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po gnas gyur khams gsum rnam rgyal/ kun tu bzang mo gnas gyur gsod byed ma/ sprul pa dred dang sre mong gi mgo bo can/ sgrib pa rnam sel gnas gyur pa stobs chen/ me tog ma gnas gyur pa rig byed ma/ g.yas su yab sprul dom gyi mgo can/ g.yon du yum sprul byi ba'i mgo bo can/ snying rje tshad med gnod sbyin mo/ byams pa tshad med 'jigs byed ma/ dga' ba tshad med bdud rtsi ma/ btang snyoms tshad med gsod byed ma ste/ dngos grub kyi mchog dam pa myur du stsol mdzad pa'i/ ye shes chen po'i sku khro rgyal yab yum sprul pa yang sprul sgo ma dang bcas pa la bstod pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung / dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dam can ma mo sde gsum gyi tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang phrin las bzhi sgrub cing dam tshig rjes su gcod pa'i chos skyong srung ma la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa rnams la/ gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i don dang / ched du brjod pa gru gsum mthing nag me rab tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya ni gong rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rigs lnga khro bcu sgo ma rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa/ gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo bgegs 'dul byang chub kyi sems dngos la bstod par bgyi/

zhes pa'i don yid la dran shing brjod cing bstod pa ni bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas 'dzab mchod ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya ces brjod pas/ rang gi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snying khar gnas pa/ de 'dra ba gcig mdun du byung / de nyid sngags kyi sgo nas bskyed pa ni/ dz+nyā na satwa e tri ko na bi ma na paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sarba bighā nan hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa ste/ dz+nyā na ye shes/ sa twa sems dpa'/ e tri ko na gsum brtsegs/ bi ma na dri ma med pa ste/ ye shes sems dpa' sum brtsegs bskyed par bstan pa yin la/ gdan gang du bskyed na/ paṃ las pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la ces pas/ paṃ las pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la ces pa ma las nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la ces pas/ a las zla ba'i gdan/ dbang phyug pho mo dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ ces pa ni ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon yin la/ badz+ra kī li sogs ni bskyed pa'i sngags te/ de dag ni 'dir skabs kyi gsang ba sngags kyi sgo yin zhing / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo ni rang gi mdun du ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba la/ yum med pa de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' de 'dra ba tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam/ de'i mthar kī la ya'i phreng ba spu shad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor ba dang bcas pa shin tu gsal bar bsgom pa ni 'di'i skabs kyi dmigs pa yid kyi sgo yin la/ tshig gsal btab pa ni/ gru gsum mthing nag sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ pad+ma nyi zla dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje gzhon nu/ sku mdog mthing nag dur khrod kyi chas la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

yab thabs snying rje chen po dang / yum shes rab stong nyid gnyis su med pa gtso kyang gi rnam pa dang / 'khor gyi tshogs khro bcu yab yum phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs pa rnams/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis yun ring dus nas nye bar bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha yin pas/ drag po rang byung mchog gi dngos grub dang / dbang dang zhi ba rgyas pa sogs thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa sogs mdor na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bdag la cig char du myur du stsol cig:ces pa'i don yin pas brjod cing bsgom pa'o/ /de ni bzlas pa dngos ni/ rang gi mdun du ye shes sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang / rang rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas pa rnams snang la rang bzhin med par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar rnam pa gsal la ngo bo brjod du med pa lham mer gsal ba'i ngang nas bzla dgos pas/ de la yang mgal me'i phreng ba klad la bskor ba ltar bzlas pa dang / bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar bzlas pa dang / mgar gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba ltar bzlas pa dang gsum las/ dang po sngags phreng mgal me ltar 'khor ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig las/ sngags phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu byung ba/ rdo rje'i dbus rā nas thon/ ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ slar g.yas nas thon te rang gi sna bug g.yon dang ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas mar song snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags phreng phyir 'gro dus rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byas/

sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar bsgyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku'i rnam par rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ de ltar sngags phreng rgyun mi chad pa 'khor bar bsam pa ni/ mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'o/ /rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang sems can yi dam gyi lhar gyur pa thams cad kyi rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam zhing / sngags phreng rgyun mi chad pa 'khor ba la sems gtad/ gnyis pa bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar bzlas pa ni/ dper na bung ba'i tshang zhig na bung ba thams cad skad dus gcig la 'don pa ltar/ lha tshogs thams cad kyis kī la ya dus gcig la sgrogs pa dang / rang gi zhal gsum dang / dbu rgyan gyi khrag 'thung rigs lnga dang / ba spu'i bu ga'i khro chung rnams dang / de bzhin du mdun du spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ sras mchog phur bu la sogs pa lha tshogs thams cad kyis zhal kun nas kī la ya'i sgra sgrogs pa dang / der ma zad me sgra chu sgra rlung sgra la sogs pa thams cad kyang kī la ya yi sgrar bsgyur te sgrogs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa mgar gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba ltar bzla ba ni/ dper na mgar gyi sol mal du lcags bsregs nas tho bas rdung ba'i tshe me stag phyogs thams cad du 'phro ba ltar/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe 'od zer phyogs bcur spro ba'o/ /'di la chos nyid du shes pa dang / lhar shes pa dang / dgug gzhug tu shes pa'i dmigs pa gsum las/ dang po ni sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas thugs zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par byas te 'phags pa mchod/ yang 'od zer skye 'gro sems can thams cad la phog pas las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dag nas thams cad chos nyid ngang du lhan nas song bar bsam pa yin/

zhes bshad la/ gnyis pa lhar shes pa ni/ sngags kyi 'od zer las 'khrungs pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu grangs med pa khams gsum gang ba spros/ re re'i zhal rnams nas sngags bzlas pas 'od zer 'phros snang srid thams cad la phog pas/ snang srid thams cad lha tshogs su gyur par bsam pa yin gsungs la/ gsum pa dgug gzhug tu shes pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer lcags kyu la sogs pa dpag med spros/ nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa nṛ dang tri'i gzugs su gnas pa de/ lcags kyus bzung / zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrogs gis bsdams/ dril bus myos par byas la/ liṅga la bstims par bsgom pa yin gsungs so/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa'i rtog pa'i tshogs sbyang ba la/ rang gi lus kyi gnas su spro bsdu bya ba dang / bsnyen pa'i nus pa gsog pa la sras mchog dang spro bsdu bya ba dang / dam can bsnyen pa la dam can dang / sgrol ba la dgra bgegs dang / dbang bskur ba'i dus lha dang / tshe sgrub pa'i dus tshe bum dang / dngos grub len pa'i dus zhal zas dang / gshin don byed pa'i dus gshin po dang spro bsdu byas pas sdig sgrib sbyangs ba dang brgyad du yod pa las/ 'dir gtso che ba sngags 'phreng mgal me ltar 'khor ba bsgom pa yin no/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo ni dper na shing bu phra mo'i sne la me sbar nas bskor na/ dmar stag mi chad pa 'khor nas 'ong ba ltar sngags kyi 'phreng ba rgyun mi chad pa 'khor ba la sems gtad pa'o/ /ji skad du yang / gzhan du mi 'phro'i sems kyis ni/ /de'i tshul gyis bzlas par bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi sbyin/ /zhes dang / yang spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i skyon chags pas/ /thos dang bsam dang sgom pa kun/ /glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dran pa la ni de mi gnas/ /zhes dang / bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/

/yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnam rtog gzhan du ma yengs par tshul bzhin du bsgom bzlas byas na/ rgyal ba'i bka' mi bslu bas ji ltar gsung bzhin 'grub par the tshom ga la yod/ gal te bsgom rgyud man ngag med pa dang / yod kyang mi bsgom pa sems bag med du g.yeng na bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras bu mi thob pas/ 'bad pa don med du 'gro bar gsungs pas/ sems gzhan du ma yengs pa shin tu gal che'o/ /de bzhin du 'grel pa man ngag la lta zhing bla ma mkhas pa bsten pa shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ spyir rgyud kun nas yi ge bco lnga man la 'bru 'bum dang / yi ge sum cu man la bzhi 'bum/ de bas mang ba rnams la 'bum 'am khri bskyal bar gsungs shing / bye brag rdo rje phur pa 'di la/ rgyud las/ ting 'dzin spro bsdu gsal ba yi/ /bsnyen pa nyi khri bdun 'bum bzlas/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags rnams kun/ /dus der mi 'byung mi srid do/ /zhes dang / bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin dam tshig ma nyams na/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dus 'dir thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang ltar bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la/ 'bum phrag bcu drug mdzad pa yin te/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ stod las byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med la/ smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang du byas na/ kī la ya yi ge srog can bcu drug yod pas/ 'bru 'bum gyi 'bum phrag bcu drug de'i kha skong khri tsho bcu drug stong phrag bcu drug rnams bzlas nas/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang phyag len la de ltar du mdzad pa yin la/ sngags 'di kho nar ma gtogs 'khor gyi sngags bzla mi dgos pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ gtso 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags yin par/

rgyud dang tshad ldan mkhas pa kun gyi gsung rab las 'byung ngo / /de ltar bzlas pa ji ltar 'tshams pa shib bur bzlas nas/ thun 'jog khar oṃ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lnga bdun la sogs pa ci rigs bzlas/ de nas gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba tshar gcig bzla ba phyag len yin pas/ ma rak+mo sogs brjod nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs brjod cing / phreng ba la kha rlangs phog par byas rang gi mgo thog tu bzhag ste byin brlabs bstims la/ phreng ba rdo rje mdud pa brgyabs la sgam phrag tu bzhag la/ de nas mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' sogs brjod pas/ bskyed ma thag pa'i ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam la/ de nas sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas/ sogs sh+lo ka'i mjug tu/ na ma sarba sogs sngags brjod bdud rtsi phul nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi zad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yak+ṣa he ru ka /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas/ 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ tshig don dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba rnams bsgral ba dang / kī la ya yi dngos grub ni gsang ba gsum bdag rdo rje'i gzhon nu'i sku'i go 'phang yin pas/ de bdag la gdan thog 'di'am tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ zhes bsam zhing bsgom pa'o/ /de yan chad kyi phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga yi sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba dang / dkyil 'khor gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pas don gyi khog phug pa dang / khams gsum nas srog la dbang bskur zhing srog ye shes sems dpa' srog la dbang bskur ba dang /

ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs shing mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blang ba dang / zhes gsungs pa de yan chad man ngag dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ bgegs bskrad byin rlabs spyan drangs dngos/ /mchod dang bskang dang bzlas pa dag /bstod kyi las su shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas dkyus kyi tshig drug ma shes na/ phrin las gong 'og shan mi phyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i lugs kyi bstod las kyi rim pa phrin las gong ma bzhin bstan zin nas/ 'og ma bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas gong gi sa bcad 'dod don zhu ba'i rjes su gtor bsngo chen mo phyag len ltar mdzad/ bskang ba byed na bsdus pa tsam dang / ma byas na gtor bsngo bshags pa yan rgyun bzhin la/ bshags pa'i mjug mthol lo bshags so bzod pa dam pa bzhes/ zhes pa'i mjug tu dril bu bcad brdung byas la/ oṃ shri ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ro ru ro ru/ bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si/ ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍom+bhi ni tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+ṣa si/ siṅga la de wi hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ tshigs bcad re'i mjug tu dril bu bsil zhing / hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/ /zhes pa nas/ phur srung rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gtor bsngo chen mo nas 'byung ba ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ dril bu tshig brdung byas la/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams zhes pa nas/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob ces pa'i bar dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs gzhung tshig rnams brjod/ de yang chos dbyings ye shes la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs kun bzang rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed kyi sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi sgo nas/

chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / gang 'dul zhi ba dang khro bo'i skur ston pa khyed rnams/ sngon 'gro ba ma lus pa 'dren par zhal gyi bzhes pa'i thugs dam gyi dbang gis/ bdag dang 'gro ba kun thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs nas/ thugs rje drag po'i stobs kyi bdag cag gis zhe sdang dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su shar ba dang / gzhan yang bsgral bya'i yul du gyur pa thams cad bsgral ba dang / bdag la sgrol nus pa'i dngos grub dang / khyad par mchog gi dngos grub rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / yon tan 'phrin las mi zad rgyan gyi brgyan pa ste/ bla na med pa gong na med pa bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang dam pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub tshe ring nad med/ dpal dang grags pa 'khor dang longs spyod/ stobs dang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang mnyam pa sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams gshegs su gsol zhing / dam tshig pa rang la thim pa sogs/ dkyus sam bdud rtsi 'od can bzhin byas la/ bdag srung zhing go cha gyon pa ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sogs brjod/ sngags don/ oṃ dam bca' ba/ shrī dpal/ badz+ra rdo rje/ ku ma ra gzhon nu/ kro dha khro bo/ rak+ṣa bsrung ba ste/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje gzhon nus go mtshams med pas gtams pas/ rang nyid gzi brjid dang / nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur par bsgom pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /go bsgo ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni/ rdo rje'i lus la go gyon pa zhes pa ste lus ngag yid gsum mi 'jig pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bsam pa'o/

/de nas dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun sogs/ gzhung tshig bdud rtsi 'od can nas byung pa ltar brjod/ tshig don yid kyis bsgom pa ni/ bdag gi gsang chen bla na med pa'i nying khu rdo rje phur pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i las/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa mkhyen pa/ 'khrul bral dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ tshul bzhin du bgyis pa'i dge ba bla na med pa 'di'i mthus/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad kun/ 'khor bar 'dzin pa'i bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal shing / phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kyi tshogs kun 'joms nas/ rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ 'bras bu bla na med pa byang chub chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ go 'phang rin po che nges par nye bar myur du 'grub par gyur cig zhes pa'i don yin de ma bcos pa bsgom pa gnad che'o/ /gzhan yang dge ba 'di yi sogs gzhung tshig rnams tshig don yid la dran zhing brjod 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bkrol yang phal cher go sla'o/ /de nas shis par brjod pa yang / sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/ de yang tshigs bcad re'i mjug tu dril bu bsil zhing / de yang bka' drin mtshungs med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal dang ldan pa rdo rje 'chang dngos dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad yid la dran kyang rung / de'i mod la bkra shis pa chos dang mthun pa'i las thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba'am dbyar gyi mtsho chen bzhin/ 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas nas rigs drug nyan rang byang sems te skye rgu thams cad la bde legs 'byung nges yin pas 'byung bar shog ces pa'i don dang / yang don dam pa skye ba med pa chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa las/

thugs dam gyi dbang gi khrag 'thung 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ mtshan bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu nyid dang / don dam pa gang de'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / rnam pa sgyu ma'i gzugs 'dzin bde ba chen po'i yab la 'khril mdzad/ mtshan yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma ste/ dpal chen yab yum gnyis kyis/ bdag sogs kun la nyon mongs pa'i skye shi med pa don gyi sku gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i bkra shis stsol bar shog ces dang / yang sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang chen rigs kun khyab bdag gi spyan snga ru/ las chos bzhin du sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag thams cad la/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las srung zhing / ma yi bu ltar skyong bar zhal gyi bzhes pa'i/ rdo rje nag po chen po sogs chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis stsol bar shog ces dang / yang nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen mi zad pa'i gter mnga' zhing gnod sbyin nor 'chang dbang po kun gyi rje dpon/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po ār+ya dzam+bha la yi/ 'dod dgu'i dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa'i bkra shis bdag cag la myur du stsol bar shog ces dang / yang phyi las las skyes pa'i bgegs dang / nang rtog pa 'khrul pa la byung ba'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu chos nyid kyi ngang du zhi ba dang / mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen thams cad dang rnam par kun tu bral ba dang / rang gi lhag bsam dag pa'i 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bdag la bde legs shog /bdag cag 'khor bcas nyin mo yang bde legs/ /mtshan mo yang bde legs shing / mdor na nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i bkra shis/ rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyis byin mthus deng 'dir bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bde ba dang legs pa'i dpal 'byor rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa stsol bar shog

de ltar bstsal ba la brten nas 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar pa ltar spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rgyal nas bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pa'i dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig zhes tshig don dran zhing bkra shis brjod pa'o/ /'di ni bdud rtsi 'od can nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi dgongs pa bkral ba'o/ /de yan gyi thun dang po'i rnam gzhag legs par bstan zin nas/ thun gnyis pa srod thun zhes pa ni/ yang na nyi ma rgas kha'am/ yang na rgas tshar rjes 'go len dgos shing / mdor na nyi ma rgas pa dang / nam phyed gung dang / nyi ma shar ba dang / nyi ma phyed gung rnams/ ting 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus bzhi yin pas thun gyi 'go gzung bar mi bya'o/ /des na gong du bshad pa'i dus gang rigs la dbu gzung ba ni/ rgyud 'debs nas rtsom gtor bsngo yan gong du bshad pa ltar las/ 'on kyang srod thun gyi skabs su ḍā dril mi brdung bar dril sil kho nar byed pa phyag len no/ /gtor bsngo bka' bdud phur srung mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag rnams 'bul ba yin pas/ gtor ma byin rlabs bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs ltar brjod nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes lan gsum bya khyung phyag rgya bstan pa dang bcas te byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyis gnas su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du bh+yo dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas/ gzhi bdag gtor ma'i mjug yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar dang / de dang sbrel nas bh+yo dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo sogs nas/ thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces pa'i bar dang / de dang sbrel nas oṃ lha'i tshogs rnams zhes pa nas/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob bar dang de dang sbrel nas ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ zhes pa man chad dkyus dang 'dra'o/

/de rnams kyi phyag rgya dang dril bu rdung tshul rnams 'dir ma bris kyang da lta phyag len la bzhugs pa 'di la 'khrul ba med pas mthong brgyud dang / mkhas pa'i slob dpon bsten nas shes par bya'o/ /dus kyi tshad zla ba gsum dang / thun gyi tshad nyin re thun gsum re mdzad pas/ nyin dang po nyi ma phyed yol la zhugs nas/ nyin thun srod thun gnyis gong du bshad pa ltar dang / sang nyin snga thun shar skya tsam nas 'go bzung nas/ nyi ma phyed gung yan du gtor bsngo grub par byas/ de'i tshul gong du bshad pa'i srod thun bzhin no/ /de nas zas la rol zhing / nyi ma phyed yol ma thag thun bzung nas nyi ma rgas kha yan du gtor bsngo grub par mdzad pas/ thun bar ma 'di la gtor bsngo chen mo mdzad/ de nas srod thun ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /thun bar rnams su rang nyid lus rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral ba dang / ngag kī la ya'i sgra dang mi 'bral ba dang / yid chos nyid byang chub sems kyi phur bu gsal stong mi phyed pa dang mi 'bral ba ste/ mi 'bral ba rnam pa gsum dang / yang rgyud las/ bdag khyod kun mnyes thams cad 'brangs/ /kun la phan pa'i sman yin te/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yis/ /thams cad za zhing brgyan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ldang ba dang / za ba dang / 'gro ba dang / 'dug pa dang / 'thung ba dang / nyal pa'i dus rnams su lha'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i tshul ni/ snga dro ldang ba'i dus su oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing / chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las 'gag pa med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs par bsam mo/ /za ba'i dus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas lha mchod pa'i tshul du rol zhing / mkha' 'gro rnams la lhag ma'i gtor ma sngags tsam gyis sbyin no/ /'gro ba'i dus oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e waṃ ma ya/

dharmā kā ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing / 'gro ba 'dren pa'i don du 'gro bar bsam/ 'dug pa'i dus su oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing gang du gnas pa'i sa de ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang dang / 'khor dang nyer gnas rnams sprul pa'i 'khor du bsam mo/ /btung ba spyi dang khyad par dza gad btung ba la dza gad de nyid traṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsam/ oṃ na mo gu ru badz+ra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma karma dza gad pra ba ya khā raṃ khā hi/ zhes bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dngos grub bsdus nas lha mchod pa'i tshul du rol par bshad do/ /nyal ba'i tshe oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya shū n+ya ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rang rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i ngang nas seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis chos kyi dbyings skye ba med pa stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ sang snga dro gong du bshad pa ltar gyis ldang ngo / /de dag phyi'i bskyed rim dang nang bskyed pa'i rim pa yang / gsang rgyud las/ dbang chen 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus la rdzogs/ /phung po lnga ni sras lnga'i dngos/ /sku lnga ye shes sku dang ldan/ /rang sems nor bu rin po che/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa yang / yang gsang rgyud las/ gsang ba'i gzhal yas bstan pa ni/ ye nas rang byung dam pa de/ /sangs rgyas rol mo du mas khrid/ /rgyan dang bla bre'i rang bzhin grub/ /sangs rgyas gzhal yas dam pa yin/ /de yi dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha/ /phra la dod par brtag par bya/ /de yang yang dang yang du ni/ /phra ba'i sems kyis bzung gyur na/ /'jug tu dmigs pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /yang zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /sgrub thabs bsdus pa de nyid du/ ha cang gsal kha che ba zhig ma gsungs kyang / chos thams cad la ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyis rgyas thebs na/

rdzogs rim kyang shugs byung du rtogs 'dra zhing / 'on kyang dkyil chog dang gtor bzlog sogs nas 'byung ba ltar brjod na/ dang po ni/ a ka ro'i sngags brjod nas/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa de kho na nyid dran pa zhes gsung zhing / de yang chos thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ gong du bshad pa ltar gsang rgyud las/ don gyi phur pa byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems kyi phur pa ni/ /snang srid phur pa'i rgyu ru grag /'byung ba'i rgyu yang sems yin te/ /sems las ma byung chos gzhan med/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad rang gi sems yin zhing / sems ni yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ gnyis ka yang ma yin/ gnyis min yang ma yin pa ste/ brjod bral mu bzhi las 'das pa/ 'bad rtsol sogs la ma bltos pa/ rang babs gshis kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba zab mo la blos 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ltar na rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lor thim/ de gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ 'khor gyi lha rnams sgo ma bzhi khro bcu phra thabs dang bcas pa la/ de rnams rang gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yang rang nyid yab la/ yab kyang spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag pa'o/ /yang 'cham dpe nas phyag rgya'i gar 'cham sgo nas bskyed pa'i rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa rnams/ 'od du zhu nas rang gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ rang nyid thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshe thig le la/ thig le na dā la/ na dā yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par gsungs so/ /gang ltar yang rang gi rtogs pa ni/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud dag pa lha dang gzhal yas khang du bskyed cing gsal bar bsgom pa ni bskyed rim/

lha dang gzhal yas su gsal ba de yang rang bzhin ci yang med pa stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni rdzogs rim/ gsal ba nyid kyang stong pa/ stong pa nyid kyang gsal ba ste/ gsal stong dbyer mi phyed pa ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug des na bskyed pa'i dus na gsal ba gtso bo dang / lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i dus na zung 'jug gtso bo/ nyal ba la sogs pa'i dus na stong pa gtso bor bsgom pas/ gsal ba'i 'bras bu sprul sku/ zung 'jug gi 'bras bu longs sku/ stong pa'i 'bras bu chos sku thob pa yin nam bsams so/ /gzhan yang rdzogs rim phyag rgya ma la brten nas thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa ni 'dir ma bris pas gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la 'bad pa'i 'bras bu gang zhe na/ rgyud las/ rnam par smin dang tshe la dbang / /phyag rgya che dang lhun gyi grub/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i go 'phang thob par gsungs te/ de yang dang po ni/ rnam smin gyi rgyu lha'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed rim gsal bar brtan cing / rdzogs rim lta bas kyang rgyas thebs la/ 'bras bu rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin pas/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin zhes gsungs shing / des bdag med gnyis la thos bsam gtso bor byed pa'i sgo nas tshogs gsog pas/ lam tshogs lam la gnas shing / 'bras bu mngon du byed pa la mos pas/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa yang thob pa yin gsung / des bskyed rim brtan pas stong gsum thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du dgongs shing / rang chos nyan pa'i tshe chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pas/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du nyan zhing / gzhan la ston pa'i tshe lus ngag gis 'gro don dngos su byed par gsungs la/ de nyid kyis tshogs lam mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho ba yin par bshad la/ de tshe de nyid la mchog gi 'bras bu mngon du byed pas/

'chi ba med cing he ru ka rigs lnga gang rung gi rig 'dzin pas na/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhes gsungs shing / de lam sbyor lam la gnas shing sa mos pas spyod pa/ dgongs pa bskyed rim brtan pas snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du dgongs la/ rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob pas chos nyan pa'i tshe yang sgra brnyan tsam du nyan zhing / gzhan la ston pa'i tshe yang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i spros bral gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas ston par mdzad par gsungs shing / de nyid kyis sbyor lam mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho ba yin par gsungs shing / de ni gsang sngags bla med rang rkang gi 'phags lam thams cad phyag rgya ma la brten dgos pa gtso che zhing / de nyid kyis kyang phyag rgya ma la brtan nas 'phags pa'i sa thob cing / kun bzang rigs lnga gang rung gi rig 'dzin pas na/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin zhes bya la/ de nyid lam gyi dbang du byas na thog mar mthong lam ste/ brjod bral blo 'das/ chos dbyings spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa sa dang po'i ye shes mngon du byed/ sa de la brten nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa sogs spyad de/ phyi'i yul na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du 'dus shing / nang gi rtsa khams la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal dngos su mthong / rtsa mdud rnams rim gyis grol nas lam bsgom lam dang / sa phyi ma bcu gcig la rim par gnas pa yin gsungs/ mthar chos thams cad kyi dbyings mngon du gyur pas snod bcud thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du dgongs shing / chos nyan pa'i tshe yang nam mkha'i ngang tshul can du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las nyan la/ gzhan la ston pa'i tshe yang 'gro don dgongs pas khyab tshad du mdzad pa yin gsungs/ de mthar phyin pa'i tshe lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho bar gsungs shing /

de yang chos thams cad ye 'am gdod ma nas ma bcos lhun gyi grub pa la lhun gyis grub par shes pas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin zhes gsungs zhing / de rigs kun la khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rig 'dzin zhing / sa'i dbang du byas na sa bcu gsum pa phyed 'og ma/ lam nye rgyu bsgom pa'i sgom lam la gnas shing / chos chos sku las nyan la gzhan la ston pa lus ngag la mi ltos par/ 'gro don nam mkhas gar khyab des khyab par bshad la/ de ltar lhun gyi grub pa'i rig 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyun gyis 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can/ chos sku kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba/ chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa yin la/ de nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya gzhan gyi don gyi phyir gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te las dag pa rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / rigs can gsum la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang / gzhan yang las dang skal bar 'tshams pa rnams la/ skye ba sprul sku la sogs par sprul nas mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar gsungs/ 'o na sku gsung thugs mi zad rgyan gyi brgyan pa'i 'khor lo gang zhe na sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad pa gnyis las/ dang po sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i tshad sus kyang bzung mi nus te/ dper na sprul sku shākya thub pa lta bu la mtshon na/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' rtogs par 'dod nas ri rab kyi steng dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang / de bzhin du steng phyogs kyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma can zhes bya ba na/

de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo dpal gyi snying po'i rgyal po bzhugs pa rnams su rim gyis phyin te bltas kyang dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong ba lta bu'o/ /sku thams cad pa ni sprul pa mchog nas bzung ste/ ri bor dang / stag dang / seng ge dang / gru dang / gzings dang / zam pa la sogs pa gdul bya gang la gang 'dul sku gang gis 'dul ba de la de dang rjes su 'tshams pa'i skur bstan nas don mdzad pa'o/ /gsung la yang gnyis las gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung de drung nas nyan kyang che ba med la/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags la sogs pa nas nyan kyang chung ba med pa ste/ de yang mau'u 'gal gyi bus nub phyogs bde ba can dang / de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag 'das pa na 'od zer gyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gnas su byon te nyan pas kyang chung du song ba med pa thos pa lta bu'o/ /gsung thams cad pa ni dag pa lha'i skad nas bzung ste/ klu dang gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pa 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston nus pa'o/ /thugs la yang gnyis las/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyis shes bya mkhyen pa bzhin/ gzhan sus kyang mi mkhyen pa ste/ mau'u 'gal gyi bu 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas kyang rang gi ma gang du skyes pa ma mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa lta bu dang / dgra bcom pa gzhan sus kyang khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod pa ma mkhyen pas rab tu byung ma nus pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal skyes skye ba bdun gyi gong rol du khyir skyes pa na/ phag gi bdas nas mchod rten zhig la bskor ba byas pa'i dge ba'i sa bon yod par mkhyen nas/ rab tu byung bar gnang ba lta bu'o/ /thugs thams cad pa ni/

ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste/ de yang ji lta ba ni dngos po'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa mkhyen cing mngon du gyur pa yin la/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ni/ tsher ma rno ba/ sran ma zlum pa/ pha wang long bu gru bzhir 'ong ba/ rma bya'i mdongs bkra ba la sogs pa chos thams cad kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel ma lus pa thugs su chud pas gang yang ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'o/ /rgyan ni mdzes par byed pa ste/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bas mdzes pa'o/ /'khor lo ni mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'tshang rgya la/ de rnams re res kyang chos bstan te sems can de nyid cig 'tshang rgya zhing / des kyang de'i phyi ma'i sems can rnams la chos bstan te 'tshang rgya ba la sogs pa mdor na 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gzhan don 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /de ltar na lam 'di la brten nas de lta bu'i 'bras bu thob pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / rtsod bral rgya bod kyi mkhas grub kun gyis kyang bzhed pas/ lam 'di ni mchog tu zab cing gzhan las ches cher khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /gal te de lta bu'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir ma thob kyang / nyams len la 'bad pas lha'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ 'chi khar lhar gsal zhing / de gsal bas bar dor rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngang du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur ba ni nges pa yin par yi ge rnying pa rnams las bshad de/ de ni bskyed rim la brten nas bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul yin la/ rdzogs rim zab mo lta ba la brten nas bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i man ngag 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi gdams pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

de yang dus rgyun du rdo rje phur pa'i lam zab mo bsgom pa la 'bad rtsol du bgyis pas/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de 'chi dus su/ 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi dgongs pa la gnas par bya ste/ 'chi ba'i dus tsam na/ sa'i rlung chu la thim pa'i dus su lus lci snyam byed cing / phung po mi theg pa snyam byed cing / phyi nang gi gsung 'dzin rags pa 'gag chu'i rlung me la thim pa'i dus su kha sna skam/ brlan gsher nyung / mig gting du bros/ lus kyi zon bag mi bde/ phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin 'bring ba 'gags so/ /me'i rlung rlung la thim pa'i rtags su drod 'tshor/ khyad par rkang pa grang / phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin phra ba 'gags/ rlung gi rlung nam mkha' la thim pas/ dbugs thung rngam pa brtsegs/ phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin phra ba'i phra ba 'gag de nas nam mkha'i rlung chos nyid la thim pas tshogs drug gi yul 'gag nas/ lus sems bral te bar ma dor ye shes ngos zin par bya'o/ /de yang ye shes ngos 'dzin pa la bzhi ste/ 'gag pa med pa'i tshe/ chad pa med pa'i srog dmigs pa med pa'i yul/ skye ba med pa'i sems de'i don bshad pa ni/ 'chi ba'i dus der rang gi sems skye med stong gsal phur pa'i ngang la gtad pa'o/ /de la gtad tsam na de'i ngang du dbugs chad pa dang / de'i rgyun 'khrig zin nas/ gnas pa chos sku'i de kho na nyid la 'gag pa med pa'i tshe zhes bya/ de la gnas pas srog chad du med de/ rgyud thung stong gsal de'i ngang du sangs rgya ba de la chad pa med pa'i srog ces bya'o/ /de ltar 'bras bu rang byung gi ye shes/ phur bu byang chub sems kyi ngang de las/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ bde ba chen po la 'das pas dmigs pa med pa'i yul te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur ba'o/ /de tsam na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal te/ rang gi sems skye med du shes pa de chos dbyings ye shes/

de'i rol par shar ba me long lta bu/ de gnyis dbyer med mnyam nyid ye shes/ de ltar rtogs pa de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de'i don mthar phyin pa bya ba grub pa'o/ /de tsam man mngon par shes pa drug kyang 'char ste/ de'i tshe 'gro ba'i don du/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis mtshan pa'i rdo rje 'chang du snang la/ 'gro ba rigs drug la rang rang gi skal ba dang mtshams pa'i sprul pa'i skur snang nas chos ston par byed pas/ de ltar na 'da' ka 'chi brod kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung las/ ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'o/ /de rnams ni mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob pa'i tshul dang / gnas skabs su yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ lam 'di la brtson par byas na/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos grub mngon du gyur nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ mdzad pa 'phrin las rnam bzhi la thogs pa mi spyod pas/ 'gro ba'i don ma lus pa bsgrub pa dang bsod nams kyi tshogs rab tu rdzogs shing / rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis rtag tu byin gyis brlabs pas/ ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa dang / gnod byed kyi tshogs dang 'du ba'i nad kun 'joms shing / tshe yi rig 'dzin thob pa dang / legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs nas rang byung gi ye shes rtogs pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas shing rtag tu bkra shis kyi dpal la longs spyod par gsungs te/ de yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud las/ gang zhig mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ /gsang ba thugs kyi dngos grub dang / /dgongs pa thams cad nges par 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don la 'phrin las bzhi/ /'di ltar thogs pa mi spyod pas/ /dngos grub bar chad la sogs pa/

/brtul shugs can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /shin tu sgrub pa nga yi bstan/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mchog /bsod nams tshogs kun rab tu rdzogs/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis/ /rtag par byin gyis rlabs byed pas/ /ci ltar bsam pa bzhin du 'grub/ /gnod byed nye bar zhi ba yis/ /'du ba'i nad kun 'joms pa dang / /tshe yi rig 'dzin rab tu thob/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs 'grub pas/ /rang byung ye shes rtogs par 'gyur/ /'khor dang longs spyod kun rgyas shing / /bkra shis dpal ni yongs rdzogs byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang phur pa 'grub pa'i rtags ni/ /kī la ya'i tan+t+ra las/ 'grub pa'i rtags ni nyer gcig te/ /sku gsung thugs la bdun bdun te/ /sku'i rtags bdun ni/ phur pa 'gul ba dang / 'phar ba dang / lding ba dang / me stag 'byung ba dang / 'od 'byung ba dang / du ba 'byung ba dang / phur pa bzhad pa'o/ /gsung gi rtags bdun ni/ phur pa las sgra 'byung ba dang / sngags kyi sgra dang / gnam lcags kyi sgra dang / 'brug sgra dang / rnga sgra dang / lce spyang gi sgra dang / rdo rje srin po'i 'ur sgra'o/ /thugs kyi rtags bdun ni/ ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba dang / las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang / tshe la dbang ba dang / rigs lnga mngon du gyur pa dang / lha rnams gsal ba dang / phur pa'i srung ma rnams bran bzhin du las byed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rab kyi dbang du byas nas/ 'bring rmi lam/ tha ma nyams snang la rtags de rnams mi 'byung ba mi srid do/ /'dir smras pa/ zab las cher zab rdo rje phur pa'i lam/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi dgongs bzhed 'di/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon po'i thugs brgyud nas/ /lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin rnams la mnga'/ /khyad par mnga' bdag slob dpon gsum rnams las/ /bod 'dir rgyal dbang pad+ma'i drin las byon/

/byon pa de nyid lo chen klu'i+i dbang po'i+i/ /rnam dpyod tshad med blo yi legs bsdus nas/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i khang bzang tog tu bzhag /bzhag pa 'di la gangs can bod 'di na/ /sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos zhes su grags/ /grags 'di rgyu skar dbus na rta ljang ltar/ /lam bzang mtha' yas kun dang thun mong min/ /ci phyir zhe na lhag pa'i lha mchog 'di/ /gzhan las mthu stobs che zhing 'phrin las myur/ /de yang sngon tshe dus kyi bskal pa la/ /srin po ru tra thar pa nag po de/ /log pa'i lam la gol ba de 'dul phyir/ /'og min zhing du rgyal kun bka' bgros mdzad/ /mdzad nas gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dul phyir du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs te/ /srin po ru tra 'khor bcas drag pos bsgral/ /bsgral nas de yi rjes su theg pa'i mchog /gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung / /bar du rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog yi dam 'di bsgrub nas/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /khams gsum zil gnon srid gsum dbang bsdus nas/ /rgyal bstan spel zhing 'gro rnams bde la bkod/ /tha ma sa skya'i rje btsun rim byon gyis/ /thugs dam gdams pa'i snying khu 'di mdzad nas/ /grub pa'i dpa' bo 'phrin las 'od stong gis/ /bstan 'gro phan bde'i dpal la bkod pa 'di/ /kun dang thun mong min pa'i bshad pa yin/ /des na rang re skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams/ /'di la mi mos sems ldan yin nam ci/ /khyad par deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di la/ /snying nas chos byed nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /'byung yang de la bar chad bsam mi khyab/ /de phyir lhag pa'i lha mchog 'di bsgrub na/ /bdud dpung bye bas bar chad mi tshugs shing / /mchog thun dngos grub myur du thob bo zhes/

/rtsod bral rgya bod mkhas pa kun gyis gsung / /de bas myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pa/ /kun gyis lam bzang 'di la 'bad par rigs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //de nas rjes kyi bya ba bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ mtshams tho bsdu ba ni/ mtshams tho gang yod nang nas phyir rim bzhin bsdu dgos pa las/ de'i tshul snga dro'i thun nyi ma phyed gong du tshar bar byas la/ de ma thag tho'i drung du byon la/ thog mar yid kyi sprul pa'i ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod phul nas/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ de nas oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs brjod nas mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas pa badz+ra muḥtho'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing / rang gi hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim par bsgom/ de nas zas la rol nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa cung zad dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa bskang ba dang bcas pa gtang rag gi tshul du 'bul/ 'di'i rjes su tshogs bstan skyong lhag ma rnams bdud rtsi 'od can nas 'byung ba bzhin nges par bya dgos so/ /de nas/ gsang sngags ma bzlas lha mi 'grub/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsnyen pa'i bcu cha'i tshad kyi sbyin bsreg nges par blug dgos pas/ gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas kyang rgyun du nyams len ma chag par gal che zhing / dgos pa ni byin rlabs rgyun mi chad pas/ dkyil 'khor bris sgrub dang / dbang bskur/ lung sbyin dang / mnan bsreg 'phang gsum la sogs pa las gang byed pa thams cad la byin rlabs che zhing bkra shis pa 'byung ba yin la/ de ltar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi 'od can gyi 'grel pa/ bdud rtsi snying thig zhes bya ba 'di ni rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen du ma'i/

legs bshad bdud rtsi'i cha dang / khyad par rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ gzung ma mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la gdams pa'i 'grel pa rdo rje don gsal rnam dag zhes bya ba dang / /khyad par du yang rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter yig las/ sna nam skye ba sa skya'i mthil du 'byung / /mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i rten 'brel de la yod/ /zhes dang / gnam sa chos 'byung 'dra ba'i sa phyogs su/ /sa'i ming can gsang sngags chos la mos/ /khyad par pad+ma bdag la gus pa'i mi/ /bya yi lo pa thugs kar sme nag ldan/ /'brel tshad don ldan de la gtod rgya bgyis/ /zhes rgyal dbang pad+ma'i lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam bshad 'phrin las pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba la sogs pa'i dri med gsung rab du ma'i bcud bsdus nas/ rdo rje phur pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa cung zad gsal ba'i phyir du/ sa chen bla ma'i bran gyur dpal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes 'bod pas/ dge bcu'i khrims ldan mdo khams nang chen yul gyi dgon gnas/ mngon dga' bde chen gling zhes pa'i chos grwa chen por 'di bris pa'i/ yi ge pa ni mang thos mkhyen rab blo gsal gyis bgyis/ 'di brtsams pa la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtshos bzod par bzhes nas/ bdag rgyud sprin bral gyi zla ba ltar mdzes par gyur cig 'dir smras pa/ rin chen bai ḍūr sngon po'i ri rab la/ /tsha zer bye ba 'bum gyis gzi 'dus ltar/ /rab brjid lhag pa'i lha mchog la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs phyogs tsam gsal ba 'dis/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi kun brnyes pa/ /mi zad bdud rtsi'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /kun dga' bsod nams gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /brten nas bdud rtsi snying thig bdag gis bshad/

/'dod don rgyal sras blo gsal pad+mo'i tshal/ /zab don bdud rtsi grangs dang thig pa yis/ /skal ldan blo yi pad+mo rab rgyas nas/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i dpal mgon 'byung la re/ /des na chos 'di thos bsam byed rnams la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob zhal bzhes pa'i/ /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying la zhugs par shog /de bzhin lnga bcu rtsa gcig lha tshogs kyis/ /chos 'di tshul bzhin bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /dri med dpal 'bar zhal mchog mngon bstan nas/ /ring por mi thogs kun bzang sar 'god shog /gzhan yang dam can ma mo sde gsum dang / /dpa' bo ging dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs/ /mdor na pho nya sum brgya drug cu yis/ /bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub par shog /khyad par dpal ldan bka' bdud lcam dral dang / /phur pa'i srung ma dam can bcu gnyis la/ /chos 'di gnyer du gtad pas khyed rnams kyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /bdag gis 'di sbyar dge dang dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams ma lus gcig bsdus nas/ /mar gyur 'gro ba kun la phan don du/ /myur du kun mkhyen go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /de ltar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed kyi rnam bshad bdud rtsi snying thig 'di nyid nyams len gyi rnal 'byor pa rang dang skal mnyam rnams la phan phyir gcig las du mar byed pa'i chos sbyin spar gyi 'phrul sgo sa bya gnam lo gsar tshes mgo zla'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes spa shes 'grub 'byor nyin lce btsun ngag dbang blo gros snying po ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyis bla brang phun tshogs khang sar du grub par bgyis pa 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //sarba da ka l+ya naṃ// //7skyabs mgon bdag khri rdo rje 'chang gis rnam bshad shin tu klog dka' bar zhu dag gyis zhes bkas gnang ba ltar ku se ba a pad kyis gdod ma nas yi ge ma dag pa'i phung por gyur pa 'di zhu dag bgyis pas dub par gyur pa'i dge bas
